5.46.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
anyāni tatra tīrthāni yāni saṃti mahāmate ..
tāni kīrtaya sarvāṇi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ .. 1 ..
5.46.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
अन्यानि तत्र तीर्थानि यानि संति महामते ..
तानि कीर्तय सर्वाणि परं कौतूहलं हि नः .. 1 ..
5.46.m: The seers said: / Whatever other sacred fords are there, O highly wise one, / proclaim them all, for our curiosity is great indeed.

5.46.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatra sārasvataṃ tīrthamanyadasti suśobhanam ..
yatra snāto'timūko'pi bhavedvākyavicakṣaṇaḥ .. 2 ..
5.46.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तत्र सारस्वतं तीर्थमन्यदस्ति सुशोभनम् ..
यत्र स्नातोऽतिमूकोऽपि भवेद्वाक्यविचक्षणः .. 2 ..
5.46.m: Sūta said: / There is another very beautiful sacred ford there belonging to Sarasvatī, / where, having bathed, even an utterly mute person becomes eloquent in speech.

5.46.s:
labhate cepsitānkāmānmānuṣāndaivikānapi ..
brahmalokādiparyatāṃstathālokāndvijottamāḥ .. 3 ..
5.46.d:
लभते चेप्सितान्कामान्मानुषान्दैविकानपि ..
ब्रह्मलोकादिपर्यतांस्तथालोकान्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 3 ..
5.46.m: He also obtains desired wishes, both human and divine, / and likewise worlds up to the world of Brahmā, O best of brahmins.

5.46.s:
purāsītpārthivo nānā vikhyāto balavardhanaḥ ..
samudravalayāmurvīṃ bubhuje yo bhujārjitām.. 4 ..
5.46.d:
पुरासीत्पार्थिवो नाना विख्यातो बलवर्धनः ..
समुद्रवलयामुर्वीं बुभुजे यो भुजार्जिताम्.. 4 ..
5.46.m: Formerly there was a celebrated king named Balavardhana, / who enjoyed the earth encircled by the ocean, conquered by his own arms.

5.46.s:
tasya putraḥ samutpannaḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ ..
tasya nāma pitā cakre saṃprāpte dvādaśe'hani ..
ambuvīciriti spaṣṭaṃ samāhūya dvijottamān .. 5 ..
5.46.d:
तस्य पुत्रः समुत्पन्नः सर्वलक्षणसंयुतः ..
तस्य नाम पिता चक्रे संप्राप्ते द्वादशेऽहनि ..
अम्बुवीचिरिति स्पष्टं समाहूय द्विजोत्तमान् .. 5 ..
5.46.m: To him a son was born endowed with all auspicious marks. / When the twelfth day arrived, having summoned the best of brahmins, / the father clearly gave him the name 'Ambuvīci'.

5.46.s:
tataḥ sa vavṛdhe bālo lālitastena bhūbhujā ..
mūkabhāvaṃ samāpanno na śakroti prajalpitum .. 6 ..
5.46.d:
ततः स ववृधे बालो लालितस्तेन भूभुजा ..
मूकभावं समापन्नो न शक्रोति प्रजल्पितुम् .. 6 ..
5.46.m: Then that boy grew, fondled by that king; / having fallen into muteness, he was unable to speak.

5.46.s:
tato'sya saptame varṣe saṃprāpte balavardhanaḥ ..
paṃcatvaṃ samanuprāptaḥ saṃgrāme śatrubhirhataḥ .. 7 ..
5.46.d:
ततोऽस्य सप्तमे वर्षे संप्राप्ते बलवर्धनः ..
पंचत्वं समनुप्राप्तः संग्रामे शत्रुभिर्हतः .. 7 ..
5.46.m: Then, when his seventh year arrived, Balavardhana / met his death, slain in battle by enemies.

5.46.s:
tato mūko'pi bālopi maṃtribhistasya bhūpateḥ ..
sa sutaḥ sthāpito rājye abhāve'nyasutasya ca .. 8 ..
5.46.d:
ततो मूकोऽपि बालोपि मंत्रिभिस्तस्य भूपतेः ..
स सुतः स्थापितो राज्ये अभावेऽन्यसुतस्य च .. 8 ..
5.46.m: Then, though mute and still a child, by the ministers of that king / that son was established on the throne, in the absence of another son.

5.46.s:
evaṃ tasya mahīpasya rājyasthasya jaḍātmanaḥ ..
bālatve vartamānasya rājyaṃ viplavamadhyagāt .. 9 ..
5.46.d:
एवं तस्य महीपस्य राज्यस्थस्य जडात्मनः ..
बालत्वे वर्तमानस्य राज्यं विप्लवमध्यगात् .. 9 ..
5.46.m: Thus, while that dull-witted king was on the throne / and remaining in childhood, the kingdom fell into turmoil.

5.46.s:
tato jalacaranyāyaḥ saṃpravṛtto mahītale ..
pīḍyaṃte sarvalokāstu durbalā balavattaraiḥ .. 6.46.10 ..
5.46.d:
ततो जलचरन्यायः संप्रवृत्तो महीतले ..
पीड्यंते सर्वलोकास्तु दुर्बला बलवत्तरैः .. 6.46.10 ..
5.46.m: Then the law of the fishes set in upon the earth: / all people who were weak were oppressed by the stronger ones.

5.46.s:
tataste maṃtriṇaḥ procurvasiṣṭhaṃ svapurohitam ..
vaco'rthaṃ nṛpaterasya kurūpāyaṃ mahāmune .. 11 ..
5.46.d:
ततस्ते मंत्रिणः प्रोचुर्वसिष्ठं स्वपुरोहितम् ..
वचोऽर्थं नृपतेरस्य कुरूपायं महामुने .. 11 ..
5.46.m: Then those ministers said to Vasiṣṭha, their family priest: / 'O great sage, devise a means for the speech of this king.

5.46.s:
paśya kṛtsnaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhe śūnyatāṃ samupasthitam ..
jaḍatvānnṛpaterasya tasmātkuru yathocitam .. .. 12 ..
5.46.d:
पश्य कृत्स्नं धरापृष्ठे शून्यतां समुपस्थितम् ..
जडत्वान्नृपतेरस्य तस्मात्कुरु यथोचितम् .. .. 12 ..
5.46.m: Behold the whole surface of the earth has fallen into desolation / on account of this king's dumbness; therefore, do what is fitting.'

5.46.s:
tatastu suciraṃ dhyātvā dīnānprovāca maṃtriṇaḥ ..
sarvānārtisamopetāñchṛṇvatastasya bhūpateḥ .. 13 ..
5.46.d:
ततस्तु सुचिरं ध्यात्वा दीनान्प्रोवाच मंत्रिणः ..
सर्वानार्तिसमोपेताञ्छृण्वतस्तस्य भूपतेः .. 13 ..
5.46.m: Then, having meditated for a long time, he addressed the wretched ministers / who were all overcome with distress, while that king listened:

5.46.s:
asti sārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tatrāyaṃ snātu bhūpatiḥ .. 14 ..
5.46.d:
अस्ति सारस्वतं तीर्थं सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम् ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे तत्रायं स्नातु भूपतिः .. 14 ..
5.46.m: 'There is a sacred ford belonging to Sarasvatī that grants all desires to mortals / in the sacred field sprung from Hāṭakeśvara; let this king bathe there.'

5.46.s:
atha tadvacanātsadyaḥ sa gatvā tatra satvaram ..
snānāttīrthe'tha saṃjātastatkṣaṇātsa kala svanaḥ .. 15 ..
5.46.d:
अथ तद्वचनात्सद्यः स गत्वा तत्र सत्वरम् ..
स्नानात्तीर्थेऽथ संजातस्तत्क्षणात्स कल स्वनः .. 15 ..
5.46.m: Then, by his word, he went there swiftly without delay; / from the bath in the sacred ford, at that very moment his voice became melodious.

5.46.s:
tatprabhāvaṃ sarasvatyāḥ sa vijñāya mahīpatiḥ ..
śraddhayā parayā yukto dhyāyamānaḥ sarasvatīm .. 16 ..
5.46.d:
तत्प्रभावं सरस्वत्याः स विज्ञाय महीपतिः ..
श्रद्धया परया युक्तो ध्यायमानः सरस्वतीम् .. 16 ..
5.46.m: Having realised that power of Sarasvatī, the king, / endowed with supreme faith, meditating upon Sarasvatī,

5.46.s:
tatastūrṇaṃ samādāya mṛttikāṃ sa nadītaṭāt ..
cakāra bhāratīṃ devīṃ svayameva caturbhujām .. 17 ..
5.46.d:
ततस्तूर्णं समादाय मृत्तिकां स नदीतटात् ..
चकार भारतीं देवीं स्वयमेव चतुर्भुजाम् .. 17 ..
5.46.m: then quickly took clay from the riverbank / and himself fashioned the four-armed goddess Bhāratī:

5.46.s:
dadhatīṃ dakṣiṇe haste kamalaṃ sumanoharam ..
akṣamālāṃ tathānyasmiñjitatāraka varcasam .. 18 ..
5.46.d:
दधतीं दक्षिणे हस्ते कमलं सुमनोहरम् ..
अक्षमालां तथान्यस्मिञ्जिततारक वर्चसम् .. 18 ..
5.46.m: holding a very enchanting lotus in her right hand, / and in another a rosary surpassing the brilliance of stars;

5.46.s:
kamaṇḍaluṃ tathānyasmindivyavāriprapūritam ..
pustakaṃ ca tathā vāme sarvavidyāsamudbhavam .. 19 ..
5.46.d:
कमण्डलुं तथान्यस्मिन्दिव्यवारिप्रपूरितम् ..
पुस्तकं च तथा वामे सर्वविद्यासमुद्भवम् .. 19 ..
5.46.m: and in another a water-pot filled with divine water; / and in the left a book, the origin of all knowledge.

5.46.s:
tato medhye śilāpṛṣṭhe tāṃ niveśya prayatnataḥ ..
pūjayāmāsa sadbhaktyā dhūpamālpānulepanaiḥ .. 6.46.20 ..
5.46.d:
ततो मेध्ये शिलापृष्ठे तां निवेश्य प्रयत्नतः ..
पूजयामास सद्भक्त्या धूपमाल्पानुलेपनैः .. 6.46.20 ..
5.46.m: Then, having carefully placed her upon a pure slab of stone, / he worshipped her with true devotion using incense, garlands, and unguents.

5.46.s:
cakāra ca stutiṃ paścācchraddhāpūtena cetasā ..
tadagre prayato bhūtvā svareṇa mahatā nṛpaḥ .. 21 ..
5.46.d:
चकार च स्तुतिं पश्चाच्छ्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा ..
तदग्रे प्रयतो भूत्वा स्वरेण महता नृपः .. 21 ..
5.46.m: And afterwards, with a mind purified by faith, / becoming restrained in front of her, the king uttered a hymn of praise with a loud voice:

5.46.s:
sadasaddevi yatkiñcidbandhamokṣātmakaṃ padam ..
tatsarvaṃ guptayā vyāptaṃ tvayā kāṣṭhaṃ yathāgninā .. 22 ..
5.46.d:
सदसद्देवि यत्किञ्चिद्बन्धमोक्षात्मकं पदम् ..
तत्सर्वं गुप्तया व्याप्तं त्वया काष्ठं यथाग्निना .. 22 ..
5.46.m: 'O goddess, whatever state is real or unreal, having the nature of bondage and liberation, / all that is pervaded by you in a hidden manner, as wood [is pervaded] by fire.

5.46.s:
sarvasya siddhirūpeṇa tvaṃ janasya hṛdi sthitā ..
vācārūpeṇa jihvāyāṃ jyotīrūpeṇa cakṣuṣi .. 23 ..
5.46.d:
सर्वस्य सिद्धिरूपेण त्वं जनस्य हृदि स्थिता ..
वाचारूपेण जिह्वायां ज्योतीरूपेण चक्षुषि .. 23 ..
5.46.m: You dwell in the heart of every person in the form of accomplishment, / in the tongue in the form of speech, and in the eye in the form of light.

5.46.s:
bhaktigrāhyāsi deveśi tvamekā bhuvanatraye ..
śaraṇāgatadīnārtaparitrāṇaparāyaṇe ..24..
5.46.d:
भक्तिग्राह्यासि देवेशि त्वमेका भुवनत्रये ..
शरणागतदीनार्तपरित्राणपरायणे ..24..
5.46.m: You are accessible through devotion, O queen of gods, you alone in the three worlds, / dedicated to protecting the wretched and afflicted who have taken refuge.

5.46.s:
tvaṃ kīrtistvaṃ dhṛtirmedhā tvaṃ bhaktistvaṃ prabhā smṛtā ..
tvaṃ nidrā tvaṃ kṣudhā kīrtiḥ sarvabhūtanivāsinī .. 25 ..
5.46.d:
त्वं कीर्तिस्त्वं धृतिर्मेधा त्वं भक्तिस्त्वं प्रभा स्मृता ..
त्वं निद्रा त्वं क्षुधा कीर्तिः सर्वभूतनिवासिनी .. 25 ..
5.46.m: You are fame, you are fortitude, intellect; you are devotion, you are regarded as splendour; / you are sleep, you are hunger, renown, dwelling in all beings;

5.46.s:
tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirvapuḥ prītiḥ svadhā svāhā vibhāvarī ..
ratiḥ prītiḥ kṣitirgaṃgā satyaṃ dharmo manasvinī .. 26 ..
5.46.d:
तुष्टिः पुष्टिर्वपुः प्रीतिः स्वधा स्वाहा विभावरी ..
रतिः प्रीतिः क्षितिर्गंगा सत्यं धर्मो मनस्विनी .. 26 ..
5.46.m: contentment, nourishment, physical form, pleasure, Svadhā, Svāhā, the night, / delight, joy, the earth, the Gaṅgā, truth, righteousness, the high-minded woman;

5.46.s:
lajjā śāṃtiḥ smṛtirdakṣā kṣamā gaurī ca rohiṇī ..
sinīvālī kuhū rākā devamātā ditistathā .. 27 ..
5.46.d:
लज्जा शांतिः स्मृतिर्दक्षा क्षमा गौरी च रोहिणी ..
सिनीवाली कुहू राका देवमाता दितिस्तथा .. 27 ..
5.46.m: modesty, tranquility, memory, dexterity, patience, Gaurī and Rohiṇī; / Sinīvālī, Kuhū, Rākā, the mother of the gods, and likewise Diti;

5.46.s:
brahmāṇī vinatā lakṣmīḥ kadrūrdākṣāyaṇī śivā ..
gāyatrī cātha sāvitrī kṛṣirvṛṣṭiḥ śrutiḥ kalā .. 28 ..
5.46.d:
ब्रह्माणी विनता लक्ष्मीः कद्रूर्दाक्षायणी शिवा ..
गायत्री चाथ सावित्री कृषिर्वृष्टिः श्रुतिः कला .. 28 ..
5.46.m: Brahmāṇī, Vinatā, Lakṣmī, Kadrū, Dākṣāyaṇī, Śivā, / Gāyatrī, and Sāvitrī, agriculture, rain, the Veda, the arts;

5.46.s:
balānāḍī tuṣṭikāṣṭhā rasanā ca sarasvatī ..
yatkiñcittriṣu lokeṣu bahutvādyanna kīrtitam .. 29 ..
5.46.d:
बलानाडी तुष्टिकाष्ठा रसना च सरस्वती ..
यत्किञ्चित्त्रिषु लोकेषु बहुत्वाद्यन्न कीर्तितम् .. 29 ..
5.46.m: strength, the tubular channel, the limit of satisfaction, the tongue, and Sarasvatī; / whatever else exists in the three worlds that has not been mentioned on account of its multiplicity,

5.46.s:
iṃgitaṃ neṃgitaṃ tacca tadrūpaṃ te sureśvari..
gandharvāḥ kinnarā devāḥ siddhavidyādharoragāḥ .. 6.46.30 ..
5.46.d:
इंगितं नेंगितं तच्च तद्रूपं ते सुरेश्वरि..
गन्धर्वाः किन्नरा देवाः सिद्धविद्याधरोरगाः .. 6.46.30 ..
5.46.m: moving or unmoving, that too is your form, O queen of gods. / Gandharvas, Kinnaras, gods, Siddhas, Vidyādharas, and serpents,

5.46.s:
yakṣaguhyakabhūtāśca daityā ye ca vināyakāḥ ..
tvatprasādena te sarve saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ .. 31 ..
5.46.d:
यक्षगुह्यकभूताश्च दैत्या ये च विनायकाः ..
त्वत्प्रसादेन ते सर्वे संसिद्धिं परमां गताः .. 31 ..
5.46.m: Yakṣas, Guhyakas, Bhūtas, Daityas, and whichever Vināyakas there are— / by your grace they all attained the supreme perfection.

5.46.s:
tathānye'pi bahutvādye na mayā parikīrtitāḥ ..
ārādhitāstu kṛcchreṇa pūjitāśca suvistaraiḥ ..
haraṃtu devatāḥ pāpamanye tvaṃ kīrtitā'pi ca .. 32 ..
5.46.d:
तथान्येऽपि बहुत्वाद्ये न मया परिकीर्तिताः ..
आराधितास्तु कृच्छ्रेण पूजिताश्च सुविस्तरैः ..
हरंतु देवताः पापमन्ये त्वं कीर्तिताऽपि च .. 32 ..
5.46.m: Likewise, others also who have not been mentioned by me due to their multiplicity, / but worshipped with great austerity and revered with elaborate rites— / may the deities remove sin, and you too who have been praised.'

5.46.s:
evaṃ stutā sā deveśī bhūbhujā tena bhāratī ..
yayau pratyakṣatāṃ tūrṇaṃ prāha cedaṃ suharṣitā .. 33 ..
5.46.d:
एवं स्तुता सा देवेशी भूभुजा तेन भारती ..
ययौ प्रत्यक्षतां तूर्णं प्राह चेदं सुहर्षिता .. 33 ..
5.46.m: Praised in this way by that king, Bhāratī, the queen of the gods, / quickly appeared visibly and, greatly delighted, spoke these words:

5.46.s:
.. sarasvatyuvāca .. ..
stotreṇānena bhūpāla bhaktyā susthirayā sadā ..
parituṣṭāsmi tenāśu varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam.. 34 ..
5.46.d:
.. सरस्वत्युवाच .. ..
स्तोत्रेणानेन भूपाल भक्त्या सुस्थिरया सदा ..
परितुष्टास्मि तेनाशु वरं वृणु यथेप्सितम्.. 34 ..
5.46.m: Sarasvatī said: / "O king, by this hymn of praise and with your ever-firm devotion, / I am well pleased; therefore, quickly choose a boon as you desire."

5.46.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛti madvākyāttvayā stheyamasaṃśayam ..
atrārcāyāṃ trilokesmi nyāvatkīrtirmama sthirā .. 35 ..
5.46.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति मद्वाक्यात्त्वया स्थेयमसंशयम् ..
अत्रार्चायां त्रिलोकेस्मि न्यावत्कीर्तिर्मम स्थिरा .. 35 ..
5.46.m: The king said: / "From this day forward, by my word, you must certainly remain / here in this image in these three worlds as long as my fame endures.

5.46.s:
yastvāmārādhayetsamyagatrasthāṃ mannimittataḥ ..
bhaktyānurūpamevāśu tasmai deyaṃ tvayā hi tat .. 36 ..
5.46.d:
यस्त्वामाराधयेत्सम्यगत्रस्थां मन्निमित्ततः ..
भक्त्यानुरूपमेवाशु तस्मै देयं त्वया हि तत् .. 36 ..
5.46.m: Whoever properly worships you who reside here on my account, / to him you should quickly grant just what accords with his devotion."

5.46.s:
.. sarasvatyuvāca..
yo māmatra sthitāṃ nityaṃ snātvā'tra salile śubhe..
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pūjayiṣyati mānavaḥ .. 37 ..
5.46.d:
.. सरस्वत्युवाच..
यो मामत्र स्थितां नित्यं स्नात्वाऽत्र सलिले शुभे..
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां पूजयिष्यति मानवः .. 37 ..
5.46.m: Sarasvatī said: / "Whoever, having bathed here in this auspicious water, / constantly worships me residing here on the eighth and fourteenth days,

5.46.s:
tasyāhaṃ vāṃchitānkāmānsaṃpradāsyāmi pārthiva ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tatra sthitā devī svayameva sarasvatī .. 38..
5.46.d:
तस्याहं वांछितान्कामान्संप्रदास्यामि पार्थिव ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तत्र स्थिता देवी स्वयमेव सरस्वती .. 38..
5.46.m: to him, O king, I will grant his desired wishes." / Sūta said: / Thus the goddess Sarasvatī herself remained there.

5.46.s:
tataḥprabhṛti lokānāṃ hitāya parameśvarī ..
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāmupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ .. 39 ..
5.46.d:
ततःप्रभृति लोकानां हिताय परमेश्वरी ..
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यामुपवासपरायणः .. 39 ..
5.46.m: From then on, for the welfare of the worlds, the supreme goddess [remained]. / Devoted to fasting on the eighth and fourteenth days,

5.46.s:
yastāṃ pūjayate martyaḥ śvetapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ..
sa syādvāggmī sumedhāvī sadā janmanijanmani ..6.46.40..
5.46.d:
यस्तां पूजयते मर्त्यः श्वेतपुष्पानुलेपनैः ..
स स्याद्वाग्ग्मी सुमेधावी सदा जन्मनिजन्मनि ..6.46.40..
5.46.m: whatever mortal worships her with white flowers and ointments, / he becomes eloquent and wise in every birth forever.

5.46.s:
sarasvatyāḥ prasādena jāyamānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ ..
anvaye'pi na tasyaiva kaścinmūrkhaḥ prajāyate .. 41 ..
5.46.d:
सरस्वत्याः प्रसादेन जायमानः पुनःपुनः ..
अन्वयेऽपि न तस्यैव कश्चिन्मूर्खः प्रजायते .. 41 ..
5.46.m: Being born again and again by the grace of Sarasvatī, / no one who is a fool is ever born even in his lineage.

5.46.s:
yo dharmaśravaṇaṃ tasyāḥ purataḥ kurute naraḥ..
sa nūnaṃ vasati svarge tatprabhāvādyugatrayam..42..
5.46.d:
यो धर्मश्रवणं तस्याः पुरतः कुरुते नरः..
स नूनं वसति स्वर्गे तत्प्रभावाद्युगत्रयम्..42..
5.46.m: Whatever man listens to the sacred law before her, / he surely dwells in heaven for three yugas through her power.

5.46.s:
vidyādānaṃ naro yaśca tasyā hyāyatane sadā ..
karoti śraddhayā yuktaḥ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..43..
5.46.d:
विद्यादानं नरो यश्च तस्या ह्यायतने सदा ..
करोति श्रद्धया युक्तः सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ..43..
5.46.m: And whatever man, endowed with faith, constantly makes a gift of knowledge / in her shrine, he obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

5.46.s:
yo yacchati dvijendrāya dharmaśāstrasamudbhavam..
pustakaṃ vājimedhasya sa samagraṃ phalaṃ labhet .. 44 ..
5.46.d:
यो यच्छति द्विजेन्द्राय धर्मशास्त्रसमुद्भवम्..
पुस्तकं वाजिमेधस्य स समग्रं फलं लभेत् .. 44 ..
5.46.m: Whoever gives to a chief of brahmins a manuscript / derived from the dharmaśāstra, he obtains the entire fruit of an horse sacrifice.

5.46.s:
yo vedādhyayanaṃ tasyāḥ karoti purataḥ sthitaḥ ..
so'gniṣṭomasya yajñasya kṛtsnaṃ phalamavāpnuyāt .. 458 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye sarasvatī tīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 46 .. .. cha ..
5.46.d:
यो वेदाध्ययनं तस्याः करोति पुरतः स्थितः ..
सोऽग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य कृत्स्नं फलमवाप्नुयात् .. 458 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सरस्वती तीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 46 .. .. छ ..
5.46.m:
Whoever, standing before her, recites the Veda, / he obtains the full fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.
Thus ends the forty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Sarasvatī Tīrtha', in the Praise of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.47.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
mahākālasya māhātmyaṃ vistareṇa mahāmate ..
asmākaṃ sūtaja brūhi sarvaṃ vetti yato bhavān .. 1 ..
5.47.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
महाकालस्य माहात्म्यं विस्तरेण महामते ..
अस्माकं सूतज ब्रूहि सर्वं वेत्ति यतो भवान् .. 1 ..
5.47.m: The seers said: / "O great-minded son of Sūta, relate to us in detail / the glory of Mahākāla, since you know everything."

5.47.s:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
āsītpūrvaṃ mahīpāla ikṣvākukulanandanaḥ ..
rudrasena iti khyātaḥ sarvaśatruniṣūdanaḥ .. 2 ..
5.47.d:
..सूत उवाच .. ..
आसीत्पूर्वं महीपाल इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः ..
रुद्रसेन इति ख्यातः सर्वशत्रुनिषूदनः .. 2 ..
5.47.m: Sūta said: / "Formerly there was a king who brought joy to the Ikṣvāku race, / famed as Rudrasena, a slayer of all enemies.

5.47.s:
samudra iva gāṃbhīrye saumyatve śaśisaṃnibhaḥ ..
vīrye yathā sahasrākṣo rūpe kandarpasannibhaḥ .. 3 ..
5.47.d:
समुद्र इव गांभीर्ये सौम्यत्वे शशिसंनिभः ..
वीर्ये यथा सहस्राक्षो रूपे कन्दर्पसन्निभः .. 3 ..
5.47.m: He was like the ocean in profundity, like the moon in gentleness, / like the thousand-eyed Indra in valor, and like Kāmadeva in beauty.

5.47.s:
tasya kāṃtīti vikhyātā purī sarvaguṇānvitā ..
rājadhānyabhavacchreṣṭhā proccaprākāratoraṇā .. 4 ..
5.47.d:
तस्य कांतीति विख्याता पुरी सर्वगुणान्विता ..
राजधान्यभवच्छ्रेष्ठा प्रोच्चप्राकारतोरणा .. 4 ..
5.47.m: He had an excellent royal capital known as Kānti, endowed with all virtues, / with lofty ramparts and arched gateways.

5.47.s:
tathaivāsītpriyā tasya bhāryā paramasaṃmatā ..
khyātā padmavatīnāma rūpaudārya guṇānvitā .. 5 ..
5.47.d:
तथैवासीत्प्रिया तस्य भार्या परमसंमता ..
ख्याता पद्मवतीनाम रूपौदार्य गुणान्विता .. 5 ..
5.47.m: Likewise, he had a beloved, highly esteemed wife / known by the name of Padmāvatī, endowed with beauty, generosity, and virtues.

5.47.s:
sa tayā sahito rājā vaiśākhyā divase sadā ..
samabhyeti nijasthānātsainyenālpena saṃvṛtaḥ .. 6 ..
5.47.d:
स तया सहितो राजा वैशाख्या दिवसे सदा ..
समभ्येति निजस्थानात्सैन्येनाल्पेन संवृतः .. 6 ..
5.47.m: Always on the day of the full moon of Vaiśākha, that king, accompanied by her / and surrounded by a small army, went out from his own place.

5.47.s:
camatkārapure kṣetre pīṭhe tatra dvijottamāḥ ..
mahākālasya devasya purato rātrijāgaram ..
karoti śraddhayā yuktaḥ sabhāryaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ .. 7 ..
5.47.d:
चमत्कारपुरे क्षेत्रे पीठे तत्र द्विजोत्तमाः ..
महाकालस्य देवस्य पुरतो रात्रिजागरम् ..
करोति श्रद्धया युक्तः सभार्यः स महीपतिः .. 7 ..
5.47.m: O best of brahmins, in the sacred field of Camatkārapura, at that seat, / that ruler of the earth, endowed with faith and accompanied by his wife, / kept a night-vigil before the god Mahākāla,

5.47.s:
upavāsaparo bhūtvā dhyāyamāno maheśvaram ..
gītavādyena hṛdyena nṛtyena dvijasattamāḥ ..
dharmākhyānena viprāṇāṃ vedādhyayanavistaraiḥ .. 8 ..
5.47.d:
उपवासपरो भूत्वा ध्यायमानो महेश्वरम् ..
गीतवाद्येन हृद्येन नृत्येन द्विजसत्तमाः ..
धर्माख्यानेन विप्राणां वेदाध्ययनविस्तरैः .. 8 ..
5.47.m: intent on fasting, meditating on the great lord, / with charming vocal and instrumental music, with dance, O best of brahmins, / with narratives of sacred law by brahmins, and with extensive Vedic recitations.

5.47.s:
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya snātvā dhautāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ ..
dadau dānāni viprebhyastapasvibhyo viśeṣataḥ .. 9 ..
5.47.d:
ततः प्रातः समुत्थाय स्नात्वा धौतांबरः शुचिः ..
ददौ दानानि विप्रेभ्यस्तपस्विभ्यो विशेषतः .. 9 ..
5.47.m: Then, rising in the morning, having bathed, pure, dressed in clean garments, / he gave gifts to brahmins, especially to ascetics,

5.47.s:
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇebhyaśca tathānyebhyaḥ sahasraśaḥ ..
varṣevarṣe sadaivaṃ sa samabhyetya mahīpatiḥ ..
vaiśākhyāṃ jāgaraṃ tasya devasya purato'karot .. 6.47.10 ..
5.47.d:
दीनांधकृपणेभ्यश्च तथान्येभ्यः सहस्रशः ..
वर्षेवर्षे सदैवं स समभ्येत्य महीपतिः ..
वैशाख्यां जागरं तस्य देवस्य पुरतोऽकरोत् .. 6.47.10 ..
5.47.m: and by thousands to the poor, the blind, and the destitute, as well as others. / Year after year, that ruler of the earth, having always arrived thus / on the full moon of Vaiśākha, kept a vigil before that god.

5.47.s:
yathāyathā sa bhūpālaḥ kurute rātrijāgaram ..
mahākālāgratastasya tathā vṛddhiḥ prajāyate .. 11 ..
5.47.d:
यथायथा स भूपालः कुरुते रात्रिजागरम् ..
महाकालाग्रतस्तस्य तथा वृद्धिः प्रजायते .. 11 ..
5.47.m: In whatever manner that king kept the night-vigil / before Mahākāla, in that same way his prosperity increased.

5.47.s:
śatravo vilayaṃ yāṃti lakṣmīrvṛddhiṃ pragacchati ..
ekadā sa samāyātastatra yāvanmahīpatiḥ .. 12 ..
5.47.d:
शत्रवो विलयं यांति लक्ष्मीर्वृद्धिं प्रगच्छति ..
एकदा स समायातस्तत्र यावन्महीपतिः .. 12 ..
5.47.m: His enemies vanished, and his fortune steadily advanced. / Once, when that king had arrived there,

5.47.s:
tatraiva divase tāvanmahākālasya cāgrataḥ ..
apaśyadbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhānnānādigbhyaḥ samāgatān .. 13 ..
5.47.d:
तत्रैव दिवसे तावन्महाकालस्य चाग्रतः ..
अपश्यद्ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठान्नानादिग्भ्यः समागतान् .. 13 ..
5.47.m: on that very day, right before Mahākāla, / he saw the best of brahmins arrived from various directions,

5.47.s:
vedādhyayanasaṃpannānvrataniṣṭhāparāyaṇān ..
eke tatra kathāścakruḥ supuṇyā brāhmaṇottamāḥ .. 14 ..
5.47.d:
वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नान्व्रतनिष्ठापरायणान् ..
एके तत्र कथाश्चक्रुः सुपुण्या ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः .. 14 ..
5.47.m: rich in Vedic study and devoted to observing vows. / Some of those best of brahmins there narrated very holy tales:

5.47.s:
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ tathā pare ..
tīrthānāṃ ca tathā cānye brahmarṣīṇāṃ tathā pare ..
yajñānāṃ sāgarāṇāṃ ca dvīpānāṃ ca manoharāḥ .. 15 ..
5.47.d:
राजर्षीणां पुराणानां देवर्षीणां तथा परे ..
तीर्थानां च तथा चान्ये ब्रह्मर्षीणां तथा परे ..
यज्ञानां सागराणां च द्वीपानां च मनोहराः .. 15 ..
5.47.m: some about royal seers and the Purāṇas, others about divine seers, / others about sacred fords, others about brahmin seers, / and others charming stories about sacrifices, oceans, and continents.

5.47.s:
atha tānpṛthivīpālaḥ sa praṇamya yathākramam ..
upaviṣṭaḥ sabhāmadhye taiḥ sarvaiścābhinaṃditaḥ .. 16 ..
5.47.d:
अथ तान्पृथिवीपालः स प्रणम्य यथाक्रमम् ..
उपविष्टः सभामध्ये तैः सर्वैश्चाभिनंदितः .. 16 ..
5.47.m: Then that protector of the earth, having bowed to them in proper order, / sat down in the midst of the assembly and was welcomed by all of them.

5.47.s:
kasmiṃścidatha saṃprāpte kathāṃte te munīśvarāḥ ..
papracchurbhūmipālaṃ tu kautūhalasamanvitāḥ .. 17 ..
5.47.d:
कस्मिंश्चिदथ संप्राप्ते कथांते ते मुनीश्वराः ..
पप्रच्छुर्भूमिपालं तु कौतूहलसमन्विताः .. 17 ..
5.47.m: Then, when a certain story had ended, those lords among sages, / filled with curiosity, asked the ruler of the earth:

5.47.s:
vaiśākhīdivase rājaṃstvaṃ sadābhyetya dūrataḥ ..
varṣevarṣe'sya devasya purato rātrijāgaram .. 18 ..
5.47.d:
वैशाखीदिवसे राजंस्त्वं सदाभ्येत्य दूरतः ..
वर्षेवर्षेऽस्य देवस्य पुरतो रात्रिजागरम् .. 18 ..
5.47.m: "O king, on the day of the full moon of Vaiśākha, always coming from afar, / year after year, before this god, a night-vigil

5.47.s:
prakaroṣi prayatnena tyaktvānyāḥ sakalāḥ kriyāḥ ..
snānadānādikā yāśca nirdiṣṭāḥ śāstraciṃtakaiḥ .. 19 ..
5.47.d:
प्रकरोषि प्रयत्नेन त्यक्त्वान्याः सकलाः क्रियाः ..
स्नानदानादिका याश्च निर्दिष्टाः शास्त्रचिंतकैः .. 19 ..
5.47.m: you diligently observe, setting aside all other rites, / such as bathing, giving, and the like, which are prescribed by those who study the scriptures.

5.47.s:
na te yadi rahasyaṃ syāttadā'śeṣaṃ prakīrtaya ..
nūnaṃ tvaṃ vetsi tatsarvaṃ yatphalaṃ rātrijāgare .. 6.47.20 ..
5.47.d:
न ते यदि रहस्यं स्यात्तदाऽशेषं प्रकीर्तय ..
नूनं त्वं वेत्सि तत्सर्वं यत्फलं रात्रिजागरे .. 6.47.20 ..
5.47.m: If it is not a secret to you, then tell it completely. / Surely you know all that fruit which resides in the night-vigil."

5.47.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ caiva yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
yuṣmābhiḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi tathāpyakhilameva hi .. 210
ahamāsaṃ vaṇigjātyā purā vai vaidiśe pure ..
nirdhano baṃdhubhirmuktaḥ paribhūtaḥ padepade .. 22 ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ ..
vaidiśe nākarodvṛṣṭiṃ sapta varṣāṇi paṃca ca .. 23 ..
tato vṛṣṭinirodhena sarve lokāḥ kṣudhārdditāḥ ..
annābhāvānmṛtāḥ kecitkeciddeśāṃtare gatāḥ .. 24 ..
tato'haṃ svāṃ samādāya patnīṃ kṣutkṣāmagātrikām ..
aśrupūrṇamukhīṃ dīnāṃ praskhalantīṃ padepade ..25..
saurāṣṭraṃ manasi dhyātvā prasthitastadanantaram ..
subhikṣaṃ lokataḥ śrutvā jīvanāya dvijottamāḥ ..26..
krameṇa gacchamāno'tha bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ ..
ānartaviṣayaṃ prāptaścamatkārapurāṃtike .. 27 ..
5.47.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
रहस्यं परमं चैव यत्पृष्टोऽहं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
युष्माभिः कीर्तयिष्यामि तथाप्यखिलमेव हि .. 210
अहमासं वणिग्जात्या पुरा वै वैदिशे पुरे ..
निर्धनो बंधुभिर्मुक्तः परिभूतः पदेपदे .. 22 ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य भगवान्पाकशासनः ..
वैदिशे नाकरोद्वृष्टिं सप्त वर्षाणि पंच च .. 23 ..
ततो वृष्टिनिरोधेन सर्वे लोकाः क्षुधार्द्दिताः ..
अन्नाभावान्मृताः केचित्केचिद्देशांतरे गताः .. 24 ..
ततोऽहं स्वां समादाय पत्नीं क्षुत्क्षामगात्रिकाम् ..
अश्रुपूर्णमुखीं दीनां प्रस्खलन्तीं पदेपदे ..25..
सौराष्ट्रं मनसि ध्यात्वा प्रस्थितस्तदनन्तरम् ..
सुभिक्षं लोकतः श्रुत्वा जीवनाय द्विजोत्तमाः ..26..
क्रमेण गच्छमानोऽथ भिक्षान्नकृतभोजनः ..
आनर्तविषयं प्राप्तश्चमत्कारपुरांतिके .. 27 ..
5.47.m:
The king said: / "O best of brahmins, although what I am asked by you is a supreme secret, / nevertheless I shall tell it entirely.
Formerly, in the city of Vaidiśa, I was a merchant by caste, / poor, abandoned by relatives, and humiliated at every step.
Then, after some time, the blessed Indra / caused no rain to fall in Vaidiśa for twelve years.
Then, because of the drought, all the people were afflicted by hunger; / some died from lack of food, and some went to other countries.
Then, taking my wife, whose limbs were emaciated by hunger, / whose face was full of tears, miserable, and stumbling at every step,
I set out thereafter, fixing my mind on Saurāṣṭra, / having heard from people of abundance there, in order to survive, O best of brahmins."
Then, proceeding by degrees, having eaten food obtained by begging, / I arrived in the region of Ānarta, near Camatkārapura.

5.47.s:
tatra ramyaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ padminīkhaṇḍamaṃḍitam ..
saraḥ svacchodakāpūrṇaṃ jalapakṣibhirāvṛtam .. 28 ..
tato'haṃ tatsamāsādya snātaḥ śītena vāriṇā ..
kṣudhārtaśca tṛṣārtaśca śramārtaśca viśeṣataḥ .. 29 ..
athāhaṃ bhāryayā prokto gṛhāṇeśa jalāśayāt ..
jalajāni krayārthāya yena syādadya bhojanam .. 6.47.30 ..
etatsaṃdṛśyate dūrātpuraṃdarapuropamam ..
puraśreṣṭhaṃ samāsādya vikrayaṃ kartumarhasi .. ..3...
tato mayā gṛhītāni padmāni dvijasattamāḥ ..
vikrayārthaṃ prabhūtāni vācchamānena bhojanam ..32..
camatkārapuraṃ prāpya tato'haṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
bhrāṃtastrikeṣu sarveṣu catvareṣu gṛheṣu ca .. 33 ..
na kaścitpratigṛhṇāti tāni padmāni mānavaḥ ..
mama bhāgyavaśālloko jātaḥ krayaparāṅmukhaḥ ..34..
5.47.d:
तत्र रम्यं मया दृष्टं पद्मिनीखण्डमंडितम् ..
सरः स्वच्छोदकापूर्णं जलपक्षिभिरावृतम् .. 28 ..
ततोऽहं तत्समासाद्य स्नातः शीतेन वारिणा ..
क्षुधार्तश्च तृषार्तश्च श्रमार्तश्च विशेषतः .. 29 ..
अथाहं भार्यया प्रोक्तो गृहाणेश जलाशयात् ..
जलजानि क्रयार्थाय येन स्यादद्य भोजनम् .. 6.47.30 ..
एतत्संदृश्यते दूरात्पुरंदरपुरोपमम् ..
पुरश्रेष्ठं समासाद्य विक्रयं कर्तुमर्हसि .. ..3...
ततो मया गृहीतानि पद्मानि द्विजसत्तमाः ..
विक्रयार्थं प्रभूतानि वाच्छमानेन भोजनम् ..32..
चमत्कारपुरं प्राप्य ततोऽहं द्विजसत्तमाः ..
भ्रांतस्त्रिकेषु सर्वेषु चत्वरेषु गृहेषु च .. 33 ..
न कश्चित्प्रतिगृह्णाति तानि पद्मानि मानवः ..
मम भाग्यवशाल्लोको जातः क्रयपराङ्मुखः ..34..
5.47.m:
There I saw a delightful lake adorned with beds of lotuses, / filled with clear water, and covered with waterfowl.
Then I approached it and bathed in the cold water, / being afflicted by hunger, afflicted by thirst, and especially afflicted by fatigue.
Then I was addressed by my wife: “O lord, take water-born [lotuses] from the body of water / for the sake of sale, so that there may be food today.
This excellent city, resembling the city of Purandara, is seen from afar; / having reached it, you should make a sale.”
Then, O best of brahmins, I took many lotuses / for the sake of selling, desiring food.
Having reached Camatkārapura, O best of brahmins, / I then wandered through all the crossroads, squares, and houses.
Not a single human being accepted those lotuses; / through the power of my fate, the people were averse to buying.

5.47.s:
atha kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhasya śrāṃtasya mama bhāskaraḥ ..
astācalamanuprāptaḥ saṃdhyākālastato'bhavat .. 35 ..
tato vairāgyamāpannaḥ supto'haṃ bhagnamaṃdire ..
tāni padmāni bhūpṛṣṭhe nidhāya saha bhāryayā. 36 ..
athārdharātre saṃprāpte śruto gītadhvanirmayā ..
tataśca ciṃtitaṃ citte jāgaro'yamasaṃśayam ..37..
tasmādgacchāmi cetkaścitpadmānyetāni me naraḥ ..
mūlyena pratigṛhṇāti bhojanaṃ jāyate tataḥ .. 38 ..
evaṃ viniścayaṃ kṛtvā padmānyādāya satvaram..
sabhāryaḥ prasthitastatra yatra gītasya niḥsvanaḥ .. 39 ..
tataścāyatane tasminprāpto'haṃ munipuṃgavāḥ ..
apaśyaṃ devadeveśaṃ mahākālaṃ prapūjitam ..
agrasthitairdvijaśreṣṭhairjapagītaparāyaṇaiḥ .. 6.47.40 ..
eke nṛtyaṃ prakurvaṃti gītamanye japaṃ pare ..
anye homaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā dharmākhyānamathāpare .. 41 ..
5.47.d:
अथ क्षुत्क्षामकण्ठस्य श्रांतस्य मम भास्करः ..
अस्ताचलमनुप्राप्तः संध्याकालस्ततोऽभवत् .. 35 ..
ततो वैराग्यमापन्नः सुप्तोऽहं भग्नमंदिरे ..
तानि पद्मानि भूपृष्ठे निधाय सह भार्यया. 36 ..
अथार्धरात्रे संप्राप्ते श्रुतो गीतध्वनिर्मया ..
ततश्च चिंतितं चित्ते जागरोऽयमसंशयम् ..37..
तस्माद्गच्छामि चेत्कश्चित्पद्मान्येतानि मे नरः ..
मूल्येन प्रतिगृह्णाति भोजनं जायते ततः .. 38 ..
एवं विनिश्चयं कृत्वा पद्मान्यादाय सत्वरम्..
सभार्यः प्रस्थितस्तत्र यत्र गीतस्य निःस्वनः .. 39 ..
ततश्चायतने तस्मिन्प्राप्तोऽहं मुनिपुंगवाः ..
अपश्यं देवदेवेशं महाकालं प्रपूजितम् ..
अग्रस्थितैर्द्विजश्रेष्ठैर्जपगीतपरायणैः .. 6.47.40 ..
एके नृत्यं प्रकुर्वंति गीतमन्ये जपं परे ..
अन्ये होमं द्विजश्रेष्ठा धर्माख्यानमथापरे .. 41 ..
5.47.m:
Then, as my throat was emaciated with hunger and I was exhausted, the sun / reached the mountain of setting; then the evening twilight arrived.
Then, overcome with despair, having placed those lotuses upon the surface of the earth, / I slept in a ruined temple along with my wife.
Then, when midnight arrived, the sound of singing was heard by me; / and thereupon I thought in my mind: “Doubtless this is a vigil.
Therefore I will go; if some man accepts these lotuses of mine / for a price, then food will come about.”
Having thus resolved and quickly taken the lotuses, / accompanied by my wife I set out to where the sound of song was.
Then, having arrived at that temple, O bulls among sages, / I saw Mahākāla, the lord of the gods of gods, being worshipped / by the foremost brahmins standing before him, devoted to recitation and singing.
Some were performing dances, others songs, others recitation; / other foremost brahmins performed fire-offerings, and others discourses on dharma.

5.47.s:
tataḥ kaścinmayā pṛṣṭaḥ kriyate jāgaro'tra kim ..
ka ete jāgarāsaktā lokāḥ kīrtaya me drutam .. 42 ..
tenoktameṣa devasya mahākālasya jāgaraḥ ..
kriyate brāhmaṇairbhaktyā upavāsaparāyaṇaiḥ .. 43 ..
adya puṇyatithirnāma vaiśākhī puṇyadā parā ..
yasyāmasya puro bhaktyā naraḥ kuryātprajāgaram ..
mahākālasya devasya saukhyaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam .. 44 ..
saṃti padmāni me yaccha mūlyamādāya bhadraka ..
bhojanārthamahaṃ dadmi kaladhautapalatrayam .. 45 ..
tato'vadhāritaṃ citte mayā brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ..
pūjayāmi mahākālaṃ padmairetaiḥ sureśvaram .. 46 ..
na mayā sukṛtaṃ kiṃcidanyadehāṃtare kṛtam ..
niyataṃ tena saṃbhūta itthaṃbhūto'smi durgataḥ .. 47 ..
paraṃ kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭheyaṃ bhāryā me priyavādinī ..
annābhāvānna saṃdehaḥ prātaryāsyati saṃkṣayam .. 48 ..
5.47.d:
ततः कश्चिन्मया पृष्टः क्रियते जागरोऽत्र किम् ..
क एते जागरासक्ता लोकाः कीर्तय मे द्रुतम् .. 42 ..
तेनोक्तमेष देवस्य महाकालस्य जागरः ..
क्रियते ब्राह्मणैर्भक्त्या उपवासपरायणैः .. 43 ..
अद्य पुण्यतिथिर्नाम वैशाखी पुण्यदा परा ..
यस्यामस्य पुरो भक्त्या नरः कुर्यात्प्रजागरम् ..
महाकालस्य देवस्य सौख्यं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् .. 44 ..
संति पद्मानि मे यच्छ मूल्यमादाय भद्रक ..
भोजनार्थमहं दद्मि कलधौतपलत्रयम् .. 45 ..
ततोऽवधारितं चित्ते मया ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः ..
पूजयामि महाकालं पद्मैरेतैः सुरेश्वरम् .. 46 ..
न मया सुकृतं किंचिदन्यदेहांतरे कृतम् ..
नियतं तेन संभूत इत्थंभूतोऽस्मि दुर्गतः .. 47 ..
परं क्षुत्क्षामकंठेयं भार्या मे प्रियवादिनी ..
अन्नाभावान्न संदेहः प्रातर्यास्यति संक्षयम् .. 48 ..
5.47.m:
Then someone was asked by me: “Is a vigil being performed here? / Who are these people attached to the vigil? Tell me quickly.”
By him it was said: “This vigil for the god Mahākāla / is being performed by brahmins with devotion, dedicated to fasting.
Today is the auspicious lunar day named the full moon of Vaiśākha, granting supreme merit, / on which, if a man keeps vigil before this god Mahākāla / with devotion, he attains happiness without doubt.”
[I said:] “I have lotuses; give me [something] taking them for a price, O good man! / For the sake of food, I will give [them] for three palas of silver.”
Then it was resolved in my mind, O best of brahmins: / “I shall worship Mahākāla, the lord of gods, with these lotuses.
No good deed was done by me in any other body [in a past life]; / surely because of that, such a thing has happened, and I have become destitute.
Moreover, this wife of mine who speaks affectionately has a throat emaciated with hunger; / from lack of food she will perish by morning, of this there is no doubt.”

5.47.s:
evaṃ ciṃtayamānasya mama sā dayitā tataḥ ..
provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ vinayāvanatā sthitā ..49..
mā nātha kuru padmānāṃ vikrayaṃ dhanalobhataḥ ..
kuruṣva ca hitaṃ vākyaṃ yatte vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam .. 6.47.50 ..
upavāso balājjātaḥ sasyābhāvādasaṃśayam ..
asmākaṃ jāgaraṃ cāpi bhaviṣyati bubhukṣayā .. 51 ..
tatrobhābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ snānaṃ divā sarasi śobhane ..
gharmārttābhyāṃ śramārttābhyāṃ kṛtadevārcanaṃ tathā ..52..
tasmāddevaṃ mahākālaṃ pūjayāmo'dhunā vayam ..
padmairetaiḥ paraṃ śreya āvayoryena jāyate .. 53 ..
.. rājovāca .. ..
ubhābhyāmatha hṛṣṭābhyāṃ pūjito'yaṃ maheśvaraḥ ..
taiḥ padmaiḥ sattvamāsthāya kṛtvā pūjāṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 54 ..
kṣutpīḍayā samāyātā naiva nidrā kathaṃcana ..
svalpāpi maṃdire cātra sthitayorharasannidhau ..55..
5.47.d:
एवं चिंतयमानस्य मम सा दयिता ततः ..
प्रोवाच मधुरं वाक्यं विनयावनता स्थिता ..49..
मा नाथ कुरु पद्मानां विक्रयं धनलोभतः ..
कुरुष्व च हितं वाक्यं यत्ते वक्ष्यामि सांप्रतम् .. 6.47.50 ..
उपवासो बलाज्जातः सस्याभावादसंशयम् ..
अस्माकं जागरं चापि भविष्यति बुभुक्षया .. 51 ..
तत्रोभाभ्यां कृतं स्नानं दिवा सरसि शोभने ..
घर्मार्त्ताभ्यां श्रमार्त्ताभ्यां कृतदेवार्चनं तथा ..52..
तस्माद्देवं महाकालं पूजयामोऽधुना वयम् ..
पद्मैरेतैः परं श्रेय आवयोर्येन जायते .. 53 ..
.. राजोवाच .. ..
उभाभ्यामथ हृष्टाभ्यां पूजितोऽयं महेश्वरः ..
तैः पद्मैः सत्त्वमास्थाय कृत्वा पूजां द्विजोत्तमाः .. 54 ..
क्षुत्पीडया समायाता नैव निद्रा कथंचन ..
स्वल्पापि मंदिरे चात्र स्थितयोर्हरसन्निधौ ..55..
5.47.m:
Then, as I was thinking thus, that beloved wife of mine, / standing bowed in humility, spoke sweet words:
“O lord, do not make a sale of the lotuses out of greed for wealth; / and act on the beneficial advice which I will now tell you.
Fasting has occurred perforce due to the lack of grain, without doubt; / and for us there will also be a vigil because of hunger.
Moreover, bathing was performed by both of us by day in the beautiful lake, / afflicted by heat and afflicted by fatigue, and likewise worship of the deities was performed.
Therefore, let us now worship the god Mahākāla / with these lotuses, so that the highest good may come to the two of us.”
The king said: / “Then this Maheśvara was worshipped by the two joyful ones; / having summoned resolve and performed worship with those lotuses, O best of brahmins,
sleep did not come at all, even a little, due to the torment of hunger, / as the two of us stayed in that temple in the presence of Hara.

5.47.s:
tataḥ prabhātasamaye prodgate ravimaṃḍale ..
mṛto'haṃ kṣudhayāviṣṭaḥ sthāne'traiva dvijottamāḥ .. 56 ..
atha sā dayitā mahyaṃ tadādāya kalevaram..
harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭā praviṣṭā havyavāhanam .. 57 ..
tatprabhāvādahaṃ jātaḥ kāṃtīnātho mahīpatiḥ ..
daśārṇādhipateḥ kanyā sāpi jātismarā satī .. 58 ..
tataḥ svayaṃvaraṃ prāptā māṃ vijñāya nijaṃ patim ..
mayāpi saiva vijñāya pūrvapatnī samāhṛtā .. 59 ..
etasmātkāraṇādasya mahākālasya jāgaram ..
varṣevarṣe ca vaiśākhyāṃ karomi dvijasattamāḥ .. 6.47.60 ..
anayā priyayā sārdhaṃ puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ..
pūjayitvā mahākālaṃ satyametanmayoditam .. 61 ..
kṛto viprā mayā tveṣa sa tadā rātrijāgaraḥ ..
yathāpyetatphalaṃ jātaṃ devasyāsya prabhāvataḥ .. 62 ..
adhunā śraddhayā yukto yathoktavidhinā tataḥ ..
yatkaromi na jānāmi kiṃ me saṃyacchate phalam .. 63 ..
5.47.d:
ततः प्रभातसमये प्रोद्गते रविमंडले ..
मृतोऽहं क्षुधयाविष्टः स्थानेऽत्रैव द्विजोत्तमाः .. 56 ..
अथ सा दयिता मह्यं तदादाय कलेवरम्..
हर्षेण महताविष्टा प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहनम् .. 57 ..
तत्प्रभावादहं जातः कांतीनाथो महीपतिः ..
दशार्णाधिपतेः कन्या सापि जातिस्मरा सती .. 58 ..
ततः स्वयंवरं प्राप्ता मां विज्ञाय निजं पतिम् ..
मयापि सैव विज्ञाय पूर्वपत्नी समाहृता .. 59 ..
एतस्मात्कारणादस्य महाकालस्य जागरम् ..
वर्षेवर्षे च वैशाख्यां करोमि द्विजसत्तमाः .. 6.47.60 ..
अनया प्रियया सार्धं पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः ..
पूजयित्वा महाकालं सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 61 ..
कृतो विप्रा मया त्वेष स तदा रात्रिजागरः ..
यथाप्येतत्फलं जातं देवस्यास्य प्रभावतः .. 62 ..
अधुना श्रद्धया युक्तो यथोक्तविधिना ततः ..
यत्करोमि न जानामि किं मे संयच्छते फलम् .. 63 ..
5.47.m:
Then, at dawn, when the orb of the sun had arisen, / seized by hunger I died in this very place, O best of brahmins.
Then that beloved wife of mine, taking that body, / filled with great joy, entered the sacrificial fire.
By that power, I became the lord of the earth, the ruler of Kānti; / she too [was born as] the daughter of the sovereign of Daśārṇa, remembering her past birth, a virtuous wife.
Then, having arrived at the svayaṃvara, recognizing me as her own husband, / she, that very same former wife, was recognized and taken by me as well.
For this reason, O best of brahmins, year after year on the full moon of Vaiśākha, / I perform the vigil of this Mahākāla,
having worshipped Mahākāla together with this beloved wife / with flowers, incense, and unguents; this that I have spoken is true.
Indeed, O brahmins, that night-vigil was performed by me back then [in such a manner]; / yet such fruit was produced by the power of this god!
Now, endowed with faith, according to the prescribed rule, / whatever I do—I do not know what fruit it will grant me!

5.47.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā satyaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
yena satyena tenaiṣa mahākālaḥ prasīdatu .. 64 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etacchrutvā dvijaśreṣṭhā vismayotphullalocanāḥ ..
pracakrurjapatestasya sādhuvādānanekaśaḥ .. 65 ..
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
satyamuktaṃ mahīpāla tvayaitadakhilaṃ vacaḥ ..
mahākālaprasādena na kiṃciddurlabhaṃ bhuvi .. 66 ..
tasmādviśeṣataḥ sarve varṣevarṣe vayaṃ nṛpa ..
kariṣyāmo'sya devasya śraddhayā rātrijāgaram .. 67 ..
tataḥ sa pārthivaste ca sarva eva dvijātayaḥ ..
pracakrurjāgaraṃ tasya mahākālasya saṃnidhau ..68..
viśeṣāddharṣasaṃyuktā vividhairgītavādanaiḥ ..
dharmākhyānaiśca nṛtyaiśca vedoccāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
tadārabhya nṛpāḥ sarve pracakrurvismayānvitāḥ .. 69 ..
5.47.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं मया सत्यं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
येन सत्येन तेनैष महाकालः प्रसीदतु .. 64 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतच्छ्रुत्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठा विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनाः ..
प्रचक्रुर्जपतेस्तस्य साधुवादाननेकशः .. 65 ..
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
सत्यमुक्तं महीपाल त्वयैतदखिलं वचः ..
महाकालप्रसादेन न किंचिद्दुर्लभं भुवि .. 66 ..
तस्माद्विशेषतः सर्वे वर्षेवर्षे वयं नृप ..
करिष्यामोऽस्य देवस्य श्रद्धया रात्रिजागरम् .. 67 ..
ततः स पार्थिवस्ते च सर्व एव द्विजातयः ..
प्रचक्रुर्जागरं तस्य महाकालस्य संनिधौ ..68..
विशेषाद्धर्षसंयुक्ता विविधैर्गीतवादनैः ..
धर्माख्यानैश्च नृत्यैश्च वेदोच्चारैः पृथग्विधैः ..
तदारभ्य नृपाः सर्वे प्रचक्रुर्विस्मयान्विताः .. 69 ..
5.47.m:
All this has been related to you in truth by me, O best of brahmins; / by that truth, may this Mahākāla be pleased.”
Sūta said: / Having heard this, the foremost brahmins, their eyes wide with wonder, / repeatedly uttered praises to him as he was chanting.
The brahmins said: / “O protector of the earth, all these words spoken by you are true; / by the grace of Mahākāla, nothing is unobtainable on earth.
Therefore, O king, all of us especially, year after year, / shall perform the night-vigil of this god with faith.”
Then that ruler of the earth and all those brahmins / kept vigil in the presence of that Mahākāla.
Filled with great joy, with various songs and instruments, / with narrations of righteousness, dances, and diverse Vedic recitations, / all the kings, filled with wonder, observed [it] from then on.

5.47.s:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale samutthāya sa bhūpatiḥ ..
pūjayitvā mahākālaṃ tāṃśca sarvāndvijottamān ..
anujñāpya yayau hṛṣṭaḥ sasainyaḥ svapuraṃ prati .. 6.47.70 ..
tataḥ kālena saṃprāpya dehāntaṃ sa mahīpatiḥ ..
saṃprāptaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam .. 71 ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ mahākālasamudbhavam ..
māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇa śreṣṭhāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 72 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye mahākāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 47 .. ..
5.47.d:
ततः प्रभाते विमले समुत्थाय स भूपतिः ..
पूजयित्वा महाकालं तांश्च सर्वान्द्विजोत्तमान् ..
अनुज्ञाप्य ययौ हृष्टः ससैन्यः स्वपुरं प्रति .. 6.47.70 ..
ततः कालेन संप्राप्य देहान्तं स महीपतिः ..
संप्राप्तः परमं स्थानं जरामरणवर्जितम् .. 71 ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं महाकालसमुद्भवम् ..
माहात्म्यं ब्राह्मण श्रेष्ठाः सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 72 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये महाकालेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 47 .. ..
5.47.m:
Then, having arisen at the clear daybreak, that king / worshipped Mahākāla and all those best of brahmins; / having taken leave, rejoicing, he set out towards his own city with his army.
Then, in the course of time, reaching the end of his body, that king / attained the supreme abode, free from old age and death.
This entire māhātmya concerning the origin of Mahākāla has been told to you, / O best of brahmins, destroying all sins.
Thus ends the forty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Mahākāleśvara' in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.48.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatraivāsya samuddeśe hariścaṃdrasya bhūpateḥ ..
āśramo 'sti suvikhyāto nānādrumasamāvṛtaḥ .. 1 ..
5.48.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तत्रैवास्य समुद्देशे हरिश्चंद्रस्य भूपतेः ..
आश्रमो ऽस्ति सुविख्यातो नानाद्रुमसमावृतः .. 1 ..
5.48.m: Sūta said: / In that very region there is the well-known hermitage of King Hariścandra, / surrounded by diverse trees,

5.48.s:
yatra tena tapastaptaṃ saṃsthāpyomāmaheśvarau ..
yacchatā vividhaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo'bhivāṃchitam .. 2 ..
5.48.d:
यत्र तेन तपस्तप्तं संस्थाप्योमामहेश्वरौ ..
यच्छता विविधं दानं ब्राह्मणेभ्योऽभिवांछितम् .. 2 ..
5.48.m: where austerity was performed by him, having installed Umā and Maheśvara, / bestowing varied desired gifts upon brahmins.

5.48.s:
āsīdrājā hariścaṃdrastriśaṃkutanayaḥ purā ..
ayodhyādhipatiḥ śrīmānsūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ .. 3 ..
5.48.d:
आसीद्राजा हरिश्चंद्रस्त्रिशंकुतनयः पुरा ..
अयोध्याधिपतिः श्रीमान्सूर्यवंशसमुद्भवः .. 3 ..
5.48.m: Formerly, there was a king, Hariścandra, the son of Triśaṅku, / the glorious ruler of Ayodhyā, born of the Solar dynasty.

5.48.s:
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ dhruvam ..
tasmiñchāsati dharmeṇa na ca caurakṛtaṃ bhayam .. 4 ..
5.48.d:
न दुर्भिक्षं न च व्याधिर्नाकालमरणं ध्रुवम् ..
तस्मिञ्छासति धर्मेण न च चौरकृतं भयम् .. 4 ..
5.48.m: While he ruled righteously, there was certainly no famine, / no disease, no untimely death, and no fear caused by thieves.

5.48.s:
kālavarṣī sadā meghaḥ sasyāni pracurāṇi ca ..
rasavaṃti ca toyāni sarvartuphalitā drumāḥ .. 5 ..2
5.48.d:
कालवर्षी सदा मेघः सस्यानि प्रचुराणि च ..
रसवंति च तोयानि सर्वर्तुफलिता द्रुमाः .. 5 ..2
5.48.m: The clouds always rained in due season, crops were abundant, / the waters sweet, and the trees bore fruit in all seasons.

5.48.s:
daṃḍastatrābhavadvāstau gṛharodho'kṣadevane ..
eko doṣākaraścaṃdraḥ priyadoṣāśca kauśikāḥ .. 6 ..
5.48.d:
दंडस्तत्राभवद्वास्तौ गृहरोधोऽक्षदेवने ..
एको दोषाकरश्चंद्रः प्रियदोषाश्च कौशिकाः .. 6 ..
5.48.m: Punishment (daṇḍa) existed only in measuring poles; confinement to a house only in dice play; / the moon alone was the maker of night (doṣākara / maker of faults); and only owls (kauśika) loved the night (priyadoṣāḥ / loved faults).

5.48.s:
snehakṣayaśca dīpeṣu vivāhe ca karagrahaḥ ..
vṛttabhaṃgastathā gadye dānotthitirgajānane .. 7 ..
5.48.d:
स्नेहक्षयश्च दीपेषु विवाहे च करग्रहः ..
वृत्तभंगस्तथा गद्ये दानोत्थितिर्गजानने .. 7 ..
5.48.m: Loss of oil (sneha / affection) occurred only in lamps; taking of the hand (karagraha / taxation) only in marriage; / break of meter (vṛttabhaṅga / breach of conduct) only in prose; and issuance of rut (dāna / giving) only on the face of an elephant.

5.48.s:
tasyaivaṃ guṇayuktasya sārvabhaumasya bhūpateḥ ..
eka eva mahānāsīddoṣaḥ putravivarjitaḥ .. 8 ..
5.48.d:
तस्यैवं गुणयुक्तस्य सार्वभौमस्य भूपतेः ..
एक एव महानासीद्दोषः पुत्रविवर्जितः .. 8 ..
5.48.m: To that emperor of kings endowed with such virtues, / there was only one great defect: he was bereft of a son.

5.48.s:
tataḥ putrakṛte gatvā cakāra sumahattapaḥ ..
camatkārapure kṣetre liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ ..9..
5.48.d:
ततः पुत्रकृते गत्वा चकार सुमहत्तपः ..
चमत्कारपुरे क्षेत्रे लिंगं संस्थाप्य भक्तितः ..9..
5.48.m: Then, for the sake of a son, having gone to the sacred field of Camatkārapura / and installed a liṅga with devotion, he performed severe austerity.

5.48.s:
paṃcāgnisādhako grīṣme varṣāsvākāśasaṃsthitaḥ ..
jalāśrayaśca hemaṃte sa dhyāyati maheśvaram .. 6.48.10 ..
5.48.d:
पंचाग्निसाधको ग्रीष्मे वर्षास्वाकाशसंस्थितः ..
जलाश्रयश्च हेमंते स ध्यायति महेश्वरम् .. 6.48.10 ..
5.48.m: Enduring the five fires in the hot season, standing exposed to the sky in the rains, / and taking refuge in water in the cold season, he meditated on Maheśvara.

5.48.s:
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tasya tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..
pratyakṣo'bhūtsamaṃ gauryā gaṇasaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ .. 11 ..
uvāca varado'smīti prārthayasva yathepsitam ..
ahaṃ te saṃpradāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham...2..
5.48.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते तस्य तुष्टो महेश्वरः ..
प्रत्यक्षोऽभूत्समं गौर्या गणसंघैः समावृतः .. 11 ..
उवाच वरदोऽस्मीति प्रार्थयस्व यथेप्सितम् ..
अहं ते संप्रदास्यामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम्...2..
5.48.m:
Then, at the end of a thousand years, Maheśvara, pleased with him, / became visible together with Gaurī, surrounded by hosts of gaṇas.
[The god] said: 'I am the giver of boons; ask whatever you desire. / I shall grant it to you, even if it be very difficult to obtain.'

5.48.s:
tatastaṃ praṇipatyoccaiḥ stutvā sūktaiḥ śrutairapi ..
provāca vinayopetaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ .. 13 ..
5.48.d:
ततस्तं प्रणिपत्योच्चैः स्तुत्वा सूक्तैः श्रुतैरपि ..
प्रोवाच विनयोपेतः कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः .. 13 ..
5.48.m: Then, having bowed low before him, praised him aloud with hymns from the scriptures, / and stood with folded hands, [the king] spoke with humility:

5.48.s:
tvatprasādātsuraśreṣṭha yatkiṃciddharaṇītale ..
tadasti me gṛhe sarvaṃ vāṃchitaṃ svena cetasā .. 14 ..
surūpāṇi kalatrāṇi rājyaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam ..
śarīraṃ roganirmuktaṃ saṃkhyāhīnaṃ tathā dhanam...5..
ekaṃ me sumahadduḥkhaṃ yadapatyaṃ na vidyate ..
tasmāddehi sutaṃ deva prasanno yadi śaṃkara ...6.. ..
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
acireṇa nṛpaśreṣṭha putrastava bhaviṣyati ..
matprasādānna saṃdehastasmādgaccha drutaṃ gṛham...7..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etasminnaṃtare gaurī kopasaṃraktalocanā ..
bhartsayitvā mahādevaṃ tataḥ provāca taṃ nṛpam ...8..
5.48.d:
त्वत्प्रसादात्सुरश्रेष्ठ यत्किंचिद्धरणीतले ..
तदस्ति मे गृहे सर्वं वांछितं स्वेन चेतसा .. 14 ..
सुरूपाणि कलत्राणि राज्यं निहतकंटकम् ..
शरीरं रोगनिर्मुक्तं संख्याहीनं तथा धनम्...5..
एकं मे सुमहद्दुःखं यदपत्यं न विद्यते ..
तस्माद्देहि सुतं देव प्रसन्नो यदि शंकर ...6.. ..
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
अचिरेण नृपश्रेष्ठ पुत्रस्तव भविष्यति ..
मत्प्रसादान्न संदेहस्तस्माद्गच्छ द्रुतं गृहम्...7..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे गौरी कोपसंरक्तलोचना ..
भर्त्सयित्वा महादेवं ततः प्रोवाच तं नृपम् ...8..
5.48.m:
'By your grace, O best of gods, whatever there is on the surface of the earth / that is desired by my own heart—all that is in my house:
beautiful wives, an empire free of obstacles, / a body free of disease, and boundless wealth.
I have one great sorrow: that no offspring is found [to me]. / Therefore grant a son, O god, if Śaṃkara is pleased.'
The Blessed Lord said: / 'Before long, O best of kings, a son will be yours, / by my grace, there is no doubt; therefore go quickly to your house.'
Sūta said: / At this moment Gaurī, her eyes red with anger, / rebuked Mahādeva and then said to that king:

5.48.s:
yasmāttvayā mahāmūrkha na praṇāmaḥ kṛto mama ..
harādanaṃtaraṃ tasmācchāpaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ tava .. 19 ..
5.48.d:
यस्मात्त्वया महामूर्ख न प्रणामः कृतो मम ..
हरादनंतरं तस्माच्छापं दास्याम्यहं तव .. 19 ..
5.48.m: 'Since, O great fool, no obeisance was made by you to me / immediately after Hara, I will therefore utter a curse upon you.

5.48.s:
tava saṃlapsyate putro yathoktaḥ śūlapāṇinā ..
paraṃ tanmṛtyujaṃ duḥkhaṃ tvaṃ śiśutvepi lapsyase .. 6.48.20 ..
5.48.d:
तव संलप्स्यते पुत्रो यथोक्तः शूलपाणिना ..
परं तन्मृत्युजं दुःखं त्वं शिशुत्वेपि लप्स्यसे .. 6.48.20 ..
5.48.m: A son will be obtained by you, as spoken by the Trident-holder; / yet you shall experience the grief born of his death even in his childhood.'

5.48.s:
evamuktvā bhagavatī sārdhaṃ devena śaṃbhunā ..
adarśanaṃ yayau paścāttathānyairapi pārśvagaiḥ.. 21 ..
5.48.d:
एवमुक्त्वा भगवती सार्धं देवेन शंभुना ..
अदर्शनं ययौ पश्चात्तथान्यैरपि पार्श्वगैः.. 21 ..
5.48.m: Having spoken thus, the Goddess, together with Lord Śambhu / and the other attendants as well, vanished from sight.

5.48.s:
so'pi rājā varaṃ labdhvā śāpaṃ ca tadanaṃtaram ..
na jagāma gṛhaṃ bhūyaścakāra sumahattapaḥ .. 22 ..
5.48.d:
सोऽपि राजा वरं लब्ध्वा शापं च तदनंतरम् ..
न जगाम गृहं भूयश्चकार सुमहत्तपः .. 22 ..
5.48.m: The king, too, having obtained the boon and immediately after it the curse, / did not go home; once more he performed very severe austerity.

5.48.s:
ekāsanaṃ samārūḍhau kṛtvā gaurī maheśvarau ..
tataścārādhayāmāsa samaṃ puṣpānulepanaiḥ .. 23 ..
5.48.d:
एकासनं समारूढौ कृत्वा गौरी महेश्वरौ ..
ततश्चाराधयामास समं पुष्पानुलेपनैः .. 23 ..
5.48.m: Placing Gaurī and Maheśvara seated on the same seat, / he worshipped them equally with flowers and unguents.

5.48.s:
viśeṣeṇa dadau dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo mahīpatiḥ ..
bhūmiśāyī praśāṃtātmā ṣaṣṭhakālakṛtāśanaḥ .. 24 ..
5.48.d:
विशेषेण ददौ दानं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो महीपतिः ..
भूमिशायी प्रशांतात्मा षष्ठकालकृताशनः .. 24 ..
5.48.m: The king gave gifts especially to brahmins; / sleeping on the ground, serene in mind, he took food only at every sixth meal-time.

5.48.s:
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
pārvatyā sahito bhūyastasya saṃdarśanaṃ gataḥ .. 25 ..
5.48.d:
ततः संवत्सरस्यांते भगवान्वृषभध्वजः ..
पार्वत्या सहितो भूयस्तस्य संदर्शनं गतः .. 25 ..
5.48.m: Then, at the end of a year, the Lord whose banner bears the bull, / accompanied by Pārvatī, again appeared before his eyes.

5.48.s:
tataḥ sa nṛpatistābhyāṃ yugapadvidhipūrvakam..
kṛtvā natiṃ tato vākyaṃ vinayādidamabravīt .. 26 ..
5.48.d:
ततः स नृपतिस्ताभ्यां युगपद्विधिपूर्वकम्..
कृत्वा नतिं ततो वाक्यं विनयादिदमब्रवीत् .. 26 ..
5.48.m: Then the king, having bowed to both of them simultaneously according to rule, / spoke these words out of humility:

5.48.s:
purā devi mayānaṃdapūre vyākula cetasā ..
na natā tvaṃ na me kopaṃ tasmāttvaṃ kartumarhasi .. 27 ..
5.48.d:
पुरा देवि मयानंदपूरे व्याकुल चेतसा ..
न नता त्वं न मे कोपं तस्मात्त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि .. 27 ..
5.48.m: 'Formerly, O Goddess, my mind being agitated in a flood of bliss, / you were not bowed to [by me]; therefore you should not be angry with me.

5.48.s:
dehārdhadhāriṇī devi sadā tvaṃ śūladhāriṇaḥ ..
tadaikasminnate kasmānna natā tvaṃ vadasva me .. 28 ..
5.48.d:
देहार्धधारिणी देवि सदा त्वं शूलधारिणः ..
तदैकस्मिन्नते कस्मान्न नता त्वं वदस्व मे .. 28 ..
5.48.m: O Goddess, you always hold half the body of the Trident-bearer; / tell me, when one was bowed to, why were you not bowed to?

5.48.s:
yastaṃ namati deveśaṃ tena tvaṃ sarvadā natā ..
natāyāṃ tvayi deveśo nataḥ syāditi me matiḥ 529 ..
tathāpi ca pṛthaktvena mayā tvaṃ tu natā saha ..
ekāsanaṃ samārūḍhā tatsamaṃ devi pūjitā .. 6.48.30 ..
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yaḥ puroktaḥ purāriṇā ..
sostu vai saphalaḥ sadyo varaḥ putrakṛte mama .. 31 ..
yayā vaṃśadharaḥ putro dīrghāyurdṛḍhavikramaḥ ..
tvatprasādādbhaveddevi tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi .. 32 ..
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
nānyathā me vaco rājañjāyate'tra kathaṃcana ..
tasmādbālo'pi te putraḥ paṃcatvaṃ samupaiṣyati .. 33 ..
darśayitvā tu te duḥkhamalpamṛtyusamudbhavam ..
bhūyaḥ saṃprāpsyati prāṇānacirānme prasādataḥ .. 34 ..
bhaviṣyati ca dīrghāyustato vaṃśadharo jayī ..
sārvabhaumapradhānaśca dānī yajvā ca dharmavit .. .. 35 ..
5.48.d:
यस्तं नमति देवेशं तेन त्वं सर्वदा नता ..
नतायां त्वयि देवेशो नतः स्यादिति मे मतिः 529 ..
तथापि च पृथक्त्वेन मया त्वं तु नता सह ..
एकासनं समारूढा तत्समं देवि पूजिता .. 6.48.30 ..
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे यः पुरोक्तः पुरारिणा ..
सोस्तु वै सफलः सद्यो वरः पुत्रकृते मम .. 31 ..
यया वंशधरः पुत्रो दीर्घायुर्दृढविक्रमः ..
त्वत्प्रसादाद्भवेद्देवि तथा त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि .. 32 ..
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
नान्यथा मे वचो राजञ्जायतेऽत्र कथंचन ..
तस्माद्बालोऽपि ते पुत्रः पंचत्वं समुपैष्यति .. 33 ..
दर्शयित्वा तु ते दुःखमल्पमृत्युसमुद्भवम् ..
भूयः संप्राप्स्यति प्राणानचिरान्मे प्रसादतः .. 34 ..
भविष्यति च दीर्घायुस्ततो वंशधरो जयी ..
सार्वभौमप्रधानश्च दानी यज्वा च धर्मवित् .. .. 35 ..
5.48.m:
Whoever bows to the Lord of gods has bowed to you at all times; / when you are bowed to, the Lord of gods is bowed to—such is my view.
Nevertheless, you have been bowed to by me together [with him], not separately; / mounted on one seat, you have been worshipped equally, O Goddess.
Therefore grant me your grace; let that boon which was spoken earlier by the Enemy of Pura / for the sake of my son become immediately fruitful.
By your grace, O Goddess, let a son be born who carries on the lineage, / long-lived and of firm valour; thus you ought to act.'
The Goddess said: / 'O King, my word never turns out otherwise in any way; / therefore your son, even while a child, shall meet his demise.
Yet, having shown you the sorrow arising from an early death, / he shall regain his life again before long through my grace.
And he shall be long-lived thereafter, the continuer of the lineage, victorious, / foremost among universal rulers, generous, a sacrificer, and knower of righteousness.

5.48.s:
tasmādrājangṛhaṃ gatvā kuru rājyamabhīpsitam ..
saṃprāpsyasi sutaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yādṛśaṃ kīrtitaṃ mayā .. 36..
anyo'pi mānavo yo māṃ rūpeṇā nenasaṃsthitām ..
pūjayiṣyati cātraiva samaṃ devena śaṃbhunā .. 37 ..
tasyāhaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi putrānhṛdayavāṃchitān ..
tathānyadapi yatkiṃcidacirānnātra saṃśayaḥ .. 38 ..
śrīmahādeva uvāca .. ..
bhūya eva nṛpaśreṣṭha mattaḥ prārthaya vāṃchitam ..
na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syātsatyametadbravīmi te .. 39 ..
.. hariścaṃdra uvāca .. ..
kṛtakṛtyosmi deveśa sarvamasti gṛhe mama ..
putraṃ tyaktvā tvayā so'pi datto vaṃśadharo jayī .. 6.48.40 ..
tathāpi na tavādeśo vyarthaḥ kāryaḥ kathaṃcana ..
etasmātkāraṇāddeva yācayiṣyāmi vāṃchitam .. 41 ..
rājasūyakṛte'smākaṃ sadā buddhiḥ pravartate ..
niṣedhayaṃti māṃ sarve mantriṇaḥ suhṛdastadā .. 42 ..
5.48.d:
तस्माद्राजन्गृहं गत्वा कुरु राज्यमभीप्सितम् ..
संप्राप्स्यसि सुतं श्रेष्ठं यादृशं कीर्तितं मया .. 36..
अन्योऽपि मानवो यो मां रूपेणा नेनसंस्थिताम् ..
पूजयिष्यति चात्रैव समं देवेन शंभुना .. 37 ..
तस्याहं संप्रदास्यामि पुत्रान्हृदयवांछितान् ..
तथान्यदपि यत्किंचिदचिरान्नात्र संशयः .. 38 ..
श्रीमहादेव उवाच .. ..
भूय एव नृपश्रेष्ठ मत्तः प्रार्थय वांछितम् ..
न वृथा दर्शनं मे स्यात्सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते .. 39 ..
.. हरिश्चंद्र उवाच .. ..
कृतकृत्योस्मि देवेश सर्वमस्ति गृहे मम ..
पुत्रं त्यक्त्वा त्वया सोऽपि दत्तो वंशधरो जयी .. 6.48.40 ..
तथापि न तवादेशो व्यर्थः कार्यः कथंचन ..
एतस्मात्कारणाद्देव याचयिष्यामि वांछितम् .. 41 ..
राजसूयकृतेऽस्माकं सदा बुद्धिः प्रवर्तते ..
निषेधयंति मां सर्वे मन्त्रिणः सुहृदस्तदा .. 42 ..
5.48.m:
Therefore, O King, go home and rule the desired kingdom; / you shall obtain an excellent son, such as was described by me.'
And whatever other human being shall worship me stationed in this form, / right here, together with the god Śambhu,
to him I will grant sons cherished in his heart, / and likewise whatever else [he desires], without delay; of this there is no doubt.
Śrī Mahādeva said:
Ask of me once again, best of kings, whatever you desire. / My darśana shall not be in vain; this I tell you in truth.
Hariścandra said:
Lord of the gods, I have accomplished my purpose; everything is present in my house, / except a son, and he too has been given by you—a lineage-bearer and victorious.
Even so, your command must by no means be made fruitless. / For this reason, O god, I shall ask for a desired boon.
Our mind is constantly inclined toward performing the Rājasūya sacrifice, / but all my ministers and friends then dissuade me:

5.48.s:
sarvaistairjāyate yajñaḥ pārthivaiḥ karadīkṛtaiḥ ..
yuddhaṃ vinā karaṃ te'pi na yacchanti yato vibho .. 43 ..
tato yuddhārthinaṃ māṃ te vārayaṃti hitaiṣiṇaḥ ..
kṛtotsāhaṃ makhaprāptau nītimārgasamāśritāḥ .. 44 ..
tasmāttava prasādena rājasūyo bhavenmakhaḥ ..
avighnaḥ siddhimāyātu mama nānyadvṛṇomyaham ..45..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sa tatheti pratijñāya jagāmādarśana haraḥ ..
so'pi labdhavaro bhūpaḥ svameva bhavanaṃ gataḥ .. 46 ..
evaṃ tena narendreṇa pūrvaṃ tatra vinirmitau ..
umāmaheśvarau paścānnirmitāvitarairapi .. 47 ..
yastābhyāṃ kurute pūjāṃ saṃprāpte paṃcamī dine ..
phalaiḥ sarveṣu gātreṣu yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ ..
sutaṃ prāpnoti so'bhīṣṭaṃ svavaṃśoddharaṇakṣamam .. 48 ..
5.48.d:
सर्वैस्तैर्जायते यज्ञः पार्थिवैः करदीकृतैः ..
युद्धं विना करं तेऽपि न यच्छन्ति यतो विभो .. 43 ..
ततो युद्धार्थिनं मां ते वारयंति हितैषिणः ..
कृतोत्साहं मखप्राप्तौ नीतिमार्गसमाश्रिताः .. 44 ..
तस्मात्तव प्रसादेन राजसूयो भवेन्मखः ..
अविघ्नः सिद्धिमायातु मम नान्यद्वृणोम्यहम् ..45..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय जगामादर्शन हरः ..
सोऽपि लब्धवरो भूपः स्वमेव भवनं गतः .. 46 ..
एवं तेन नरेन्द्रेण पूर्वं तत्र विनिर्मितौ ..
उमामहेश्वरौ पश्चान्निर्मितावितरैरपि .. 47 ..
यस्ताभ्यां कुरुते पूजां संप्राप्ते पंचमी दिने ..
फलैः सर्वेषु गात्रेषु यावत्संवत्सरं द्विजाः ..
सुतं प्राप्नोति सोऽभीष्टं स्ववंशोद्धरणक्षमम् .. 48 ..
5.48.m:
‘That sacrifice is accomplished only when all kings have been made tributary; / and since, O Lord, they will not pay tribute without a battle,
therefore, relying on the path of statecraft, those well-wishers hold me back / when I desire war and have set my heart upon securing the sacrifice.’
Therefore, by your grace, may the Rājasūya sacrifice take place / and reach completion without obstacle; I choose nothing else.
Sūta said:
Having promised ‘So be it,’ Hara disappeared from sight. / That king too, having obtained the boon, returned to his own palace.
In this way, Umā and Maheśvara were first fashioned there by that lord of men; / afterwards, they were fashioned by others as well.
Whoever performs their worship when the fifth day arrives, / with fruits upon all their limbs for the duration of a year, O twice-born ones, / obtains the desired son capable of redeeming his own lineage.

5.48.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya umāmaheśvarotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 48 .. .. .. .. ..
5.48.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य उमामहेश्वरोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टाचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 48 .. .. .. .. ..
5.48.m: Thus ends the forty-eighth chapter, named ‘Description of the Origin and Māhātmya of Umā and Maheśvara,’ in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.49.s:
sūta uvāca .. ..
tatraivāsti mahāpuṇyo hradatīre vyavasthitaḥ ..
kalaśeśvara ityākhyaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ .. 1 ..
5.49.d:
सूत उवाच .. ..
तत्रैवास्ति महापुण्यो ह्रदतीरे व्यवस्थितः ..
कलशेश्वर इत्याख्यः सर्वपापप्रणाशनः .. 1 ..
5.49.m:
Sūta said:
Right there, situated on the bank of the pool, is the exceedingly holy [liṅga] / named Kalaśeśvara, which destroys all sins.

5.49.s: dṛṣṭvā pramucyate pāpānmanuṣyaḥ kalaśeśvaram.. 2 ..
5.49.d: दृष्ट्वा प्रमुच्यते पापान्मनुष्यः कलशेश्वरम्.. 2 ..
5.49.m: Upon seeing Kalaśeśvara, a human being is liberated from sins.

5.49.s:
purāsītkalaśonāma yaduvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ..
yajvā dānapatirdakṣaḥ sarvalokahite rataḥ .. 3 ..
5.49.d:
पुरासीत्कलशोनाम यदुवंशसमुद्भवः ..
यज्वा दानपतिर्दक्षः सर्वलोकहिते रतः .. 3 ..
5.49.m: Formerly, there was a man named Kalaśa, born of the Yadu lineage, / a sacrificer, a master of generosity, capable, and devoted to the welfare of all people.

5.49.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya durvāsā muni sattamaḥ ..
cāturmāsyavrataṃ kṛtvā tadgṛhaṃ samupasthitaḥ .. 4 ..
5.49.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य दुर्वासा मुनि सत्तमः ..
चातुर्मास्यव्रतं कृत्वा तद्गृहं समुपस्थितः .. 4 ..
5.49.m: Then, after some time, the sage Durvāsas, best of munis, / having observed the vow of Cāturmāsya, arrived at his house.

5.49.s:
athotthāya nṛpastūrṇaṃ sammukhaḥ prayayau mudā ..
svāgataṃ svāgataṃ testu bruvāṇa iti sādaram .. 5 ..
5.49.d:
अथोत्थाय नृपस्तूर्णं सम्मुखः प्रययौ मुदा ..
स्वागतं स्वागतं तेस्तु ब्रुवाण इति सादरम् .. 5 ..
5.49.m: Thereupon the king rose quickly and went forward with joy, / respectfully saying: “Welcome! Welcome to you!”

5.49.s:
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ bhaktyā prakṣālya caraṇau svayam ..
dattvārghamiti hovāca harṣabāṣpākulekṣaṇaḥ .. 6 ..
5.49.d:
ततः प्रणम्य तं भक्त्या प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ स्वयम् ..
दत्त्वार्घमिति होवाच हर्षबाष्पाकुलेक्षणः .. 6 ..
5.49.m: Then, having bowed to him with devotion, washed his feet himself, / and offered the guest-offering, he spoke thus, his eyes clouded with tears of joy:

5.49.s:
idaṃ rājyamamī putrā imā nārya idaṃ dhanam..
brūhi sarvaṃ mune tvaṃ ca tava kāryaṃ dadāmyaham .. 7 ..
5.49.d:
इदं राज्यममी पुत्रा इमा नार्य इदं धनम्..
ब्रूहि सर्वं मुने त्वं च तव कार्यं ददाम्यहम् .. 7 ..
5.49.m: “Here is the kingdom, here are my sons, here are these women, here is the wealth. / Say whatever it is, O muni, and I will accomplish your purpose.”

5.49.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
yuktametanmahārāja vaktuṃ te kāryamīdṛśam ..
gṛhāgatāya viprāya vratine'smadvidhāya ca .. 8 ..
5.49.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
युक्तमेतन्महाराज वक्तुं ते कार्यमीदृशम् ..
गृहागताय विप्राय व्रतिनेऽस्मद्विधाय च .. 8 ..
5.49.m:
Durvāsas said:
It is fitting for you, great king, to speak such a purpose / to a brahmin who has come to your house, one observing vows like us.

5.49.s:
na me kiñciddhanaiḥ kāryaṃ na rājyena nṛpottama ..
cāturmāsyavrato'to'haṃ pāraṇaṃ kartṛmutsahe .. 9 ..
5.49.d:
न मे किञ्चिद्धनैः कार्यं न राज्येन नृपोत्तम ..
चातुर्मास्यव्रतोऽतोऽहं पारणं कर्तृमुत्सहे .. 9 ..
5.49.m: I have no need of wealth, nor of a kingdom, best of kings. / I have kept the vow of Cāturmāsya, and therefore I wish to break my fast.

5.49.s:
tasmādyatkiñcidannaṃ te siddhamasti gṛhe nṛpa ..
taddehi bhojanārthaṃ me bubhukṣātīva vardhate .. 6.49.10 ..
5.49.d:
तस्माद्यत्किञ्चिदन्नं ते सिद्धमस्ति गृहे नृप ..
तद्देहि भोजनार्थं मे बुभुक्षातीव वर्धते .. 6.49.10 ..
5.49.m: Therefore, O king, whatever food is already prepared in your house, / give that to me to eat; my hunger increases exceedingly.

5.49.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥ sa pṛthivīpālo yathāsiddhaṃ susaṃskṛm ..
annaṃ bhojyakṛte tasmai pradadau svayameva hi .. 11 ..
5.49.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततः स पृथिवीपालो यथासिद्धं सुसंस्कृम् ..
अन्नं भोज्यकृते तस्मै प्रददौ स्वयमेव हि .. 11 ..
5.49.m:
Sūta said:
Then that protector of the earth personally gave him / the food just as it had been prepared and well cooked, for his meal—

5.49.s:
vyañjanāni vicitrāṇi pakvānnāni bahūni ca ..
peyaṃ coṣyaṃ ca khādyaṃ ca lehyamannamanekadhā ..
tathā māṃsaṃ vicitraṃ ca lavaṇādyaiḥ susaṃskṛtam .. 12 ..
5.49.d:
व्यञ्जनानि विचित्राणि पक्वान्नानि बहूनि च ..
पेयं चोष्यं च खाद्यं च लेह्यमन्नमनेकधा ..
तथा मांसं विचित्रं च लवणाद्यैः सुसंस्कृतम् .. 12 ..
5.49.m: various condiments, many cooked dishes, / manifold food to be drunk, sucked, chewed, and licked, / and also varied meat, well prepared with salt and seasonings.

5.49.s:
athāsau bubhuje vipraḥ kṣutkṣāmastvarayānvitaḥ ..
avindanna rasāsvādaṃ bṛhadgrāsairmudānvitaḥ .. 13 ..
5.49.d:
अथासौ बुभुजे विप्रः क्षुत्क्षामस्त्वरयान्वितः ..
अविन्दन्न रसास्वादं बृहद्ग्रासैर्मुदान्वितः .. 13 ..
5.49.m: Then that brahmin, emaciated with hunger, ate in haste, / taking large mouthfuls with joy, not discerning the taste.

5.49.s:
atha tṛptena māṃsasya jñātastena raso dvijāḥ ..
tataḥ kopaparītātmā taṃ śaśāpa munīśvaraḥ .. 14 ..
5.49.d:
अथ तृप्तेन मांसस्य ज्ञातस्तेन रसो द्विजाः ..
ततः कोपपरीतात्मा तं शशाप मुनीश्वरः .. 14 ..
5.49.m: Then, when he was satiated, the taste of the meat was recognized by him, O twice-born ones; / thereupon the lord of sages, his soul overcome with anger, cursed him:

5.49.s:
yasmānmāṃsaṃ tvayā dattvā vratabhaṃgaḥ kṛto mama ..
tasmāttvamāmiṣāhāro raudro vyāghro bhaviṣyasi .. 15 ..
5.49.d:
यस्मान्मांसं त्वया दत्त्वा व्रतभंगः कृतो मम ..
तस्मात्त्वमामिषाहारो रौद्रो व्याघ्रो भविष्यसि .. 15 ..
5.49.m: “Since by giving meat you have caused the breaking of my vow, / therefore you shall become a ferocious tiger that feeds on flesh!”

5.49.s:
tataḥ sa bhūpatirbhītaḥ praṇamya ca munīśvaram ..
provāca dīnavadano vepamānaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ .. 16 ..
5.49.d:
ततः स भूपतिर्भीतः प्रणम्य च मुनीश्वरम् ..
प्रोवाच दीनवदनो वेपमानः सुदुःखितः .. 16 ..
5.49.m: Then the king, terrified, bowed down before the lord of sages / and, trembling and deeply grieved, spoke with a wretched countenance:

5.49.s:
tava kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhasya mayā bhaktiḥ kṛtā mune ..
yathāsiddhena bhojyena tatkasmācchaptumudyataḥ .. 17 ..
5.49.d:
तव क्षुत्क्षामकण्ठस्य मया भक्तिः कृता मुने ..
यथासिद्धेन भोज्येन तत्कस्माच्छप्तुमुद्यतः .. 17 ..
5.49.m: “Devotion was shown by me to you whose throat was parched with hunger, O muni, / with food just as it had been prepared; why then are you bent on cursing me?

5.49.s:
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me bhaktasya vinatasya ca ..
śāpasyānugraheṇaiva śīghraṃ brāhmaṇasattama .. 18 ..
5.49.d:
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे भक्तस्य विनतस्य च ..
शापस्यानुग्रहेणैव शीघ्रं ब्राह्मणसत्तम .. 18 ..
5.49.m: Therefore, show favor to me, your devoted and bowed [servant], / by showing grace regarding the curse swiftly, best of brahmins!”

5.49.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
muktvā śrāddhaṃ tathā yajñaṃ na māṃsaṃ bhakṣayeddvijaḥ ..
viśeṣeṇa vratasyāṃte cāturmāsyodbhavasya ca .. 19 ..
5.49.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
मुक्त्वा श्राद्धं तथा यज्ञं न मांसं भक्षयेद्द्विजः ..
विशेषेण व्रतस्यांते चातुर्मास्योद्भवस्य च .. 19 ..
5.49.m:
Durvāsas said:
Except at a śrāddha or a sacrifice, a twice-born man should not eat meat, / especially at the conclusion of the vow born of Cāturmāsya.

5.49.s:
upavāsaparo bhūtvā māṃsamaśnāti yo dvijaḥ ..
vṛthāmāṃsādvṛthā tasya tadvrataṃ jāyate dhruvam .. 6.49.20 ..
5.49.d:
उपवासपरो भूत्वा मांसमश्नाति यो द्विजः ..
वृथामांसाद्वृथा तस्य तद्व्रतं जायते ध्रुवम् .. 6.49.20 ..
5.49.m: A twice-born man who, having been intent on fasting, eats meat, / his vow certainly becomes vain because of the vain meat.

5.49.s:
tasmādvrataṃ praṇaṣṭaṃ me cāturmāsyasamudbhavam ..
tena śapto'si rājeṃdra mayā kopena sāṃpratam .. 21 ..
5.49.d:
तस्माद्व्रतं प्रणष्टं मे चातुर्मास्यसमुद्भवम् ..
तेन शप्तोऽसि राजेंद्र मया कोपेन सांप्रतम् .. 21 ..
5.49.m: Therefore my vow arising from Cāturmāsya has been ruined; / on that account you have now been cursed by me in anger, O king of kings.

5.49.s:
..rājovāca .. ..
tathāpi kuru me vipra śāpasyāṃtaṃ yathepsitam ..
bhaktiyuktasya dīnasya nirdoṣasya viśeṣataḥ .. 22..
5.49.d:
..राजोवाच .. ..
तथापि कुरु मे विप्र शापस्यांतं यथेप्सितम् ..
भक्तियुक्तस्य दीनस्य निर्दोषस्य विशेषतः .. 22..
5.49.m:
The king said:
Even so, O brahmin, grant as desired an end to the curse / for me, who am full of devotion, wretched, and especially innocent.

5.49.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
yadā te naṃdinī dhenurliṃgaṃ bāṇārcitaṃ purā ..
darśayiṣyati te muktistadā tūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 23 ..
5.49.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
यदा ते नंदिनी धेनुर्लिंगं बाणार्चितं पुरा ..
दर्शयिष्यति ते मुक्तिस्तदा तूर्णं भविष्यति .. 23 ..
5.49.m:
Durvāsas said:
When the cow Nandinī shall show you the liṅga / worshiped of old by Bāṇa, then your liberation will quickly take place.

5.49.s:
evamuktvā sa viprendro jagāma nijamāśramam ..
babhūva so'pi bhūpālo vyāghro raudratamākṛtiḥ .. 24 ..
5.49.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स विप्रेन्द्रो जगाम निजमाश्रमम् ..
बभूव सोऽपि भूपालो व्याघ्रो रौद्रतमाकृतिः .. 24 ..
5.49.m: Having spoken thus, that best of brahmins went to his own hermitage; / and that protector of the earth became a tiger of most ferocious appearance.

5.49.s:
naṣṭasmṛtistatastūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā jaṃtūnpuraḥsthitān ..
jaghānoccāṭitonyaiśca praviveśa mahāvanam .. 25 ..
5.49.d:
नष्टस्मृतिस्ततस्तूर्णं दृष्ट्वा जंतून्पुरःस्थितान् ..
जघानोच्चाटितोन्यैश्च प्रविवेश महावनम् .. 25 ..
5.49.m: His memory immediately lost, seeing living beings standing before him, / he killed them, and, driven away by others, he entered the great forest.

5.49.s:
atha te maṃtriṇastasya śāpasyātaṃ mahīpateḥ ..
vāṃchatastasya tadrājyaṃ cakrureva surakṣitam .. 26 ..
5.49.d:
अथ ते मंत्रिणस्तस्य शापस्यातं महीपतेः ..
वांछतस्तस्य तद्राज्यं चक्रुरेव सुरक्षितम् .. 26 ..
5.49.m: Then his ministers, desiring the end of the king's curse, / indeed kept that kingdom of his well protected.

5.49.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kalaśeśvarākhyāne kalaśanṛpaterdurvāsasaḥ śāpena vyāghratvaprāptivarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 49 .. .. ..
5.49.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कलशेश्वराख्याने कलशनृपतेर्दुर्वाससः शापेन व्याघ्रत्वप्राप्तिवर्णनंनामैकोनपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 49 .. .. ..
5.49.m: Thus ends the forty-ninth chapter, entitled "The Description of King Kalaśa's Attainment of Tiger-hood through the Curse of Durvāsas," in the account of Kalaśeśvara, in the Māhātmya of the Holy Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part], in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.50.s:
evaṃ tasya narendrasya vyāghrarūpasya kānane ..
jagāma sumahānkālo nighnato vividhāndvija .. 1 ..
5.50.d:
एवं तस्य नरेन्द्रस्य व्याघ्ररूपस्य कानने ..
जगाम सुमहान्कालो निघ्नतो विविधान्द्विज .. 1 ..
5.50.m: Thus, O twice-born, a very great period of time passed for that lord of men in the form of a tiger in the forest, slaying various [beings].

5.50.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya tasmindeśe dvijottamāḥ ..
ā yātaṃ gokulaṃ ramyaṃ gopagopīsamākulam .. 2 ..
5.50.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य तस्मिन्देशे द्विजोत्तमाः ..
आ यातं गोकुलं रम्यं गोपगोपीसमाकुलम् .. 2 ..
5.50.m: Then, at a certain time, O best of the twice-born, a delightful herd of cattle, thronged with cowherds and cowherdesses, arrived in that region.

5.50.s:
tatrāsti nandinīnāma dhenuḥ pīnapayodharā ..
vistīrṇajaghanābhogā haṃsavarṇā ghaṭasravā .. 3 ..
5.50.d:
तत्रास्ति नन्दिनीनाम धेनुः पीनपयोधरा ..
विस्तीर्णजघनाभोगा हंसवर्णा घटस्रवा .. 3 ..
5.50.m: There was a cow there named Nandinī, with swelling udders, / broad expansive hips, the color of a swan, shedding milk like a jar.

5.50.s:
atha sā nijayūthasya sadāgre tṛṇavāṃchayā ..
bhramamāṇā nikuñjāṃte liṃgaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ .. 4 ..
5.50.d:
अथ सा निजयूथस्य सदाग्रे तृणवांछया ..
भ्रममाणा निकुञ्जांते लिंगं देवस्य शूलिनः .. 4 ..
5.50.m: Now, wandering always ahead of her herd in desire for grass, / she [saw] at the edge of an arbor the liṅga of the trident-bearing god;

5.50.s:
apaśyattejasā yuktaṃ svayameva vyavasthitam ..
dvādaśārkapratīkāśaṃ cittāhlādakaraṃ param .. 5 ..
5.50.d:
अपश्यत्तेजसा युक्तं स्वयमेव व्यवस्थितम् ..
द्वादशार्कप्रतीकाशं चित्ताह्लादकरं परम् .. 5 ..
5.50.m: she saw it endowed with brilliance, abiding of its own accord, / resembling twelve suns, supremely gladdening to the heart.

5.50.s:
tatastasyopari sthitvā susrāva sumahatpayaḥ ..
śraddhayā parayā yuktā tasya snānakṛte dvijāḥ .. 6 ..
5.50.d:
ततस्तस्योपरि स्थित्वा सुस्राव सुमहत्पयः ..
श्रद्धया परया युक्ता तस्य स्नानकृते द्विजाः .. 6 ..
5.50.m: Then, standing above it, endowed with supreme faith, / she poured forth abundant milk for his ceremonial bath, O twice-born.

5.50.s:
evaṃ tāṃ snapanaṃ tasya sadā liṃgasya kurvatīm ..
na jānāti janaḥ kaścidvane vṛkṣasamākule .. 7 ..
5.50.d:
एवं तां स्नपनं तस्य सदा लिंगस्य कुर्वतीम् ..
न जानाति जनः कश्चिद्वने वृक्षसमाकुले .. 7 ..
5.50.m: As she thus constantly performed the ceremonial bath of that liṅga / in the forest crowded with trees, no person knew of it.

5.50.s:
anyasmindivase tatra sthāne vyāghraḥ samāgataḥ ..
tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro mahākāyaḥ sarvajantubhayāvahaḥ .. 8 ..
5.50.d:
अन्यस्मिन्दिवसे तत्र स्थाने व्याघ्रः समागतः ..
तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रो महाकायः सर्वजन्तुभयावहः .. 8 ..
5.50.m: On another day, a tiger arrived at that place, / sharp-fanged, huge-bodied, terrifying to all creatures.

5.50.s:
atha sā tatra āyātā patitā dṛṣṭigocare ..
nandinī dvīpinastasya daivayogāddvijottamāḥ .. 9 ..
5.50.d:
अथ सा तत्र आयाता पतिता दृष्टिगोचरे ..
नन्दिनी द्वीपिनस्तस्य दैवयोगाद्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 9 ..
5.50.m: Then, having arrived there, Nandinī fell within the range of vision / of that tiger, O best of the twice-born, by the decree of fate.

5.50.s:
tataḥ sā gokule baddhaṃ smṛtvā svaṃ laghuvatsakam ..
atṛṇādaṃ payovṛttiṃ karuṇaṃ paryadevayat .. 6.50.10 ..
5.50.d:
ततः सा गोकुले बद्धं स्मृत्वा स्वं लघुवत्सकम् ..
अतृणादं पयोवृत्तिं करुणं पर्यदेवयत् .. 6.50.10 ..
5.50.m: Then, remembering her little calf bound in the herd of cattle, / one that did not eat grass and lived on milk alone, she lamented piteously:

5.50.s:
adyaikāhaṃ ca saṃprāptā kānane janavarjite ..
putraṃ bālaṃ parityajya gopairgoṣṭhe niyaṃtritam .. 11 ..
5.50.d:
अद्यैकाहं च संप्राप्ता कानने जनवर्जिते ..
पुत्रं बालं परित्यज्य गोपैर्गोष्ठे नियंत्रितम् .. 11 ..
5.50.m: "Today I have come alone into a forest devoid of people, / abandoning my young child held fast by cowherds in the pen.

5.50.s:
yena satyena bhaktyādya snapanāyāhamāgatā ..
śivasya tena satyena bhūyānme sutasaṃgamaḥ .. 12 ..
5.50.d:
येन सत्येन भक्त्याद्य स्नपनायाहमागता ..
शिवस्य तेन सत्येन भूयान्मे सुतसंगमः .. 12 ..
5.50.m: By the truth through which I have come today with devotion for the ceremonial bath / of Śiva, by that truth may there be reunion with my son!"

5.50.s:
evaṃ sā karuṇaṃ yāvannandinī vilapatyalam..
tāvadvyāghraḥ smitaṃ kṛtvā provāca paruṣākṣaram .. 13 ..
5.50.d:
एवं सा करुणं यावन्नन्दिनी विलपत्यलम्..
तावद्व्याघ्रः स्मितं कृत्वा प्रोवाच परुषाक्षरम् .. 13 ..
5.50.m: While Nandinī was thus lamenting piteously and exceedingly, / the tiger smiled and spoke harsh words:

5.50.s:
.. vyāghra uvāca .. ..
pralāpānkiṃ mudhā dheno karoṣi vaśagā mama ..
tasmādiṣṭatamaṃ devaṃ smara svargakṛte śubhe .. 14 ..
5.50.d:
.. व्याघ्र उवाच .. ..
प्रलापान्किं मुधा धेनो करोषि वशगा मम ..
तस्मादिष्टतमं देवं स्मर स्वर्गकृते शुभे .. 14 ..
5.50.m: The tiger said: / "Why do you make lamentations in vain, O cow, when you have fallen into my power? / Therefore, remember your most cherished deity for the sake of heaven, O auspicious one!"

5.50.s:
.. dhenuruvāca .. ..
nāhamātmakṛte vyāghra vilapāmi suduḥ khitā ..
śivārcanakṛte mṛtyurmama jātaḥ śubhāvahaḥ .. 15 ..
5.50.d:
.. धेनुरुवाच .. ..
नाहमात्मकृते व्याघ्र विलपामि सुदुः खिता ..
शिवार्चनकृते मृत्युर्मम जातः शुभावहः .. 15 ..
5.50.m: The cow said: / "I do not lament for my own sake, O tiger, exceedingly distressed; / for the sake of worshiping Śiva, death has become auspicious for me.

5.50.s:
vatso me gokule baddhaḥ smaramāṇo mamāgamam ..
santiṣṭhate payovṛttiḥ kathaṃ syātsa mayā vinā .. 16 ..
5.50.d:
वत्सो मे गोकुले बद्धः स्मरमाणो ममागमम् ..
सन्तिष्ठते पयोवृत्तिः कथं स्यात्स मया विना .. 16 ..
5.50.m: My calf is tied in the herd of cattle, remembering my arrival; / he subsists on milk; how could he exist without me?

5.50.s:
etasmātkāraṇādvyāghra vilapāmi suduḥkhitā ..
na cātmajīvanārthāya satyenātmānamālabhe .. 17 ..
5.50.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्व्याघ्र विलपामि सुदुःखिता ..
न चात्मजीवनार्थाय सत्येनात्मानमालभे .. 17 ..
5.50.m: For this reason, O tiger, I lament exceedingly distressed, / and not for the sake of saving my own life; I swear by truth!

5.50.s:
tasmānmuṃca mahāvyāghra māṃ sadyaḥ sutavatsalām ..
sakhījanasya taṃ dattvā samāgacchāmi teṃtikam .. 18 ..
5.50.d:
तस्मान्मुंच महाव्याघ्र मां सद्यः सुतवत्सलाम् ..
सखीजनस्य तं दत्त्वा समागच्छामि तेंतिकम् .. 18 ..
5.50.m: Therefore, O great tiger, release me at once, fond of my son; / having entrusted him to my companions, I will return to your presence."

5.50.s:
.. vyāghra uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ mṛtyumukhaṃ prāpya niṣkramya ca kathañcana ..
bhūyastatraiva niryāsi tasmāttvāṃ bhakṣayāmyaham .. 19 ..
5.50.d:
.. व्याघ्र उवाच .. ..
कथं मृत्युमुखं प्राप्य निष्क्रम्य च कथञ्चन ..
भूयस्तत्रैव निर्यासि तस्मात्त्वां भक्षयाम्यहम् .. 19 ..
5.50.m: The tiger said: / "Having reached the jaws of death and somehow escaped, / how would you go back there again? Therefore, I will devour you."

5.50.s:
.. nandinyuvāca .. ..
śapathairāgamiṣyāmi yaiḥ punarvyāghra teṃ'tikam ..
tānākarṇaya me vaktrāttato yuktaṃ samācara .. 6.50.20 ..
5.50.d:
.. नन्दिन्युवाच .. ..
शपथैरागमिष्यामि यैः पुनर्व्याघ्र तेंऽतिकम् ..
तानाकर्णय मे वक्त्रात्ततो युक्तं समाचर .. 6.50.20 ..
5.50.m: Nandinī said: / "With the oaths by which I will come again to your presence, O tiger— / listen to them from my mouth, and then do what is proper!

5.50.s:
yatpāpaṃ brahmahatyāyāṃ mātāpitrośca vaṃcane ..
tena pāpena lipyehaṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi .. 21 ..
5.50.d:
यत्पापं ब्रह्महत्यायां मातापित्रोश्च वंचने ..
तेन पापेन लिप्येहं नागच्छामि पुनर्यदि .. 21 ..
5.50.m: Whatever sin is in the slaying of a brahmin and in deceiving one's mother and father, / may I be smeared with that sin if I do not return!

5.50.s:
vivastraṃ snānasaktānāṃ divāmaithunagāminām ..
yatpāpaṃ tena lipye'haṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi .. 22 ..
5.50.d:
विवस्त्रं स्नानसक्तानां दिवामैथुनगामिनाम् ..
यत्पापं तेन लिप्येऽहं नागच्छामि पुनर्यदि .. 22 ..
5.50.m: Whatever sin belongs to those intent on bathing unclothed, or engaging in intercourse by day, / may I be smeared with that sin if I do not return!

5.50.s:
rajasvalānusaktānāṃ yatpāpaṃ nagnaśāyinām ..
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi .. 23 ..
5.50.d:
रजस्वलानुसक्तानां यत्पापं नग्नशायिनाम् ..
तेन पापेन लिप्येऽहं नागच्छामि पुनर्यदि .. 23 ..
5.50.m: Whatever sin belongs to those who cohabit with a menstruating woman, or sleep naked, / may I be smeared with that sin if I do not return!

5.50.s:
viśvāsaghātakānāṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ ca yadbhavet ..
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi .. .. 24 ..
5.50.d:
विश्वासघातकानां च कृतघ्नानां च यद्भवेत् ..
तेन पापेन लिप्येऽहं नागच्छामि पुनर्यदि .. .. 24 ..
5.50.m: Whatever sin belongs to betrayers of trust and to the ungrateful, / may I be smeared with that sin if I do not return!

5.50.s:
gokanyābrāhmaṇānāṃ ca dūṣakānāṃ ca yadbhavet ..
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi .. 25 ..
5.50.d:
गोकन्याब्राह्मणानां च दूषकानां च यद्भवेत् ..
तेन पापेन लिप्येऽहं नागच्छामि पुनर्यदि .. 25 ..
