satīviyogayuktena bhrūṇatvaṃ pragatena ca .. 89 ..
5.53.d:
लज्जितेन स्ववासार्थं महद्दुःखयुतेन च ..
सतीवियोगयुक्तेन भ्रूणत्वं प्रगतेन च .. 89 ..
5.53.m: ashamed, for the sake of his dwelling, filled with great sorrow, / separated from Satī, and reduced to the state of an embryo.

5.53.s:
sarvapāpaharā tena garteyaṃ pṛthi vīpate ..
bhrūṇagarteti vikhyātā tasya nāmā jagattraye .. 6.53.90 ..
5.53.d:
सर्वपापहरा तेन गर्तेयं पृथि वीपते ..
भ्रूणगर्तेति विख्याता तस्य नामा जगत्त्रये .. 6.53.90 ..
5.53.m: Therefore, this pit destroys all sins, O lord of the earth; / it is renowned throughout the three worlds by his name as Bhrūṇagartā."

5.53.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktvātha sā vāṇī virarāmāṃ'tarikṣagā ..
so'pi pārthivaśārdūlaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ svapuraṃ yayau .. 91 ..
5.53.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वाथ सा वाणी विररामांऽतरिक्षगा ..
सोऽपि पार्थिवशार्दूलः प्रहृष्टः स्वपुरं ययौ .. 91 ..
5.53.m: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, that voice traversing the sky fell silent; / and that tiger among kings, delighted, went to his own city.

5.53.s:
tatastaṃ pāpanirmuktaṃ tejasā bhāskaropamam ..
dṛṣṭvā putrāstathā martyāḥ praṇemustuṣṭisaṃyutāḥ .. 92 ..
5.53.d:
ततस्तं पापनिर्मुक्तं तेजसा भास्करोपमम् ..
दृष्ट्वा पुत्रास्तथा मर्त्याः प्रणेमुस्तुष्टिसंयुताः .. 92 ..
5.53.m: Then, seeing him freed from sin, resembling the sun in radiance, / his sons and people bowed down with satisfaction.

5.53.s:
so'pi brāhmaṇaśārdūlo vasiṣṭhastaṃ mahīpatim..
samabhyetya tataḥ prāha harṣagadgadayā girā .. 93 ..
5.53.d:
सोऽपि ब्राह्मणशार्दूलो वसिष्ठस्तं महीपतिम्..
समभ्येत्य ततः प्राह हर्षगद्गदया गिरा .. 93 ..
5.53.m: And Vasiṣṭha, that tiger among brahmins, approached that king / and then spoke in a voice faltering with joy:

5.53.s:
diṣṭyā muktosi rājeṃdra pāpādbrahmavadhodbhavāt ..
diṣṭyā tvaṃ tejasā yuktaḥ punaḥ prāpto nijaṃ puram .. 94 ..
5.53.d:
दिष्ट्या मुक्तोसि राजेंद्र पापाद्ब्रह्मवधोद्भवात् ..
दिष्ट्या त्वं तेजसा युक्तः पुनः प्राप्तो निजं पुरम् .. 94 ..
5.53.m: "By good fortune, O king of kings, you are released from the sin arising from killing a brahmin! / By good fortune, endowed with splendor, you have reached your own city once more! 94

5.53.s:
tasmātkīrtaya bhūpāla kasmiṃstīrthe samāgataḥ ..
tvaṃ muktaḥ pātakādghorādbrahmahatyāsamudbhavāt .. 95 ..
5.53.d:
तस्मात्कीर्तय भूपाल कस्मिंस्तीर्थे समागतः ..
त्वं मुक्तः पातकाद्घोराद्ब्रह्महत्यासमुद्भवात् .. 95 ..
5.53.m: Therefore, O protector of the earth, tell [us]: at which sacred ford did you arrive, / [and how] were you freed from the terrible sin born of killing a brahmin?" 95

5.53.s:
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa bhrūṇagartāsamudbhavam ..
vṛttāṃtaṃ tasya viprarṣeranubhūtaṃ yathā tathā .. 96 ..
5.53.d:
ततः स कथयामास भ्रूणगर्तासमुद्भवम् ..
वृत्तांतं तस्य विप्रर्षेरनुभूतं यथा तथा .. 96 ..
5.53.m: Then he narrated to that brahmin seer the event that had taken place / at Bhrūṇagartā, exactly as it had been experienced. 96

5.53.s:
tataste maṃtriṇo vṛddhāḥ sa ca rājā munīśvaraḥ ..
putraṃ pratardanaṃnāma rājye saṃsthāpya tatkṣaṇāt .. 97 ..
5.53.d:
ततस्ते मंत्रिणो वृद्धाः स च राजा मुनीश्वरः ..
पुत्रं प्रतर्दनंनाम राज्ये संस्थाप्य तत्क्षणात् .. 97 ..
5.53.m: Then those aged ministers, along with that king, the lord of sages, / having installed his son named Pratardana upon the throne that very moment, 97

5.53.s:
bhrūṇagartāṃ samāsādya tāmeva dvijasattamāḥ ..
tapaścerurmahādevaṃ dhyāyamānā divā niśam .. 98..
5.53.d:
भ्रूणगर्तां समासाद्य तामेव द्विजसत्तमाः ..
तपश्चेरुर्महादेवं ध्यायमाना दिवा निशम् .. 98..
5.53.m: and having reached that very Bhrūṇagartā, O best of the twice-born, / performed austerity, meditating on Mahādeva day and night. 98

5.53.s:
gatāśca paramāṃ siddhiṃ kālenālpena durlabhām ..
bhrūṇarūpadharaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā maheśvaram .. 99 ..
5.53.d:
गताश्च परमां सिद्धिं कालेनाल्पेन दुर्लभाम् ..
भ्रूणरूपधरं देवं पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् .. 99 ..
5.53.m: And in a short time they attained the supreme, rarely obtained perfection, / having worshipped the great lord, the god who assumes the form of an embryo. 99

5.53.s:
tataḥprabhṛti sā gartā prakhyātā dharaṇītale ..
bhrūṇagarteti vipreṃdrāḥ sarvapātakanāśinī .. 6.53.100 ..
5.53.d:
ततःप्रभृति सा गर्ता प्रख्याता धरणीतले ..
भ्रूणगर्तेति विप्रेंद्राः सर्वपातकनाशिनी .. 6.53.100 ..
5.53.m: From that time forward, that pit has been renowned upon the earth / as Bhrūṇagartā, O lords of brahmins, destroying all sins. 100

5.53.s:
tatra kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
sa pitṝṃstārayennūnaṃ daśa pūrvāndaśā parān.. 101 ..
5.53.d:
तत्र कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां यः श्राद्धं कुरुते नरः ..
स पितॄंस्तारयेन्नूनं दश पूर्वान्दशा परान्.. 101 ..
5.53.m: The man who performs a śrāddha there on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / surely delivers his ancestors: ten preceding and ten following. 101

5.53.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra śrāddhaṃ samācaret ..
snānaṃ ca brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā dānaṃ vāpi svaśaktitaḥ .. 102 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bhrūṇagartāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 53 .. ..
5.53.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र श्राद्धं समाचरेत् ..
स्नानं च ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठा दानं वापि स्वशक्तितः .. 102 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भ्रूणगर्तामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 53 .. ..
5.53.m:
Therefore, with every effort one should perform a śrāddha there, / as well as ritual ablution, O best of brahmins, or give gifts according to one's means. 102
Thus ends the fifty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Bhrūṇagartā,' in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 53

5.54.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
carmamuṃḍā tathā devī tasminsthāne vyavasthitā ..
nalena sthāpitā pūrvaṃ svayameva mahātmanā .. 1 ..
5.54.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
चर्ममुंडा तथा देवी तस्मिन्स्थाने व्यवस्थिता ..
नलेन स्थापिता पूर्वं स्वयमेव महात्मना .. 1 ..
5.54.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, the goddess Carmamuṇḍā is situated in that place, / established of old by the great-souled Nala himself. 1

5.54.s:
abhyarcayati tāṃ bhaktyā yo mahānavamī dine ..
sa kāmānvāṃchitām̐llabdhvā padaṃ prāpnoti śāśvatam .. 2 ..
5.54.d:
अभ्यर्चयति तां भक्त्या यो महानवमी दिने ..
स कामान्वांछिताम्̐ल्लब्ध्वा पदं प्राप्नोति शाश्वतम् .. 2 ..
5.54.m: Whoever worships her with devotion on the day of the Mahānavamī, / obtains his desired wishes and attains the eternal abode. 2

5.54.s:
vīrasenasutaḥ pūrvaṃ nalonāma mahīpatiḥ ..
āsītsarvaguṇopetaḥ sarva śatrukṣayāvahaḥ .. 3 ..
5.54.d:
वीरसेनसुतः पूर्वं नलोनाम महीपतिः ..
आसीत्सर्वगुणोपेतः सर्व शत्रुक्षयावहः .. 3 ..
5.54.m: Formerly, the king named Nala was the son of Vīrasena; / he was endowed with all virtues and brought about the destruction of all enemies. 3

5.54.s:
bhāryā tasyābhavatsādhvī prāṇebhyopi garīyasī ..
damayaṃtīti vikhyātā vidarbhādhipateḥ sutā .. 4 ..
5.54.d:
भार्या तस्याभवत्साध्वी प्राणेभ्योपि गरीयसी ..
दमयंतीति विख्याता विदर्भाधिपतेः सुता .. 4 ..
5.54.m: His virtuous wife was dearer to him than his own life-breaths, / renowned as Damayantī, the daughter of the ruler of Vidarbha. 4

5.54.s:
athāsau kalināviṣṭo dyūtaṃ cakre mahīpatiḥ ..
puṣkareṇa samaṃ viprā dāyādena divāniśam .. 5 ..
5.54.d:
अथासौ कलिनाविष्टो द्यूतं चक्रे महीपतिः ..
पुष्करेण समं विप्रा दायादेन दिवानिशम् .. 5 ..
5.54.m: Then, possessed by Kali, that king played dice / day and night, O brahmins, with Puṣkara, his kinsman. 5

5.54.s:
tataḥ sa vyasanāsakto vāryamāṇo'pi sajjanaiḥ ..
hārayāmāsa saptāṃgaṃ rājyaṃ muktvā ca tāṃ priyām .. 6 ..
5.54.d:
ततः स व्यसनासक्तो वार्यमाणोऽपि सज्जनैः ..
हारयामास सप्तांगं राज्यं मुक्त्वा च तां प्रियाम् .. 6 ..
5.54.m: Then he, addicted to that vice, though restrained by virtuous people, / lost his seven-limbed kingdom, leaving aside only that beloved [wife]. 6

5.54.s:
atha tāṃ sa samādāya praviṣṭo gahanaṃ vanam ..
nirjalaṃ lajjayāviṣṭo duḥkhavyākuliteṃdriyaḥ .. 7 ..
5.54.d:
अथ तां स समादाय प्रविष्टो गहनं वनम् ..
निर्जलं लज्जयाविष्टो दुःखव्याकुलितेंद्रियः .. 7 ..
5.54.m: Then, taking her with him, he entered the dense forest, / devoid of water, overcome with shame, his senses agitated with sorrow. 7

5.54.s:
tataḥ sa ciṃtayāmāsa yadyeṣā bhīmamaṃdire ..
yāti tanmucyate kaṣṭādvanavāsasamudbhavāt .. 8 ..
5.54.d:
ततः स चिंतयामास यद्येषा भीममंदिरे ..
याति तन्मुच्यते कष्टाद्वनवाससमुद्भवात् .. 8 ..
5.54.m: Then he thought: "If she goes to the palace of Bhīma, / then she will be freed from the misery arising from forest dwelling. 8

5.54.s:
na mayā tatra gaṃtavyaṃ kathaṃcidapi māninā ..
tasmādenāṃ parityajya rātrau gacchāmi dūrataḥ .. 9 ..
5.54.d:
न मया तत्र गंतव्यं कथंचिदपि मानिना ..
तस्मादेनां परित्यज्य रात्रौ गच्छामि दूरतः .. 9 ..
5.54.m: Proud as I am, under no circumstances must I go there. / Therefore, abandoning her at night, I shall depart far away, 9

5.54.s:
yena tyaktā mayā sādhvī kuṇḍinaṃ yāti tatpuram ..
sa evaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā sukhasuptāṃ vihāya tām ..
prajagāma vanaṃ ghoraṃ vanyaśvāpadasaṃkulam.. 6.54.10 ..
5.54.d:
येन त्यक्ता मया साध्वी कुण्डिनं याति तत्पुरम् ..
स एवं निश्चयं कृत्वा सुखसुप्तां विहाय ताम् ..
प्रजगाम वनं घोरं वन्यश्वापदसंकुलम्.. 6.54.10 ..
5.54.m: so that, abandoned by me, the virtuous lady may go to that city of Kuṇḍina." / Having made this resolve, leaving her asleep in comfort, / he departed into the terrible forest filled with wild beasts. 10

5.54.s:
pratyūṣe cāpi sotthāya yāvatpaśyati bhābhinī ..
tāvatpaśyatiśūnyaṃ svaṃ pārśvaṃ yatra nalaḥ sthitaḥ .. 11 ..
5.54.d:
प्रत्यूषे चापि सोत्थाय यावत्पश्यति भाभिनी ..
तावत्पश्यतिशून्यं स्वं पार्श्वं यत्र नलः स्थितः .. 11 ..
5.54.m: And at dawn, rising up, as soon as the beautiful woman looked, / she saw her own side empty, where Nala had been resting. 11

5.54.s:
tato vilapya duḥkhārtā karuṇaṃ tatra kānane ..
jagāma mārgamāśrittha piturharmyaṃ śanaiḥśanaiḥ .. 12 ..
5.54.d:
ततो विलप्य दुःखार्ता करुणं तत्र कानने ..
जगाम मार्गमाश्रित्थ पितुर्हर्म्यं शनैःशनैः .. 12 ..
5.54.m: Then, weeping piteously in that forest, afflicted with grief, / she took the path and went slowly toward the mansion of her father. 12

5.54.s:
nalo'pi ca vane tasminbhramamāṇo mahīpatiḥ ..
ekākī vṛkṣakuṃjāni sevayāmāsa sarvadā .. 13 ..
5.54.d:
नलोऽपि च वने तस्मिन्भ्रममाणो महीपतिः ..
एकाकी वृक्षकुंजानि सेवयामास सर्वदा .. 13 ..
5.54.m: Nala too, the king wandering in that forest, / solitary, always resorted to thickets of trees. 13

5.54.s:
tatastadvanamutsṛjya jagāmānyanmahāvanam ..
nānāvṛkṣagaṇairyuktaṃ bahuśvāpadasaṃkulam .. 14 ..
5.54.d:
ततस्तद्वनमुत्सृज्य जगामान्यन्महावनम् ..
नानावृक्षगणैर्युक्तं बहुश्वापदसंकुलम् .. 14 ..
5.54.m: Then, leaving that forest, he went to another great forest, / endowed with many varieties of trees and teeming with numerous wild beasts. 14

5.54.s:
evaṃ sa pṛthivīpālo bhramamāṇovanādvanam ..
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetramāsasāda tataḥ param .. 15 ..
5.54.d:
एवं स पृथिवीपालो भ्रममाणोवनाद्वनम् ..
हाटकेश्वरजं क्षेत्रमाससाद ततः परम् .. 15 ..
5.54.m: Thus, that protector of the earth, wandering from forest to forest, / thereupon reached the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara. 15

5.54.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptaṃ tanmahānavamīdinam ..
viśeṣādyatra bhūpālāḥ pūjayanti sureśvarīm .. 16 ..
5.54.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तं तन्महानवमीदिनम् ..
विशेषाद्यत्र भूपालाः पूजयन्ति सुरेश्वरीम् .. 16 ..
5.54.m: In the meantime, that day of the Mahānavamī arrived, / on which kings especially worship the sovereign goddess of the gods. 16

5.54.s:
tataḥ sa mṛnmayīṃ kṛtvā carmamuṇḍadharāṃ nṛpaḥ ..
vibhavābhāvataḥ paścātphalamūlairatarpayat .. 17 ..
5.54.d:
ततः स मृन्मयीं कृत्वा चर्ममुण्डधरां नृपः ..
विभवाभावतः पश्चात्फलमूलैरतर्पयत् .. 17 ..
5.54.m: Then the king, having fashioned an earthen [image] bearing Carmamuṇḍā, / afterwards gratified her with fruits and roots due to the absence of wealth. 17

5.54.s:
tatastasyāḥ stutiṃ kṛtvā puraḥ sthitvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
śraddhayā parayā yukto niṣadhādhipatiḥ svayam .. 18 ..
5.54.d:
ततस्तस्याः स्तुतिं कृत्वा पुरः स्थित्वा कृतांजलिः ..
श्रद्धया परया युक्तो निषधाधिपतिः स्वयम् .. 18 ..
5.54.m: Then, having praised her and standing before her with folded hands, / the lord of Niṣadha himself, filled with supreme faith, [prayed]: 18

5.54.s:
jaya sarvagate devi carmamuṇḍadhare vare ..
jaya daityakulocchedadakṣe dakṣātmaje śubhe .. 19 ..
5.54.d:
जय सर्वगते देवि चर्ममुण्डधरे वरे ..
जय दैत्यकुलोच्छेददक्षे दक्षात्मजे शुभे .. 19 ..
5.54.m: "Victory to you, O all-pervading goddess, bearer of Carmamuṇḍā, O excellent one! / Victory to you, expert in annihilating the lineage of Daityas, O daughter of Dakṣa, O auspicious one! 19

5.54.s:
kālarātri jayācintye navamyaṣṭamivallabhe ..
trinetre tryaṃbakābhīṣṭe jaya devi surārcite.. .. 6.54.20 ..
5.54.d:
कालरात्रि जयाचिन्त्ये नवम्यष्टमिवल्लभे ..
त्रिनेत्रे त्र्यंबकाभीष्टे जय देवि सुरार्चिते.. .. 6.54.20 ..
5.54.m: O Kālarātri, victory to you, O inconceivable one, beloved of the eighth and ninth lunar days! / O three-eyed one, dear to Tryambaka, victory to you, O goddess worshipped by the gods! 20

5.54.s:
bhīmarūpe surūpe ca mahāvidye mahābale ..
mahodaye mahākāye jayadevi mahāvrate .. 21 ..
5.54.d:
भीमरूपे सुरूपे च महाविद्ये महाबले ..
महोदये महाकाये जयदेवि महाव्रते .. 21 ..
5.54.m: O you of terrible form, and of lovely form, of great wisdom, of great might, / of great elevation, of massive body! Victory to you, O goddess of great vows! 21

5.54.s:
nityarūpe jagaddhātri surāmāṃsavasāpriye ..
vikarāli mahākāli jaya pretajanānuge .. 22 ..
5.54.d:
नित्यरूपे जगद्धात्रि सुरामांसवसाप्रिये ..
विकरालि महाकालि जय प्रेतजनानुगे .. 22 ..
5.54.m: O eternal form, support of the universe, fond of liquor, flesh, and fat! / O terribly dreadful one, Mahākālī, victory to you, followed by hosts of spirits! 22

5.54.s:
śavayānarate ramye bhujaṃgābharaṇānvite ..
pāśahaste mahāhaste rudhiraughakṛtāspade .. 23 ..
5.54.d:
शवयानरते रम्ये भुजंगाभरणान्विते ..
पाशहस्ते महाहस्ते रुधिरौघकृतास्पदे .. 23 ..
5.54.m: O you who delight in a vehicle of corpses, charming one, adorned with serpent ornaments, / with noose in hand, of great hands, having your abode in torrents of blood! 23

5.54.s:
phetkārā ravaśobhiṣṭhe gītavādyavirājite ..
jayānādye jaya dhyeye bhargadehārdhasaṃśraye .. 24 ..
5.54.d:
फेत्कारा रवशोभिष्ठे गीतवाद्यविराजिते ..
जयानाद्ये जय ध्येये भर्गदेहार्धसंश्रये .. 24 ..
5.54.m: O most radiant amid howls and cries, adorned with song and instruments! / Victory to you, beginningless one! Victory, O object of meditation, who take refuge in half of Bharga's body! 24

5.54.s:
tvaṃ ratistvaṃ dhṛtistuṣṭistvaṃ gaurī tvaṃ sureśvarī ..
tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ ca sāvitrī gāyatrī tvamasaṃśayam .. 25 ..
5.54.d:
त्वं रतिस्त्वं धृतिस्तुष्टिस्त्वं गौरी त्वं सुरेश्वरी ..
त्वं लक्ष्मीस्त्वं च सावित्री गायत्री त्वमसंशयम् .. 25 ..
5.54.m: You are Rati, you are Dhṛti, Tuṣṭi; you are Gaurī, you are the sovereign goddess of the gods; / you are Lakṣmī, you are Sāvitrī, and without doubt you are Gāyatrī. 25

5.54.s:
yatkiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu strīrūpaṃ devi dṛśyate ..
tatsarvaṃ tvanmayaṃ nātra vikalpo'sti mama kvacit .. 26 ..
5.54.d:
यत्किंचित्त्रिषु लोकेषु स्त्रीरूपं देवि दृश्यते ..
तत्सर्वं त्वन्मयं नात्र विकल्पोऽस्ति मम क्वचित् .. 26 ..
5.54.m: Whatever female form is seen in the three worlds, O goddess, / all that consists of you; herein I have no doubt anywhere. 26

5.54.s:
yena satyena tena tvamatrāvāsaṃ drutaṃ kuru ..
sānnidhyaṃ bhaktitastuṣṭā surāsuranamaskṛte .. 27 ..
5.54.d:
येन सत्येन तेन त्वमत्रावासं द्रुतं कुरु ..
सान्निध्यं भक्तितस्तुष्टा सुरासुरनमस्कृते .. 27 ..
5.54.m: By virtue of that truth, do make your dwelling here quickly; / pleased by my devotion, [grant] your presence, O goddess saluted by gods and demons!" 27

5.54.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ stutā ca sā devī nalena pṛthivībhujā ..
provāca darśanaṃ gatvā taṃ nṛpaṃ bhaktavatsalā .. 28 ..
5.54.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं स्तुता च सा देवी नलेन पृथिवीभुजा ..
प्रोवाच दर्शनं गत्वा तं नृपं भक्तवत्सला .. 28 ..
5.54.m: Sūta said: / Thus praised by Nala, the ruler of the earth, / that goddess, affectionate to her devotees, appeared to the king's sight and spoke. 28

5.54.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
parituṣṭā'smi te vatsa stotreṇānena sāṃpratam ..
tasmādgṛhāṇa mattastvaṃ varaṃ manasi saṃsthitam .. 29 ..
5.54.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
परितुष्टाऽस्मि ते वत्स स्तोत्रेणानेन सांप्रतम् ..
तस्माद्गृहाण मत्तस्त्वं वरं मनसि संस्थितम् .. 29 ..
5.54.m: The holy Goddess said: / "I am well pleased with you, child, now by this hymn of praise. / Therefore, accept from me the boon situated in your mind." 29

5.54.s:
.. nala uvāca .. ..
damayantīti me bhāryā prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī ..
sā mayā nirjane muktā
vane vyālagaṇānvite .. 6.54.30 ..
5.54.d:
.. नल उवाच .. ..
दमयन्तीति मे भार्या प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी ..
सा मया निर्जने मुक्ता
वने व्यालगणान्विते .. 6.54.30 ..
5.54.m: Nala said: / "My wife named Damayantī is dearer to me than my very life-breaths; / she was abandoned by me in the solitary forest filled with ferocious beasts. 30

5.54.s:
akhaṇḍaśīlāṃ nirdoṣāṃ yathāhaṃ tvatprasādataḥ ..
labhe bhūyo'pi tāṃ devi tathātra kuru satvaram .. 31 ..
5.54.d:
अखण्डशीलां निर्दोषां यथाहं त्वत्प्रसादतः ..
लभे भूयोऽपि तां देवि तथात्र कुरु सत्वरम् .. 31 ..
5.54.m: So act quickly here, O goddess, that through your grace / I may find her again, blameless and of unbroken chastity. 31

5.54.s:
stotreṇānena yo devi stutiṃ kuryātpurastava ..
tatraiva divase tasmai tvayā deyaṃ manogatam .. 32 ..
5.54.d:
स्तोत्रेणानेन यो देवि स्तुतिं कुर्यात्पुरस्तव ..
तत्रैव दिवसे तस्मै त्वया देयं मनोगतम् .. 32 ..
5.54.m: And whoever, O goddess, praises you before you with this hymn, / on that very day you should grant him his heart's desire." 32

5.54.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sā tatheti pratijñāya jagāmādarśanaṃ tataḥ ..
so'pi pārthivaśārdūlo lebhe sarvaṃ tayoditam .. 33 ..
5.54.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सा तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय जगामादर्शनं ततः ..
सोऽपि पार्थिवशार्दूलो लेभे सर्वं तयोदितम् .. 33 ..
5.54.m: Sūta said: / Having promised, saying, "So be it," she then vanished from sight. / That tiger among kings also obtained everything she had promised. (33)

5.54.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nalanirmitacarmamuṇḍāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 54 .. ..
5.54.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नलनिर्मितचर्ममुण्डामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुष्पञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 54 .. ..
5.54.m: Thus ends the fifty-fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Carmamuṇḍā installed by Nala,' in the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya of the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. (54)

5.55.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasyā eva samīpasthaṃ devadevaṃ naleśvaram ..
dṛṣṭvā vimucyute pāpātsthāpitaṃ nalabhūbhujā .. 1 ..
5.55.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्या एव समीपस्थं देवदेवं नलेश्वरम् ..
दृष्ट्वा विमुच्युते पापात्स्थापितं नलभूभुजा .. 1 ..
5.55.m: Sūta said: / By seeing Naleśvara, the god of gods, situated near her / and installed by King Nala, one is freed from sin. (1)

5.55.s:
yastaṃ paśyennaro bhaktyā māghe ṣaṣṭhyāṃ site dvijāḥ ..
sarva rogavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam .. 2 ..
5.55.d:
यस्तं पश्येन्नरो भक्त्या माघे षष्ठ्यां सिते द्विजाः ..
सर्व रोगविनिर्मुक्तः प्राप्नोति परमं पदम् .. 2 ..
5.55.m: The man who beholds him with devotion on the sixth [tithi] of the bright [fortnight] of Māgha, O brahmins, / freed from all diseases, attains the supreme abode. (2)

5.55.s:
kaṇḍūḥ pāmātha dadrūṇi maṃḍalāni vicarcikā ..
darśanāttasya naśyanti jantūnāṃ bhāvitātmanām .. 3..
5.55.d:
कण्डूः पामाथ दद्रूणि मंडलानि विचर्चिका ..
दर्शनात्तस्य नश्यन्ति जन्तूनां भावितात्मनाम् .. 3..
5.55.m: Itching, scabies, ringworm, circular blotches, and eczema / are destroyed for living beings of purified mind by the sight of him. (3)

5.55.s:
asti tasyāgrataḥ kuṇḍaṃ svacchodakasupūritam..
matsyakūrmasamākīrṇaṃ padminīkhaṃḍamaṃḍitam .. 4 ..
5.55.d:
अस्ति तस्याग्रतः कुण्डं स्वच्छोदकसुपूरितम्..
मत्स्यकूर्मसमाकीर्णं पद्मिनीखंडमंडितम् .. 4 ..
5.55.m: Before him there is a pool filled with clear water, / teeming with fish and tortoises, and adorned with clusters of lotuses. (4)

5.55.s:
yastatra kurute snānaṃ pratyūṣe somavāsare ..
api kuṣṭhāmayamastaḥ sa bhūyaḥ syātpunarnavaḥ .. 5 ..
5.55.d:
यस्तत्र कुरुते स्नानं प्रत्यूषे सोमवासरे ..
अपि कुष्ठामयमस्तः स भूयः स्यात्पुनर्नवः .. 5 ..
5.55.m: Whoever performs ritual ablution there at dawn on a Monday, / even if afflicted with the disease of leprosy, shall become renewed again. (5)

5.55.s:
yadā saṃsthāpitaḥ śaṃbhurnalena pṛthivībhujā ..
tadā tuṣṭena sa prokto brūhi kiṃ te karomyaham .. 6 .. ..
5.55.d:
यदा संस्थापितः शंभुर्नलेन पृथिवीभुजा ..
तदा तुष्टेन स प्रोक्तो ब्रूहि किं ते करोम्यहम् .. 6 .. ..
5.55.m: When Śambhu was installed by King Nala, / he was pleased and said to him: "Tell me, what shall I do for you?" (6)

5.55.s:
.. nala uvāca .. ..
atra stheyaṃ tvayā deva sadā sannihitena ca ..
sarvalokahitārthāya roganāśāya śaṃkara .. 7 ..
5.55.d:
.. नल उवाच .. ..
अत्र स्थेयं त्वया देव सदा सन्निहितेन च ..
सर्वलोकहितार्थाय रोगनाशाय शंकर .. 7 ..
5.55.m: Nala said: / "O God, you should always remain here, close at hand, / for the benefit of all the world and the destruction of disease, O Śaṃkara." (7)

5.55.s:
.. śaṃkara uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ tvadvacanādrājansaṃprāpte somavāsare ..
pratyūṣe ca nivatsyāmi prāsāde nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 8 ..
5.55.d:
.. शंकर उवाच .. ..
अहं त्वद्वचनाद्राजन्संप्राप्ते सोमवासरे ..
प्रत्यूषे च निवत्स्यामि प्रासादे नात्र संशयः .. 8 ..
5.55.m: Śaṃkara said: / "At your word, O King, when Monday arrives / and at dawn, I will abide in this temple; of this there is no doubt. (8)

5.55.s:
māghāṣṭamyāmahorātraṃ sakalaṃ ca mahīpate 0.
prāṇināṃ roganāśāya śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ .. 9 ..
5.55.d:
माघाष्टम्यामहोरात्रं सकलं च महीपते 0.
प्राणिनां रोगनाशाय शुक्लपक्षे विशेषतः .. 9 ..
5.55.m: On the eighth [tithi] of Māgha, for the entire day and night, O King, / and especially during the bright fortnight, for the destruction of disease in living beings. (9)

5.55.s:
yo māmatra sthitaṃ tatra divase vīkṣayiṣyati ..
snātvā suvimale kuṃḍe samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
tasya nāśaṃ prayāsyaṃti vyādhayo gātrasaṃbhavāḥ .. 6.55.10 ..
5.55.d:
यो मामत्र स्थितं तत्र दिवसे वीक्षयिष्यति ..
स्नात्वा सुविमले कुंडे सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
तस्य नाशं प्रयास्यंति व्याधयो गात्रसंभवाः .. 6.55.10 ..
5.55.m: Whoever beholds me staying here on that day, / having bathed in the exceedingly pure pool and endowed with true faith, / the diseases arising in his body will go to destruction. (10)

5.55.s:
yo'sya kuṃḍasya saṃbhūtāṃ mṛttikāmapi mānavaḥ ..
saṃdhāsyati nije dehe somavāre niśākṣaye ..
so'pi rogairvinirmuktaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati puṣṭimān .. 11 ..
5.55.d:
योऽस्य कुंडस्य संभूतां मृत्तिकामपि मानवः ..
संधास्यति निजे देहे सोमवारे निशाक्षये ..
सोऽपि रोगैर्विनिर्मुक्तः संभविष्यति पुष्टिमान् .. 11 ..
5.55.m: Whatever man applies even the mud produced from this pool / to his own body on a Monday at the end of the night, / he too, freed from diseases, shall become thriving. (11)

5.55.s:
niṣkāmastu punaryo māṃ tasminkāle nṛpottama ..
pūjayiṣyati sadbhaktyā puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto mama lokaṃ sa yāsyati .. 12 ..
5.55.d:
निष्कामस्तु पुनर्यो मां तस्मिन्काले नृपोत्तम ..
पूजयिष्यति सद्भक्त्या पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो मम लोकं स यास्यति .. 12 ..
5.55.m: Moreover, he who, free from desire, at that time, O best of kings, / worships me with true devotion using flowers, incense, and ointments, / freed from all sins, shall go to my world." (12)

5.55.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstrailokyadīpako haraḥ ..
antardhānaṃ gato viprā yathā dīpo'tra tatkṣaṇāt .. 13 ..
nalo'pi tuṣṭimāpannastamārādhya ciraṃ nṛpaḥ ..
tadāhūyākhilānviprāṃścamatkārapurodbhavān ...4..
5.55.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्त्रैलोक्यदीपको हरः ..
अन्तर्धानं गतो विप्रा यथा दीपोऽत्र तत्क्षणात् .. 13 ..
नलोऽपि तुष्टिमापन्नस्तमाराध्य चिरं नृपः ..
तदाहूयाखिलान्विप्रांश्चमत्कारपुरोद्भवान् ...4..
5.55.m:
Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, the Lord Hara, the illuminator of the three worlds, / disappeared instantly, O brahmins, just like a lamp. (13)
King Nala too, having worshipped him for a long time, attained satisfaction; / then, summoning all the brahmins born in Camatkārapura, [he said:] (14)

5.55.s:
eṣa saṃsthāpitaḥ śaṃbhurmayā yuṣmatpuroṃtike ..
yena dṛṣṭena rogāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥ .. 15 ..
5.55.d:
एष संस्थापितः शंभुर्मया युष्मत्पुरोंतिके ..
येन दृष्टेन रोगाणां सर्वेषां जायते क्षयः .. 15 ..
5.55.m: "This Śambhu has been installed by me near your city; / by beholding him, the destruction of all diseases comes to pass. (15)

5.55.s:
adhunāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi svarājyāya kṛte dvijāḥ ..
niṣadhāṃ ca purīmeṣa sarvaiḥ pūjyaḥ samāhitaiḥ .. 16 ..
5.55.d:
अधुनाहं गमिष्यामि स्वराज्याय कृते द्विजाः ..
निषधां च पुरीमेष सर्वैः पूज्यः समाहितैः .. 16 ..
5.55.m: Now I shall go to my own kingdom, the city of the Niṣadhas, O brahmins; / he should be worshipped by all with a collected mind." (16)

5.55.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
evaṃ pārthivaśārdūla kariṣyāmaḥ samāhitāḥ ..
tava devakṛte yatnaṃ yātrādyāsu kriyāsu ca .. 17 ..
5.55.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
एवं पार्थिवशार्दूल करिष्यामः समाहिताः ..
तव देवकृते यत्नं यात्राद्यासु क्रियासु च .. 17 ..
5.55.m: The brahmins said: / "O tiger among kings, we shall, with collected minds, / make effort on behalf of your deity and in the rituals of pilgrimage and the like. (17)

5.55.s:
tathā pūjāṃ kariṣyāmaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ ..
asmākaṃ putrapautrā ye bhaviṣyaṃti tathā pare ..
vaṃśajāste kariṣyaṃti pūjāmasya subhaktitaḥ .. 18 ..
5.55.d:
तथा पूजां करिष्यामः श्रद्धया परया युताः ..
अस्माकं पुत्रपौत्रा ये भविष्यंति तथा परे ..
वंशजास्ते करिष्यंति पूजामस्य सुभक्तितः .. 18 ..
5.55.m: Likewise, endowed with supreme faith, we will perform worship; / our sons, grandsons, and whatever other descendants / are born of our lineage will perform his worship with deep devotion." (18)

5.55.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktaḥ sa bhūpālastairvipraistuṣṭisaṃyutaḥ ..
pratasthe tānpraṇamyoccaiḥ sarvaistaiścābhinaṃditaḥ .. .. 19 ..
5.55.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तः स भूपालस्तैर्विप्रैस्तुष्टिसंयुतः ..
प्रतस्थे तान्प्रणम्योच्चैः सर्वैस्तैश्चाभिनंदितः .. .. 19 ..
5.55.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed by those brahmins, the king, filled with satisfaction, / bowed deeply to them and set out, applauded by all of them. (19)

5.55.s:
evaṃ sa bhagavāñchaṃbhustasminsthāne vyavasthitaḥ ..
hitāya sarvalokānāṃ sarvarogakṣayāvahaḥ .. 6.55.20 ..
5.55.d:
एवं स भगवाञ्छंभुस्तस्मिन्स्थाने व्यवस्थितः ..
हिताय सर्वलोकानां सर्वरोगक्षयावहः .. 6.55.20 ..
5.55.m: Thus the Lord Śambhu remained in that place, / bringing about the destruction of all diseases for the good of all the worlds. (20)

5.55.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena vīkṣaṇīyaḥ sadā hi saḥ ..
viśeṣātsomavāreṇa śāśvataṃ śreya icchatā .. 21 ..
5.55.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन वीक्षणीयः सदा हि सः ..
विशेषात्सोमवारेण शाश्वतं श्रेय इच्छता .. 21 ..
5.55.m: Therefore, by one desiring perpetual welfare, he is certainly to be beheld / with every effort at all times, especially on a Monday. (21)

5.55.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvara kṣetramāhātmye naleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 55 ..
5.55.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वर क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नलेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 55 ..
5.55.m: Thus ends the fifty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Naleśvara,' in the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya of the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. (55)

5.56.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasyāpi nātidūrasthaṃ sāṃbādityaṃ sureśvaram ..
dṛṣṭvā kāmānavāpnoti sarvānmartyo hṛdi sthitān.. 1 ..
5.56.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्यापि नातिदूरस्थं सांबादित्यं सुरेश्वरम् ..
दृष्ट्वा कामानवाप्नोति सर्वान्मर्त्यो हृदि स्थितान्.. 1 ..
5.56.m: Sūta said: / By seeing Sāmbāditya, the lord of gods, situated not very far from him, / a mortal obtains all the desires dwelling in his heart. (1)

5.56.s:
yastu māghasya śuklāyāṃ saptamyāṃ ravivāsare ..
bhaktyā saṃpaśyate martyo narakānna sa paśyati .. 2 ..
5.56.d:
यस्तु माघस्य शुक्लायां सप्तम्यां रविवासरे ..
भक्त्या संपश्यते मर्त्यो नरकान्न स पश्यति .. 2 ..
5.56.m: A mortal who beholds him with devotion on the seventh [tithi] of the bright [fortnight] of Māgha, / on a Sunday, does not see the hells. (2)

5.56.s:
āsītpūrvaṃ dvijo nāma gālavaḥ sa mahāmuniḥ ..
svādhyāyanirato nityaṃ vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ .. 3 ..
5.56.d:
आसीत्पूर्वं द्विजो नाम गालवः स महामुनिः ..
स्वाध्यायनिरतो नित्यं वेदवेदांगपारगः .. 3 ..
5.56.m: Formerly there was a brahmin named Gālava, a great sage, / constantly dedicated to Vedic study, who had crossed to the far shore of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas. (3)

5.56.s:
śucivrataparaḥ śāṃto devadvijaparāyaṇaḥ ..
kṛtajñaśca suśīlaśca yajñakarmavicakṣaṇaḥ .. 4 ..
5.56.d:
शुचिव्रतपरः शांतो देवद्विजपरायणः ..
कृतज्ञश्च सुशीलश्च यज्ञकर्मविचक्षणः .. 4 ..
5.56.m: Devoted to pure vows, tranquil, dedicated to the gods and brahmins, / grateful, of good conduct, and skilled in sacrificial rites. (4)

5.56.s:
tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya saṃprāptaṃ paścimaṃ vayaḥ ..
aputrasya dvijaśreṣṭhāstato duḥkhaṃ vyajāyata .. 5 ..
5.56.d:
तस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य संप्राप्तं पश्चिमं वयः ..
अपुत्रस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठास्ततो दुःखं व्यजायत .. 5 ..
5.56.m: As he was living thus, advanced age arrived / while he was sonless, O best of brahmins; therefore sorrow was born [in him]. (5)

5.56.s:
tataḥ sarvaṃ parityajya gṛhakṛtyaṃ sa bhaktimān ..
sūryamārādhayāmāsa kṣetre'traiva samāhitaḥ .. 6 ..
5.56.d:
ततः सर्वं परित्यज्य गृहकृत्यं स भक्तिमान् ..
सूर्यमाराधयामास क्षेत्रेऽत्रैव समाहितः .. 6 ..
5.56.m: Then, having abandoned all household duties, that devoted man, / with a concentrated mind, worshipped the sun right in this sacred field. (6)

5.56.s:
vaṭavṛkṣaṃ samāśritya śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ..
sthāpayitvā raverarcāṃ yathoktāṃ paṃcarātrike .. 7 ..
5.56.d:
वटवृक्षं समाश्रित्य श्रद्धया परया युतः ..
स्थापयित्वा रवेरर्चां यथोक्तां पंचरात्रिके .. 7 ..
5.56.m: Taking shelter of a banyan tree, endowed with supreme faith, / having installed an image of the Sun according to the rules stated in the Pāñcarātra, (7)

5.56.s:
varṣāsvākāśaśāyī ca hemaṃte jalasaṃśrayaḥ ..
paṃcāgnisādhako grīṣme nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ .. 8 ..
5.56.d:
वर्षास्वाकाशशायी च हेमंते जलसंश्रयः ..
पंचाग्निसाधको ग्रीष्मे निराहारो जितेन्द्रियः .. 8 ..
5.56.m: lying in the open air during the rains, dwelling in water in winter, / performing the five-fire penance in summer, without food, with senses subdued. (8)

5.56.s:
tataḥ paṃcadaśe varṣe saṃprāpte bhagavānraviḥ ..
vaṭavṛkṣaṃ samāśritya samīpasthamuvāca tam .. 9 ..
5.56.d:
ततः पंचदशे वर्षे संप्राप्ते भगवान्रविः ..
वटवृक्षं समाश्रित्य समीपस्थमुवाच तम् .. 9 ..
5.56.m: Then, when the fifteenth year arrived, the divine Sun, / taking shelter of the banyan tree, spoke to him who stood nearby: (9)

5.56.s:
.. śrīsūrya uvāca .. ..
varadosmyadya bhadraṃ te varaṃ prārthaya gālava ..
atidurlabhamapyāśu tava dāsyāmyasaṃśayam ..6.56.10..
5.56.d:
.. श्रीसूर्य उवाच .. ..
वरदोस्म्यद्य भद्रं ते वरं प्रार्थय गालव ..
अतिदुर्लभमप्याशु तव दास्याम्यसंशयम् ..6.56.10..
5.56.m: The glorious Sūrya said: / "I am a giver of boons today; hail to you! Request a boon, O Gālava. / Even if it is exceedingly difficult to obtain, I will give it to you quickly without doubt." (10)

5.56.s:
.. gālava uvāca .. ..
aputro'haṃ suraśreṣṭha paścime vayasi sthitaḥ ..
tasmāddehi sutaṃ mahyaṃ vaṃśavṛddhikaraṃ param .. 11 ..
.. śrīsūrya uvāca .. ..
vaṃśavṛddhikaro vipra putrastava bhaviṣyati ..
tejasvī ca yaśasvī ca śāstrajño veda pāragaḥ...2..
yeyaṃ tvayā kṛtā me'rcā sāṃbasūryasya saṃnidhau ..
sāṃbasūryābhidhāno'yaṃ bhaviṣyati dharātale...3..
anyo'pi śradrayopeto ya enaṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa yāvaddvādaśa bhāskarāḥ ...4..
5.56.d:
.. गालव उवाच .. ..
अपुत्रोऽहं सुरश्रेष्ठ पश्चिमे वयसि स्थितः ..
तस्माद्देहि सुतं मह्यं वंशवृद्धिकरं परम् .. 11 ..
.. श्रीसूर्य उवाच .. ..
वंशवृद्धिकरो विप्र पुत्रस्तव भविष्यति ..
तेजस्वी च यशस्वी च शास्त्रज्ञो वेद पारगः...2..
येयं त्वया कृता मेऽर्चा सांबसूर्यस्य संनिधौ ..
सांबसूर्याभिधानोऽयं भविष्यति धरातले...3..
अन्योऽपि श्रद्रयोपेतो य एनं पूजयिष्यति ..
सप्तम्यां सूर्यवारेण यावद्द्वादश भास्कराः ...4..
5.56.m:
Gālava said: / "O best among gods, I am sonless and situated in advanced age; / therefore give me an excellent son who will increase my lineage." (11)
The glorious Sūrya said: / "O brahmin, you will have a son who will increase your lineage, / radiant, renowned, knowledgeable in the scriptures, and a master of the Vedas. (12)
Since this image of me was made by you near Sāmbasūrya, / it will be known by the name 'Sāmbasūrya' on the surface of the earth. (13)
Any other person as well, endowed with faith, who worships him / on a Sunday that is a seventh [tithi], for twelve suns, (14)

5.56.s:
saptamyaśca dvijaśreṣṭha nirāhārastu bhaktitaḥ yā ..
sa prāpsyati na saṃdehaḥ putraṃ vaṃśavivardhanam .. 15 ..
5.56.d:
सप्तम्यश्च द्विजश्रेष्ठ निराहारस्तु भक्तितः या ..
स प्राप्स्यति न संदेहः पुत्रं वंशविवर्धनम् .. 15 ..
5.56.m: and seventh [tithis], O best of brahmins, fasting with devotion, / will without doubt obtain a son who enhances his lineage." (15)

5.56.s:
evamuktvā ca saptāśvo virarāma divākaraḥ ..
gālavo'pi prahṛṣṭātmā jagāma nijamaṃdiram .. 16 ..
5.56.d:
एवमुक्त्वा च सप्ताश्वो विरराम दिवाकरः ..
गालवोऽपि प्रहृष्टात्मा जगाम निजमंदिरम् .. 16 ..
5.56.m: Having spoken thus, the sun drawn by seven horses ceased speaking; / and Gālava, his heart overjoyed, went to his own abode.

5.56.s:
nātidīrgheṇa kālena tatastasyābhava tatsutaḥ..
yathoktastena devena sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ .. 17 ..
5.56.d:
नातिदीर्घेण कालेन ततस्तस्याभव तत्सुतः..
यथोक्तस्तेन देवेन सर्वलक्षणलक्षितः .. 17 ..
5.56.m: Then, before much time had passed, a son was born to him / as promised by that god, endowed with all auspicious marks.

5.56.s:
tataścakre pitā nāma vaṭeśvara iti svayam ..
vaṭasthena yato dattaḥ saṃtuṣṭenāṃśumālinā .. 18 ..
5.56.d:
ततश्चक्रे पिता नाम वटेश्वर इति स्वयम् ..
वटस्थेन यतो दत्तः संतुष्टेनांशुमालिना .. 18 ..
5.56.m: Then the father himself gave him the name Vaṭeśvara, / because he had been granted by the ray-garlanded [sun] who was pleased, standing at the banyan tree (vaṭa).

5.56.s:
vaṭeśvarasutāndṛṣṭvā pautrāṃśca dvijasattamāḥ ..
gālavaḥ sūryamāpannaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ tapaḥ .. 19 ..
5.56.d:
वटेश्वरसुतान्दृष्ट्वा पौत्रांश्च द्विजसत्तमाः ..
गालवः सूर्यमापन्नः कृत्वा सुविपुलं तपः .. 19 ..
5.56.m: Seeing the sons and grandsons of Vaṭeśvara, O best of brahmins, / Gālava attained the sun, having performed vast austerity.

5.56.s:
vaṭeśvaro'pi saṃjñāya pitrā saṃsthāpitaṃ ravim ..
tadarthaṃ kārayāmāsa prāsādaṃ sumanoharam .. 6.56.20 ..
5.56.d:
वटेश्वरोऽपि संज्ञाय पित्रा संस्थापितं रविम् ..
तदर्थं कारयामास प्रासादं सुमनोहरम् .. 6.56.20 ..
5.56.m: Vaṭeśvara, too, knowing that the sun had been established by his father, / had a very charming temple constructed for him.

5.56.s:
tataḥprabhṛti loke ca sa vaṭādityasaṃjñitaḥ ..
putraprado hyaputrāṇāṃ vikhyāto bhuvanatraye .. 21 ..
5.56.d:
ततःप्रभृति लोके च स वटादित्यसंज्ञितः ..
पुत्रप्रदो ह्यपुत्राणां विख्यातो भुवनत्रये .. 21 ..
5.56.m: From that time forward in the world, known by the name Vaṭāditya, / he became renowned throughout the three worlds as a granter of sons to the childless.

5.56.s:
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ..
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā saptamīrdvādaśa kramāt ..
sa prāpnoti sutaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svavaṃśasya vivardhanam .. 22 ..
5.56.d:
सप्तम्यां सूर्यवारेण उपवासपरायणः ..
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या सप्तमीर्द्वादश क्रमात् ..
स प्राप्नोति सुतं श्रेष्ठं स्ववंशस्य विवर्धनम् .. 22 ..
5.56.m: Devoted to fasting on the seventh lunar day (saptamī) coinciding with a Sunday, / whoever worships him with devotion on twelve successive seventh days, / obtains an excellent son who enhances his lineage.

5.56.s:
niṣkāmo vā naro yastu taṃ pūjayati mānavaḥ ..
sa mokṣamāpnuyānnūnaṃ durlabhaṃ tridaśairapi .. 23 ..
5.56.d:
निष्कामो वा नरो यस्तु तं पूजयति मानवः ..
स मोक्षमाप्नुयान्नूनं दुर्लभं त्रिदशैरपि .. 23 ..
5.56.m: Or whatever man, free from desire, worships him, / he will surely attain liberation, hard even for the gods to reach.

5.56.s:
atha gāthā purā gītā nāradena surarṣiṇā ..
dṛṣṭvā putrapradaṃ devaṃ vaṭādityaṃ sureśvaram .. 24 ..
5.56.d:
अथ गाथा पुरा गीता नारदेन सुरर्षिणा ..
दृष्ट्वा पुत्रप्रदं देवं वटादित्यं सुरेश्वरम् .. 24 ..
5.56.m: Now, a song was formerly sung by the celestial seer Nārada / upon beholding that son-granting god, the lord of gods, Vaṭāditya:

5.56.s:
api varṣaśatā nārī vaṃdhyā vā durbhagāpi vā ..
sāṃbasūryaprasādena sadyo garbhavatī bhavet .. 25 ..
5.56.d:
अपि वर्षशता नारी वंध्या वा दुर्भगापि वा ..
सांबसूर्यप्रसादेन सद्यो गर्भवती भवेत् .. 25 ..
5.56.m: “Even a woman a hundred years old, barren, or unfortunate / will at once become pregnant through the grace of Sāmbāditya.

5.56.s:
kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ vratairdhyānaiḥ kiṃ japaiḥ sopavāsakaiḥ ..
putrārthaṃ vidyamāne'tha sāṃbasūrye sureśvare .. 26 ..
5.56.d:
किं दानैः किं व्रतैर्ध्यानैः किं जपैः सोपवासकैः ..
पुत्रार्थं विद्यमानेऽथ सांबसूर्ये सुरेश्वरे .. 26 ..
5.56.m: What need of gifts, what of vows and meditations, what of recitations with fasts, / for the sake of a son, while Sāmbāditya, the lord of gods, is present?”

5.56.s:
varṣamekaṃ naro bhaktyā yaḥ paśyetsūryavāsare ..
kṛtakṣaṇo'tra putraṃ sa labhate cottamaṃ sukham.. 27 ..
5.56.d:
वर्षमेकं नरो भक्त्या यः पश्येत्सूर्यवासरे ..
कृतक्षणोऽत्र पुत्रं स लभते चोत्तमं सुखम्.. 27 ..
5.56.m: The man who with devotion beholds [him] on a Sunday for one year, / finding leisure here, obtains a son and supreme happiness.

5.56.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena taṃ devaṃ yatnato dvijāḥ ..
paśyedātmahitārthāya svavaṃśaparivṛddhaye .. 28 ..
5.56.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तं देवं यत्नतो द्विजाः ..
पश्येदात्महितार्थाय स्ववंशपरिवृद्धये .. 28 ..
5.56.m: Therefore, O brahmins, with every effort one should diligently behold that god / for one’s own welfare and for the increase of one’s lineage.

5.56.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye sāṃbādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 56.. .. cha ..
5.56.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखंडे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सांबादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्पञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. .. 56.. .. छ ..
5.56.m: Thus ends the fifty-sixth chapter, named “Description of the Māhātmya of Sāmbāditya,” in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.57.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasminkṣetre tathādityaḥ sthāpito dvijasattamāḥ ..
bhīṣmeṇa brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ saṃmatena tathātmanā .. 1 ..
5.57.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे तथादित्यः स्थापितो द्विजसत्तमाः ..
भीष्मेण ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां संमतेन तथात्मना .. 1 ..
5.57.m: Sūta said: / In that sacred field, O best of brahmins, the sun was likewise established / by Bhīṣma, in agreement with the foremost of brahmins, and through his own will.

5.57.s:
śaṃtanordayitaḥ putro gāṃgeya iti viśrutaḥ ..
āsītpurā varo nṛṇāmūrdhvaretāḥ suviśrutaḥ .. 2 ..
5.57.d:
शंतनोर्दयितः पुत्रो गांगेय इति विश्रुतः ..
आसीत्पुरा वरो नृणामूर्ध्वरेताः सुविश्रुतः .. 2 ..
5.57.m: Formerly, there was a beloved son of Śaṃtanu, renowned as Gāṅgeya, / the best of men, celebrated as one whose semen flows upward (ūrdhvaretas).

5.57.s:
tasyāsīttumulaṃ yuddhaṃ bhārgaveṇa samaṃ mahat ..
trayoviṃśaddinānyeva devāsuraraṇopamam..
aṃbākṛte śitaiḥ śastrairastraiśca tadanaṃtaram.. 3 ..
5.57.d:
तस्यासीत्तुमुलं युद्धं भार्गवेण समं महत् ..
त्रयोविंशद्दिनान्येव देवासुररणोपमम्..
अंबाकृते शितैः शस्त्रैरस्त्रैश्च तदनंतरम्.. 3 ..
5.57.m: A fierce, great battle occurred between him and the descendant of Bhṛgu (Bhārgava) / for twenty-three days, resembling a war between gods and asuras, / on account of Ambā, with sharp weapons and missiles thereafter.

5.57.s:
tato brahmādayo devāḥ svayameva vyavasthitāḥ ..
tābhyāṃ nivāraṇārthāya śāṃtyarthaṃ sarvadehinān ..
gatāśca te samutthāpya punareva triviṣṭapam .. 4 ..
5.57.d:
ततो ब्रह्मादयो देवाः स्वयमेव व्यवस्थिताः ..
ताभ्यां निवारणार्थाय शांत्यर्थं सर्वदेहिनान् ..
गताश्च ते समुत्थाप्य पुनरेव त्रिविष्टपम् .. 4 ..
5.57.m: Then the gods, headed by Brahmā, stood between them on their own / to restrain those two, for the pacification of all embodied beings; / and having raised them up, they went again to heaven.

5.57.s:
aṃbāpi prāpya paramaṃ gāṃgeyotthaṃ parābhavam ..
praviṣṭā koparaktākṣī susamiddhe hutāśane..5..
5.57.d:
अंबापि प्राप्य परमं गांगेयोत्थं पराभवम् ..
प्रविष्टा कोपरक्ताक्षी सुसमिद्धे हुताशने..5..
5.57.m: Ambā, too, having suffered supreme humiliation arising from Gāṅgeya, / entered a blazing fire, her eyes red with fury.

5.57.s:
bhartsayitvā nadīputraṃ bāṣpavyākulalocanā..
tataḥprovāca madhyasthā vahneḥ kurupitāmaham..6..
5.57.d:
भर्त्सयित्वा नदीपुत्रं बाष्पव्याकुललोचना..
ततःप्रोवाच मध्यस्था वह्नेः कुरुपितामहम्..6..
5.57.m: Having reviled the son of the river (Gāṅgeya), her eyes clouded with tears, / standing in the midst of the fire she then spoke to the grandfather of the Kurus:

5.57.s:
yasmādbhīṣma tvayā tyaktā kāmārtāhaṃ sudurmate..
tasmāttava vadhāyāśu bhaviṣyāmi punaḥ kṣitau..7..
5.57.d:
यस्माद्भीष्म त्वया त्यक्ता कामार्ताहं सुदुर्मते..
तस्मात्तव वधायाशु भविष्यामि पुनः क्षितौ..7..
5.57.m: “Since I, afflicted by desire, was rejected by you, O Bhīṣma, O evil-minded one, / therefore I shall be born again on earth swiftly for your slaying.

5.57.s:
strīhatyayā samāyuktastvaṃ ca nūnaṃ bhaviṣyasi..
pramāṇaṃ yadi dharmo'tra smṛtiśāstrasamudbhavaḥ .. 8 ..
5.57.d:
स्त्रीहत्यया समायुक्तस्त्वं च नूनं भविष्यसि..
प्रमाणं यदि धर्मोऽत्र स्मृतिशास्त्रसमुद्भवः .. 8 ..
5.57.m: And you will surely be tainted with the sin of killing a woman, / if the dharma arising from the smṛti scriptures is authoritative here.”

5.57.s:
tataḥ sa ghṛṇayā''viṣṭo bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ ..
mārkaṃḍeyaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ..9..
5.57.d:
ततः स घृणया'ऽविष्टो भीष्मः कुरुपितामहः ..
मार्कंडेयं मुनिश्रेष्ठं पप्रच्छ विनयान्वितः..9..
5.57.m: Then Bhīṣma, the grandfather of the Kurus, seized with remorse, / humbly questioned the best of sages, Mārkaṇḍeya:

5.57.s:
bhagavankāśirājasya sutayā me prajalpitam ..
mama mṛtyukaraṃ pāpaṃ sakalaṃ te bhaviṣyati .. 6.57.10 ..
5.57.d:
भगवन्काशिराजस्य सुतया मे प्रजल्पितम् ..
मम मृत्युकरं पापं सकलं ते भविष्यति .. 6.57.10 ..
5.57.m: “O venerable one, by the daughter of the king of Kāśi it was proclaimed to me: / ‘All the sin causing your death will fall upon you.’

5.57.s:
tatkiṃ syādvākyamātreṇa no vā brāhmaṇasattama ..
atra me saṃśayastattvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi.. 11 ..
5.57.d:
तत्किं स्याद्वाक्यमात्रेण नो वा ब्राह्मणसत्तम ..
अत्र मे संशयस्तत्त्वं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि.. 11 ..
5.57.m: Could that be so by mere words, or not, O best of brahmins? / In this matter I have a doubt; you ought to tell me the truth properly.”

5.57.s:
.. śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
ākṣiptastāḍito vāpi yamuddiśya tyajedasūn ..
strījano vā dvijo vāpi tasya pāpaṃ tu tadbhavet .. 12 ..
5.57.d:
.. श्रीमार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
आक्षिप्तस्ताडितो वापि यमुद्दिश्य त्यजेदसून् ..
स्त्रीजनो वा द्विजो वापि तस्य पापं तु तद्भवेत् .. 12 ..
5.57.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “Against whomever reviled or struck, a woman or a brahmin gives up life / on his account, that sin indeed belongs to him.

5.57.s:
striyaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vāpi tasmānnaiva prakopayet ..
nighnaṃtaṃ vā śapaṃtaṃ vā yadīcchecchubhamātmanaḥ .. 13 ..
tvayā punarvarākī sā kāmārtā samupekṣitā ..
jitvā svayaṃvare pūrvaṃ tatkathaṃ syānna pāpabhāk ...4..
5.57.d:
स्त्रियं वा ब्राह्मणं वापि तस्मान्नैव प्रकोपयेत् ..
निघ्नंतं वा शपंतं वा यदीच्छेच्छुभमात्मनः .. 13 ..
त्वया पुनर्वराकी सा कामार्ता समुपेक्षिता ..
जित्वा स्वयंवरे पूर्वं तत्कथं स्यान्न पापभाक् ...4..
5.57.m:
Therefore one should never enrage a woman or a brahmin, / whether striking or cursing, if one desires welfare for oneself.
Moreover, by you that wretched woman, afflicted by desire, was neglected, / having won her formerly at a bridegroom-choice (svayaṃvara); how then could you not partake of the sin?”

5.57.s:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
tadarthaṃ vada me brahmanprāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye ..
tapo vā yadi vā dānaṃ vrataṃ niyamameva vā .. 15 ..
5.57.d:
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
तदर्थं वद मे ब्रह्मन्प्रायश्चित्तं विशुद्धये ..
तपो वा यदि वा दानं व्रतं नियममेव वा .. 15 ..
5.57.m: Bhīṣma said: / “For that reason, tell me, O brahmin, the expiation for purification— / whether austerity, or a gift, a vow, or a religious observance.”

5.57.s:
.. mārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
daśānāṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ yadvadhe pātakaṃ smṛtam ..
tatpāpaṃ strīvadhe kṛtsnaṃ jāyate bharatarṣabha .. 16 ..
5.57.d:
.. मार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
दशानां ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां यद्वधे पातकं स्मृतम् ..
तत्पापं स्त्रीवधे कृत्स्नं जायते भरतर्षभ .. 16 ..
5.57.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “The guilt that is stated for the slaying of ten eminent brahmins, / all that sin arises in the slaying of a woman, O bull of the Bharatas.

5.57.s:
tadatra viṣaye dānaṃ na tapo na vratādikam ..
tīrthasevāṃ parityajya tasmāttvaṃ tāṃ samācara .. 17 ..
.. .. sūta uvāca .. ..
sa tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ ..
tīrthayātrāparo bhūtvā babhrāma kṣitimaṃḍale...8..
5.57.d:
तदत्र विषये दानं न तपो न व्रतादिकम् ..
तीर्थसेवां परित्यज्य तस्मात्त्वं तां समाचर .. 17 ..
.. .. सूत उवाच .. ..
स तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा भीष्मः कुरुपितामहः ..
तीर्थयात्रापरो भूत्वा बभ्राम क्षितिमंडले...8..
5.57.m:
In this matter there is no gift, no austerity, no vow and the like [that avails], / apart from serving sacred fords; therefore perform that.”
Sūta said: / Hearing his words, Bhīṣma, the grandfather of the Kurus, / devoted to pilgrimage to sacred fords, wandered across the circle of the earth.

5.57.s:
tataḥ kramātsamāyāto bhramamāṇo mahītale ..
camatkārapure kṣetre nānātīrthasamākule .. 19 ..
5.57.d:
ततः क्रमात्समायातो भ्रममाणो महीतले ..
चमत्कारपुरे क्षेत्रे नानातीर्थसमाकुले .. 19 ..
5.57.m: Then, wandering over the surface of the earth, he came in due course / to the sacred field of Camatkārapura, crowded with various sacred fords.

5.57.s:
athāpaśyanmahātmā sa supuṇyaṃ tadgayāśiraḥ ..
snātvā śrāddhaṃ ca vidhivadyāvacchraddhāsama nvitaḥ .. 6.57.20 ..
5.57.d:
अथापश्यन्महात्मा स सुपुण्यं तद्गयाशिरः ..
स्नात्वा श्राद्धं च विधिवद्यावच्छ्रद्धासम न्वितः .. 6.57.20 ..
5.57.m: Then that great soul saw the very holy Gayāśiras there; / having bathed, just as he was endowed with faith, in accordance with the rules for an ancestral rite (śrāddha),

5.57.s:
cakre tāvannabhovāṇī vākyametaduvāca ha ..
bhīṣmabhīṣma mahābāho nārhastvaṃ śrāddhajaṃ vidhim .. 21 ..
5.57.d:
चक्रे तावन्नभोवाणी वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ..
भीष्मभीष्म महाबाहो नार्हस्त्वं श्राद्धजं विधिम् .. 21 ..
5.57.m: performed it, a voice from the sky spoke this sentence: / ‘O Bhīṣma, Bhīṣma of mighty arms, you are not fit to perform the rite

5.57.s:
kartuṃ strīhatyayāyuktastasmācchṛṇu vaco mama ..
śarmiṣṭhātīrthamityeva khyātaṃ pātakanāśanam .. 22 ..
5.57.d:
कर्तुं स्त्रीहत्ययायुक्तस्तस्माच्छृणु वचो मम ..
शर्मिष्ठातीर्थमित्येव ख्यातं पातकनाशनम् .. 22 ..
5.57.m: born of śrāddha, tainted as you are with the killing of a woman; therefore hear my words. / There is the renowned sacred ford named Śarmiṣṭhātīrtha, destroyer of sins,

5.57.s:
asmātsthānātsamīpasthaṃ vāruṇyāṃ diśi puṇyakṛt ..
kṛṣṇāṃgārakaṣaṣṭhyāṃ yo naraḥ snānaṃ samācaret .. 23 ..
5.57.d:
अस्मात्स्थानात्समीपस्थं वारुण्यां दिशि पुण्यकृत् ..
कृष्णांगारकषष्ठ्यां यो नरः स्नानं समाचरेत् .. 23 ..
5.57.m: near to this place, in the western direction, producing merit. / The man who performs a ritual ablution on the sixth day of the dark fortnight falling on a Tuesday (kṛṣṇāṅgārakaṣaṣṭhī),

5.57.s:
sa strīhatyākṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
tasmādadya dine putra bhaumavārasamanvitā .. 24 ..
5.57.d:
स स्त्रीहत्याकृतात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ..
तस्मादद्य दिने पुत्र भौमवारसमन्विता .. 24 ..
5.57.m: is freed from the sin committed through killing a woman; there is no doubt in this. / Therefore, on this day, my son, endowed with Tuesday,

5.57.s:
saiva ṣaṣṭhī tithiḥ puṇyā tasmāttatra drutaṃ vraja ..
ahaṃ tava pitā putra śaṃtanuḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ .. 25 ..
5.57.d:
सैव षष्ठी तिथिः पुण्या तस्मात्तत्र द्रुतं व्रज ..
अहं तव पिता पुत्र शंतनुः पृथिवीपतिः .. 25 ..
5.57.m: that very auspicious sixth lunar day is here; therefore go there quickly. / I am your father, O son, Śaṃtanu, the ruler of the earth.

5.57.s:
strīhatyayānvitaṃ jñātvā tatastūrṇamihāgataḥ ..
tato bhīṣmo drutaṃ gatvā tatra sthāne samāhitaḥ .. 26 ..
5.57.d:
स्त्रीहत्ययान्वितं ज्ञात्वा ततस्तूर्णमिहागतः ..
ततो भीष्मो द्रुतं गत्वा तत्र स्थाने समाहितः .. 26 ..
5.57.m: Knowing you to be tainted with the killing of a woman, I have come here swiftly.’ / Thereupon Bhīṣma went quickly, composed in mind at that place,

5.57.s:
snānaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ śrāddhaṃ cakre śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
tato bhūyaḥ samāgatya sa taṃ provāca śatanuḥ .. 27 ..
5.57.d:
स्नानं कृत्वा ततः श्राद्धं चक्रे श्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
ततो भूयः समागत्य स तं प्रोवाच शतनुः .. 27 ..
5.57.m: and having performed his ritual ablution, he then performed the śrāddha endowed with faith. / Then, having arrived again, that Śaṃtanu spoke to him:

5.57.s:
vipāpmā tvaṃ kuruśreṣṭha saṃjāto'si na saṃśayaḥ ..
tasmānnijaṃ gṛhaṃ gaccha rājyaciṃtāṃ samācara .. 28 ..
5.57.d:
विपाप्मा त्वं कुरुश्रेष्ठ संजातोऽसि न संशयः ..
तस्मान्निजं गृहं गच्छ राज्यचिंतां समाचर .. 28 ..
5.57.m: "O best of Kurus, you have become free from sin, there is no doubt. / Therefore, go to your own home and attend to the affairs of the kingdom."

5.57.s:
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo jñātvā tīrthamanuttamam ..
vāsudevātmikāmarcāṃ tathānyāṃ kurusattamaḥ .. 29 ..
5.57.d:
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो ज्ञात्वा तीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
वासुदेवात्मिकामर्चां तथान्यां कुरुसत्तमः .. 29 ..
5.57.m: Then, filled with wonder and knowing it to be an unsurpassed sacred ford, that best of the Kurus [installed] an image of Vāsudeva, and another,

5.57.s:
pārijātamayīṃ mūrtiṃ raverlakṣaṇalakṣitām ..
supramāṇāṃ surūpāṃ ca śraddhāpūtena cetasā .. 6.57.30 ..
5.57.d:
पारिजातमयीं मूर्तिं रवेर्लक्षणलक्षिताम् ..
सुप्रमाणां सुरूपां च श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा .. 6.57.30 ..
5.57.m: an image of the Sun made of pārijāta wood, endowed with the [prescribed] characteristics, / with good proportions and beautiful form, with a mind purified by faith.

5.57.s:
tathānyatsthāpayāmāsa liṃgaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ ..
durgāṃ ca bhaktisaṃyukto vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā .. 31 ..
5.57.d:
तथान्यत्स्थापयामास लिंगं देवस्य शूलिनः ..
दुर्गां च भक्तिसंयुक्तो विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा .. 31 ..
5.57.m: Likewise, endowed with devotion, according to the rites prescribed by rule, / he installed another liṅga of the trident-bearing God, and [an image of] Durgā.

5.57.s:
tataḥ sarvānsamāhūya sa viprānpurasaṃbhavān ..
provāca kauravo bhīṣmo vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ .. 32 ..
5.57.d:
ततः सर्वान्समाहूय स विप्रान्पुरसंभवान् ..
प्रोवाच कौरवो भीष्मो विनयावनतः स्थितः .. 32 ..
5.57.m: Then, having summoned all the brahmins born in that town, / the Kaurava Bhīṣma stood bowed with humility and spoke:

5.57.s:
mayā vinirmitaṃ viprā devāgāracatuṣṭayam ..
etatkṣetre ca yuṣmākaṃ dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari .. 33 ..
5.57.d:
मया विनिर्मितं विप्रा देवागारचतुष्टयम् ..
एतत्क्षेत्रे च युष्माकं दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि .. 33 ..
5.57.m: "O brahmins, four temples of the gods have been constructed by me / in this sacred field. Showing compassion toward me,

5.57.s:
pālayadhvaṃ prayāsyāmi svagṛhaṃ prati satvaram..
preritaḥ pitṛbhirdivyaiḥ svargamārgasamāśritaiḥ .. 34 ..
5.57.d:
पालयध्वं प्रयास्यामि स्वगृहं प्रति सत्वरम्..
प्रेरितः पितृभिर्दिव्यैः स्वर्गमार्गसमाश्रितैः .. 34 ..
5.57.m: protect them. I shall depart swiftly to my own home, / impelled by my divine ancestors who abide on the path to heaven."

5.57.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
gacchagaccha kuruśreṣṭha suviśrabdhaḥ svamāyayā ..
vayaṃ sarve kariṣyāmo yuṣmacchreyo'bhivardhanam .. 35 ..
5.57.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
गच्छगच्छ कुरुश्रेष्ठ सुविश्रब्धः स्वमायया ..
वयं सर्वे करिष्यामो युष्मच्छ्रेयोऽभिवर्धनम् .. 35 ..
5.57.m: The brahmins said: / "Go, go, O best of Kurus, fully confident by your own power! / We all shall bring about the increase of your prosperity.

5.57.s:
devaśreṇiriyaṃ rājanyā tvayātra vinirmitā ..
asyāḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ sadā vayam.. 36 ..
5.57.d:
देवश्रेणिरियं राजन्या त्वयात्र विनिर्मिता ..
अस्याः पूजादिकं सर्वं करिष्यामः सदा वयम्.. 36 ..
5.57.m: O king, this series of deities that has been established here by you— / we will always perform all their worship and rites.

5.57.s:
tavāpi vinayaṃ dṛṣṭvā parituṣṭā vayaṃ nṛpa ..
sarvānprārthaya tasmāttvaṃ varaṃ svaṃ manasi sthitam ..37 ..
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
eṣa eva varo'smākaṃ yatsaṃtuṣṭā dvijottamāḥ ..
tathāpyāśu vacaḥ kāryaṃ yuṣmadīyaṃ mayādhunā .. 38 .1
5.57.d:
तवापि विनयं दृष्ट्वा परितुष्टा वयं नृप ..
सर्वान्प्रार्थय तस्मात्त्वं वरं स्वं मनसि स्थितम् ..37 ..
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
एष एव वरोऽस्माकं यत्संतुष्टा द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तथाप्याशु वचः कार्यं युष्मदीयं मयाधुना .. 38 .1
5.57.m:
Seeing your humility as well, O king, we are exceedingly pleased. / Therefore, ask of all of us a boon that resides in your heart."
Bhīṣma said: / "This alone is my boon, that the best of brahmins are pleased. / Nevertheless, your word must now be carried out quickly by me:

5.57.s:
etāni devasadmāni madīyāni naro bhuvi ..
yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya pūjayecchraddhayā'nvitaḥ ..
prasādādeva yuṣmākaṃ tasya tatsyādasaṃśayam .. 39 ..
5.57.d:
एतानि देवसद्मानि मदीयानि नरो भुवि ..
यो यं काममभिध्याय पूजयेच्छ्रद्धयाऽन्वितः ..
प्रसादादेव युष्माकं तस्य तत्स्यादसंशयम् .. 39 ..
5.57.m: Whatever desire a human being on earth may contemplate, and full of faith / worship in these temples of mine—by your grace alone, / that desire will surely be his, without doubt."

5.57.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
ādityasya kariṣyāmo yātrāṃ bhādrapade vayam ..
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa sarvadaiva samāhitāḥ .. 6.57.40 ..
5.57.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
आदित्यस्य करिष्यामो यात्रां भाद्रपदे वयम् ..
सप्तम्यां सूर्यवारेण सर्वदैव समाहिताः .. 6.57.40 ..
5.57.m: The brahmins said: / "In the month of Bhādrapada we shall perform the pilgrimage-festival of the Sun / on the seventh day falling on a Sunday, remaining always attentive;

5.57.s:
tathā śivasya cāṣṭamyāṃ caitraśukle viśeṣataḥ ..
caturdaśyāṃ mahābhāga tava snehānna saṃśayaḥ .. 41 ..
5.57.d:
तथा शिवस्य चाष्टम्यां चैत्रशुक्ले विशेषतः ..
चतुर्दश्यां महाभाग तव स्नेहान्न संशयः .. 41 ..
5.57.m: and of Śiva on the eighth day, especially during the bright fortnight of Caitra; / [and] on the fourteenth day, O fortunate one, out of love for you, without a doubt;

5.57.s:
śayane bodhane viṣṇoḥ saṃprāpte dvādaśīdine ..
viṣṇorapi ca durgāyāḥ saṃprāpte navamīdine ..42..
5.57.d:
शयने बोधने विष्णोः संप्राप्ते द्वादशीदिने ..
विष्णोरपि च दुर्गायाः संप्राप्ते नवमीदिने ..42..
5.57.m: when the twelfth day arrives for Viṣṇu's sleeping and waking; / and when the ninth day arrives for both Viṣṇu and Durgā

5.57.s:
āśvine śuklapakṣe ca gītavāditranisvanaiḥ..
mahotsavaṃ tathā citrairhāsyalāsyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 43...
yastatra mānavo nityaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ..
kariṣyati ca gītādi sa yāsyati parāṃ gatim .. 44 ..
5.57.d:
आश्विने शुक्लपक्षे च गीतवादित्रनिस्वनैः..
महोत्सवं तथा चित्रैर्हास्यलास्यैः पृथग्विधैः .. 43...
यस्तत्र मानवो नित्यं श्रद्धया परया युतः ..
करिष्यति च गीतादि स यास्यति परां गतिम् .. 44 ..
5.57.m: in the bright fortnight of Āśvina, with the sounds of singing and musical instruments, / and a great festival with diverse and wonderful comic acting and graceful dances. / Whatever human being, always endowed with supreme faith, / performs singing and the like there, shall attain the highest state.

5.57.s:
vayaṃ tasya bhaviṣyāmaḥ sadaiva prītamānasāḥ ..
pradāsyāmastathā kāmānmanasā vāṃchitānnṛpa .. .. 45 ..
5.57.d:
वयं तस्य भविष्यामः सदैव प्रीतमानसाः ..
प्रदास्यामस्तथा कामान्मनसा वांछितान्नृप .. .. 45 ..
5.57.m: We shall always be pleased in our minds toward him, / and we shall grant the desires wished for in his heart, O king."

5.57.s:
evamuktvātha te viprāḥ svāni sthānāni bhejire ..
bhīṣmo'pi harṣasaṃyuktaḥ svagṛhaṃ prasthitastataḥ .. 46 ..
5.57.d:
एवमुक्त्वाथ ते विप्राः स्वानि स्थानानि भेजिरे ..
भीष्मोऽपि हर्षसंयुक्तः स्वगृहं प्रस्थितस्ततः .. 46 ..
5.57.m: Having spoken thus, those brahmins returned to their own abodes; / and Bhīṣma, filled with joy, departed thence to his own home.

5.57.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye gāṃgeyayātrākhyānaṃnāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 57 .. .. cha .. ..
5.57.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखंडे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गांगेययात्राख्यानंनाम सप्तपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 57 .. .. छ .. ..
5.57.m: Thus ends the fifty-seventh chapter, named 'The Narration of the Pilgrimage of Gāṅgeya', in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skanda Purāṇa.

5.58.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ saṃsthāpya gāṃgeyaḥ puṇyaṃ devacatuṣṭayam ..
tataḥ saṃsthāpayāmāsa gaṃgāṃ tripathagāminīm .. 1 ..
5.58.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं संस्थाप्य गांगेयः पुण्यं देवचतुष्टयम् ..
ततः संस्थापयामास गंगां त्रिपथगामिनीम् .. 1 ..
5.58.m: Sūta said: / Having thus established the holy group of four deities, / Gāṅgeya then installed the Gaṅgā that flows in three worlds

5.58.s:
kūpikāyāṃ mahābhāga śivaliṃgasya pūrvataḥ ..
tataḥ provāca tānhṛṣṭaḥ saṃpūjya dvijasattamān .. 2 ..
5.58.d:
कूपिकायां महाभाग शिवलिंगस्य पूर्वतः ..
ततः प्रोवाच तान्हृष्टः संपूज्य द्विजसत्तमान् .. 2 ..
5.58.m: in a small well to the east of the Śivaliṅga, O fortunate one. / Then, delighted, having worshipped those best of brahmins, he spoke:

5.58.s:
asyāṃ yaḥ puruṣaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā māṃ vīkṣayiṣyati ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivalokaṃ prayāsyati .. 3 ..
5.58.d:
अस्यां यः पुरुषः स्नानं कृत्वा मां वीक्षयिष्यति ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः शिवलोकं प्रयास्यति .. 3 ..
5.58.m: "The person who, having bathed in this, shall behold me, / freed from all sins, shall go to the world of Śiva.

5.58.s:
kariṣyati tathā yastu śapathaṃ cātra mānavaḥ ..
asatyaṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ sa yamasya gṛhaṃ prati .. 4 ..
5.58.d:
करिष्यति तथा यस्तु शपथं चात्र मानवः ..
असत्यं यास्यति क्षिप्रं स यमस्य गृहं प्रति .. 4 ..
5.58.m: And whatever human being here takes an oath / that is false, shall quickly go to the house of Yama."

5.58.s:
evamuktvā mahābhāgo bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ ..
jagāma svapuraṃ tasmāddharṣeṇa mahatā vṛtaḥ .. 5 ..
5.58.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महाभागो भीष्मः कुरुपितामहः ..
जगाम स्वपुरं तस्माद्धर्षेण महता वृतः .. 5 ..
5.58.m: Having spoken thus, the fortunate Bhīṣma, grandfather of the Kurus, / departed thence to his own city, filled with great joy.

5.58.s:
.. sūta uvāca ..
tatrāsīcchūdrasaṃbhūtaḥ pauṃḍrakonāma nāmataḥ ..
bālabhāve samaṃ mitraiḥ sa krīḍati divāniśam .. 6 ..
5.58.d:
.. सूत उवाच ..
तत्रासीच्छूद्रसंभूतः पौंड्रकोनाम नामतः ..
बालभावे समं मित्रैः स क्रीडति दिवानिशम् .. 6 ..
5.58.m: Sūta said: / There was a man born of a Śūdra named Pauṇḍraka. / In his childhood he played day and night with his friends.

5.58.s:
hāsyabhāvācca mitrasya pustakaṃ tena coritam ..
mitraiḥ pṛṣṭaḥ pauṇḍrakaḥ sa prāha naiva mayā hṛtam .. 7 ..
5.58.d:
हास्यभावाच्च मित्रस्य पुस्तकं तेन चोरितम् ..
मित्रैः पृष्टः पौण्ड्रकः स प्राह नैव मया हृतम् .. 7 ..
5.58.m: And in jest a book of his friend was stolen by him. / Questioned by his friends, that Pauṇḍraka said, 'It was not taken by me at all!

5.58.s:
pustakaṃ caiva yuṣmākaṃ cintanīyaṃ sadaiva tat ..
bhavadbhiryatnamāsthāya dṛśyatāṃ kvāpi pustakam .. 8 ..
5.58.d:
पुस्तकं चैव युष्माकं चिन्तनीयं सदैव तत् ..
भवद्भिर्यत्नमास्थाय दृश्यतां क्वापि पुस्तकम् .. 8 ..
5.58.m: You should always look after that book of yours. / Making an effort, you should look for the book somewhere else!'

5.58.s:
kṛtāśca śapathāstatra snātvā bhāgīrathījale ..
aduṣṭacetasā tena dattaṃ tatpustakaṃ hṛtam .. 9 ..
5.58.d:
कृताश्च शपथास्तत्र स्नात्वा भागीरथीजले ..
अदुष्टचेतसा तेन दत्तं तत्पुस्तकं हृतम् .. 9 ..
5.58.m: And having bathed there in the water of the Bhāgīrathī, oaths were taken [by him]. / Without wicked intention, that stolen book was then returned by him,

5.58.s:
punaśca ruciraṃ hāsyaṃ kṛtvā tena samaṃ bahu ..
athāsāvabhavatkuṣṭhī tatkṣaṇādeva garhitaḥ .. 6.58.10 ..
5.58.d:
पुनश्च रुचिरं हास्यं कृत्वा तेन समं बहु ..
अथासावभवत्कुष्ठी तत्क्षणादेव गर्हितः .. 6.58.10 ..
5.58.m: and again he made much charming laughter together with him. / Then he became a leper, instantly despised.

5.58.s:
sa tyakto bāṃdhavaiḥ sarvaiḥ kalatrairapi vallabhaiḥ ..
tato vairāgyamāpanno bhṛgupātaṃ papāta saḥ .. 11 ..
5.58.d:
स त्यक्तो बांधवैः सर्वैः कलत्रैरपि वल्लभैः ..
ततो वैराग्यमापन्नो भृगुपातं पपात सः .. 11 ..
5.58.m: He was abandoned by all his kinsmen and even by his beloved wives. / Then, having attained dispassion, he threw himself from a cliff.

5.58.s:
jātaśca tatprabhāvena kuṣṭhena parivarjitaḥ ..
śāstracauryakṛtāddoṣānmūkarūpaḥ sa hāsyakṛt .. 12 ..
5.58.d:
जातश्च तत्प्रभावेन कुष्ठेन परिवर्जितः ..
शास्त्रचौर्यकृताद्दोषान्मूकरूपः स हास्यकृत् .. 12 ..
5.58.m: And by the power of that [tīrtha] he was born free of leprosy; / [yet] due to the sin of stealing a text, that jester took the form of a mute.

5.58.s:
na kāryaḥ śapathastasmāttasyāgre'pi laghurdvijāḥ ..
api hāsyopacāreṇa ātmanaḥ sukhamicchatā .. 13 ..
5.58.d:
न कार्यः शपथस्तस्मात्तस्याग्रेऽपि लघुर्द्विजाः ..
अपि हास्योपचारेण आत्मनः सुखमिच्छता .. 13 ..
5.58.m: Therefore, even in front of it, O brahmins, one desiring happiness for oneself / must not make a frivolous oath, even in jest.

5.58.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śivagaṃgāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma aṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 58 .. ..
5.58.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शिवगंगामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम अष्टपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 58 .. ..
5.58.m: Thus ends the fifty-eighth chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Śivagaṅgā', in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skanda Purāṇa.

5.59.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasminkṣetre raviḥ pūrvaṃ vidureṇa pratiṣṭhitam ..
śivaśca parayā bhaktyā tathā viṣṇurdvijottamāḥ .. 1 ..
5.59.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे रविः पूर्वं विदुरेण प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
शिवश्च परया भक्त्या तथा विष्णुर्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 1 ..
5.59.m: Sūta said: / In that sacred field, the Sun was previously installed by Vidura, / and Śiva, and likewise Viṣṇu, with supreme devotion, O best of brahmins.

5.59.s:
yastānpūjayate bhaktyā mānuṣo bhaktitastataḥ ..
sa yāsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ yajñairapi sudurlabham ..2 ..
5.59.d:
यस्तान्पूजयते भक्त्या मानुषो भक्तितस्ततः ..
स यास्यति परं स्थानं यज्ञैरपि सुदुर्लभम् ..2 ..
5.59.m: The mortal who then worships them with devotion / shall go to the supreme abode, which is very difficult to attain even by sacrifices.

5.59.s:
hastināpurasaṃsthena vidureṇa purā dvijāḥ ..
gālavo muniśārdūlaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ svagṛhamāgataḥ .. 3 ..
5.59.d:
हस्तिनापुरसंस्थेन विदुरेण पुरा द्विजाः ..
गालवो मुनिशार्दूलः पृष्टः स्वगृहमागतः .. 3 ..
5.59.m: Long ago, O brahmins, Vidura, residing in Hastināpura, / questioned Gālava, the tiger among sages, who had come to his house:

5.59.s:
aputrasya gatirloke kīdṛksaṃjāyate pare ..
etanme pṛcchato brūhi kṛtvā sadbhāvamuttamam .. 4 ..
5.59.d:
अपुत्रस्य गतिर्लोके कीदृक्संजायते परे ..
एतन्मे पृच्छतो ब्रूहि कृत्वा सद्भावमुत्तमम् .. 4 ..
5.59.m: "What kind of fate befalls one who is childless in the other world? / Tell this to me who am asking, having assumed the best of goodwill."

5.59.s:
.. gālava uvāca .. ..
aputrasya gatirnāsti mṛtaḥ svargaṃ na gacchati ..
dvādaśānāmapi tathā yadyeko'pi na vidyate .. 5 ..
5.59.d:
.. गालव उवाच .. ..
अपुत्रस्य गतिर्नास्ति मृतः स्वर्गं न गच्छति ..
द्वादशानामपि तथा यद्येकोऽपि न विद्यते .. 5 ..
5.59.m: Gālava said: / "There is no fate in the hereafter for the childless; dead, he does not go to heaven / if there is not even one among the twelve [kinds of sons]:

5.59.s:
aurasaḥ kṣetrajaścaiva krayakrītaśca pālitaḥ ..
paunarbhavaḥ punardattaḥ kuṃḍo golastathā paraḥ ..
kānīnaśca sahoḍhaśca aśvattho brahmavṛkṣakaḥ .. 6 ..
5.59.d:
औरसः क्षेत्रजश्चैव क्रयक्रीतश्च पालितः ..
पौनर्भवः पुनर्दत्तः कुंडो गोलस्तथा परः ..
कानीनश्च सहोढश्च अश्वत्थो ब्रह्मवृक्षकः .. 6 ..
5.59.m: the son of one's own body, the son of the wife, the bought son, the reared son, / the son of a remarried woman, the son given away again, the kuṇḍa, the gola, and another, / the son of an unmarried woman, the son received with a bride, and the aśvattha tree, the tree of Brahmā."

5.59.s:
eteṣāmapi yadyekaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ na jāyate ..
tannūnaṃ narake vāsaḥ puṃsaṃjñe vai prajāyate .. 7 .. ..
5.59.d:
एतेषामपि यद्येकः पुरुषाणां न जायते ..
तन्नूनं नरके वासः पुंसंज्ञे वै प्रजायते .. 7 .. ..
5.59.m: If not even one among these is born to men, / then surely dwelling in the hell named Put comes to pass.

5.59.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya gālavasya mahātmanaḥ ..
aputratvātparaṃ duḥkhaṃ jagāma vidurastadā .. 8 ..
5.59.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य गालवस्य महात्मनः ..
अपुत्रत्वात्परं दुःखं जगाम विदुरस्तदा .. 8 ..
5.59.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of the noble Gālava, / Vidura was then plunged into great sorrow due to his childlessness.

5.59.s:
taptastaṃ gālavaḥ prāha mā tvaṃ duḥkhapadaṃ vraja ..
madvākyātputrakaṃ vṛkṣaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñaṃ drutaṃ kuru ..9..
5.59.d:
तप्तस्तं गालवः प्राह मा त्वं दुःखपदं व्रज ..
मद्वाक्यात्पुत्रकं वृक्षं विष्णुसंज्ञं द्रुतं कुरु ..9..
5.59.m: Pained [by his grief], Gālava said to him: 'Do not go into a state of sorrow. / At my word, swiftly make a tree named Viṣṇu your son.

5.59.s:
tasmātprāpsyasi niḥśeṣaṃ phalaṃ putrasamudbhavam ..
gatvā puṇyatame deśe raktaśṛṃgasya mūrdhani ..6.59.10..
5.59.d:
तस्मात्प्राप्स्यसि निःशेषं फलं पुत्रसमुद्भवम् ..
गत्वा पुण्यतमे देशे रक्तशृंगस्य मूर्धनि ..6.59.10..
5.59.m: From that you will obtain the entire fruit arising from a son, / having gone to the most sacred region, on the summit of Raktaśṛṅga,

5.59.s:
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sarvavṛddhiśubhodaye ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vidurastatkṣaṇādyayau .. 11 ..
5.59.d:
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे सर्ववृद्धिशुभोदये ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विदुरस्तत्क्षणाद्ययौ .. 11 ..
5.59.m: in the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara, where all prosperity and auspiciousness arise.' / Having heard his speech, Vidura departed at that very moment.

5.59.s:
tatsthānaṃ gālavoddiṣṭaṃ harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ ..
tatrāśvatthataruṃ sthāpya putratve cābhiṣecya ca .. 12 ..
5.59.d:
तत्स्थानं गालवोद्दिष्टं हर्षेण महतान्वितः ..
तत्राश्वत्थतरुं स्थाप्य पुत्रत्वे चाभिषेच्य च .. 12 ..
5.59.m: Filled with great joy, he went to that place indicated by Gālava. / Having planted an aśvattha tree there and consecrated it as a son,

5.59.s:
vaivāhikena vidhinā kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha ..
tato babhrāma tatkṣetraṃ tīrthayātrāparāyaṇaḥ.. 13 ..
kīrtitāni vicitrāṇi rājarṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām ..
śrutvā sthānāni gatvā ca dadarśa sthānadevatāḥ...4 ..
5.59.d:
वैवाहिकेन विधिना कृतकृत्यो बभूव ह ..
ततो बभ्राम तत्क्षेत्रं तीर्थयात्रापरायणः.. 13 ..
कीर्तितानि विचित्राणि राजर्षीणां महात्मनाम् ..
श्रुत्वा स्थानानि गत्वा च ददर्श स्थानदेवताः...4 ..
5.59.m:
he fulfilled his purpose through the marital rite. / Then he wandered through that sacred field, devoted to the pilgrimage of sacred fords.
Having heard of the marvelous places celebrated by noble royal seers, / he went and beheld the presiding deities of those places.

5.59.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā kuruvṛddhasya kīrtanāni mahātmanaḥ ..
tataścakre matiṃ tatra divyaprāsādakarmaṇi .. 15 ..
5.59.d:
स दृष्ट्वा कुरुवृद्धस्य कीर्तनानि महात्मनः ..
ततश्चक्रे मतिं तत्र दिव्यप्रासादकर्मणि .. 15 ..
5.59.m: Having seen the celebrated works of the elder of the Kurus, the noble one, / he then set his mind on the work of building divine temples there.

5.59.s:
tato māheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ vaṭādhastādvidhāya saḥ ..
viṣṇuṃ ca sthāpayāmāsa aśvatthasya taroradhaḥ .. 16 ..
5.59.d:
ततो माहेश्वरं लिंगं वटाधस्ताद्विधाय सः ..
विष्णुं च स्थापयामास अश्वत्थस्य तरोरधः .. 16 ..
5.59.m: Then, having installed a liṅga of Maheśvara beneath a banyan tree, / he also installed Viṣṇu beneath the aśvattha tree.

5.59.s:
niveśya ca tathā divyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nyavedayat ..
etaddevatrayaṃ kṣetre yuṣmākaṃ hi mayā kṛtam ..
bhavadbhiḥ sakalā cāsya cintākāryā sadaiva hi .. 17 ..
5.59.d:
निवेश्य च तथा दिव्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो न्यवेदयत् ..
एतद्देवत्रयं क्षेत्रे युष्माकं हि मया कृतम् ..
भवद्भिः सकला चास्य चिन्ताकार्या सदैव हि .. 17 ..
5.59.m: And having established that divine [shrine], he announced to the brahmins: / 'This triad of deities in the sacred field has indeed been established by me for you. / All care of it must always be undertaken by you.'

5.59.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
vayamasya kariṣyāmo yātrādyāḥ sakalāḥ kriyāḥ .. 18 ..
5.59.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
वयमस्य करिष्यामो यात्राद्याः सकलाः क्रियाः .. 18 ..
5.59.m: The brahmins said: / 'We shall perform all the rites for it, such as festivals and the like.

5.59.s:
tathā vaṃśodbhavā ye ca putrāḥ pautrāstathāpare ..
kariṣyaṃti kriyāḥ sarvāstvaṃ gaccha svagṛhaṃ prati .. 19 ..
5.59.d:
तथा वंशोद्भवा ये च पुत्राः पौत्रास्तथापरे ..
करिष्यंति क्रियाः सर्वास्त्वं गच्छ स्वगृहं प्रति .. 19 ..
5.59.m: Likewise, our descendants, sons, grandsons, and others, / will perform all the rites. Go to your own home.'

5.59.s:
tato jagāma viduraḥ svapuraṃ prati harṣitaḥ ..
kṛtakṛtyo dvijāste ca cakrurvākyaṃ tadudbhavam.. 6.59.20 ..
5.59.d:
ततो जगाम विदुरः स्वपुरं प्रति हर्षितः ..
कृतकृत्यो द्विजास्ते च चक्रुर्वाक्यं तदुद्भवम्.. 6.59.20 ..
5.59.m: Then Vidura, having achieved his purpose, went joyfully to his own city; / and those twice-born ones carried out the words spoken by him.

5.59.s:
māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa yo naraḥ ..
pūjayedbhāskaraṃ tatra sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 21 ..
5.59.d:
माघमासस्य सप्तम्यां सूर्यवारेण यो नरः ..
पूजयेद्भास्करं तत्र स याति परमां गतिम् .. 21 ..
5.59.m: Whatever person worships the Sun there on the seventh day of the month of Māgha, / falling on a Sunday, goes to the highest state;

5.59.s:
śivaṃ vā somavāreṇa śuklāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
śayane bodhane viṣṇuṃ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 22 ..
5.59.d:
शिवं वा सोमवारेण शुक्लाष्टम्यां विशेषतः ..
शयने बोधने विष्णुं सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 22 ..
5.59.m: or [worships] Śiva on a Monday, especially on the bright eighth day; / [or worships] Viṣṇu on his sleeping and waking days, endowed with proper faith.

5.59.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena devānāṃ tattrayaṃ śubham ..
pūjanīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa naraiḥ svargatimīpsubhiḥ .. 23 ..
5.59.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन देवानां तत्त्रयं शुभम् ..
पूजनीयं विशेषेण नरैः स्वर्गतिमीप्सुभिः .. 23 ..
5.59.m: Therefore, with every effort, that auspicious triad of deities / should especially be worshipped by men desiring to attain heaven.

5.59.s:
tatra siddhiṃ gatāḥ pūrvaṃ munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ..
vidureśvaramārādhya śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 24 ..
5.59.d:
तत्र सिद्धिं गताः पूर्वं मुनयः संशितव्रताः ..
विदुरेश्वरमाराध्य शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 24 ..
5.59.m: There, having worshipped Vidureśvara, sages of strict vows / formerly attained perfection by hundreds and by thousands.

5.59.s:
tatastatsiddhidaṃ jñātvā liṃgaṃ vai pākaśāsanaḥ ..
pāṃsubhiḥ pūrayāmāsa yathā kaścinna budhyate .. 25 ..
5.59.d:
ततस्तत्सिद्धिदं ज्ञात्वा लिंगं वै पाकशासनः ..
पांसुभिः पूरयामास यथा कश्चिन्न बुध्यते .. 25 ..
5.59.m: Then, knowing that liṅga to be a bestower of perfection, Indra (Pākaśāsana) / covered it with dust so that no one would know of it.

5.59.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya vidurastatra cāgataḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā lopagataṃ liṃgaṃ duḥkhena mahatānvitaḥ .. 26 ..
5.59.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य विदुरस्तत्र चागतः ..
दृष्ट्वा लोपगतं लिंगं दुःखेन महतान्वितः .. 26 ..
5.59.m: After some time, however, Vidura arrived there; / seeing the liṅga vanished, he was overcome with great grief.

5.59.s:
etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
mā tvaṃ kuru viṣādaṃ hi liṃgārthe vidurādhunā ..27...
5.59.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
मा त्वं कुरु विषादं हि लिंगार्थे विदुराधुना ..27...
5.59.m: At that very moment, a bodiless voice said: / 'Vidura, do not despair now on account of the liṅga!

5.59.s:
yo'yaṃ sa dṛśyate vālo vaṭastasya tale sthitā ..
devadroṇiḥ sureśena pāṃsubhiḥ paripūritā .. 28 ..
5.59.d:
योऽयं स दृश्यते वालो वटस्तस्य तले स्थिता ..
देवद्रोणिः सुरेशेन पांसुभिः परिपूरिता .. 28 ..
5.59.m: The young banyan tree that is seen here—at its base / lies the trough of the gods, filled with dust by the lord of the gods.'

5.59.s:
tato gajāhvayāttūrṇaṃ samānīya dhanaṃ bahu ..
śodhayāmāsa tatsthānaṃ divārātramatandritaḥ .. 29 ..
5.59.d:
ततो गजाह्वयात्तूर्णं समानीय धनं बहु ..
शोधयामास तत्स्थानं दिवारात्रमतन्द्रितः .. 29 ..
5.59.m: Then, having swiftly brought much wealth from Hastināpura (Gajāhvaya), / he cleared that place day and night without sloth.

5.59.s:
tato vilokya tāndevānharṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ ..
prāsādaṃ nirmame teṣāṃ yogyaṃ sādhvabhisaṃsthitam .. .. 6.59.30 ..
5.59.d:
ततो विलोक्य तान्देवान्हर्षेण महतान्वितः ..
प्रासादं निर्ममे तेषां योग्यं साध्वभिसंस्थितम् .. .. 6.59.30 ..
5.59.m: Then, having seen those gods, filled with great joy, / he constructed a suitable, well-built temple for them.

5.59.s:
kailāsaśikharākāraṃ bhāskarārthe mahāmuniḥ ..
jaṭāmadhyagataṃ dṛṣṭvā vaṭasya ca maheśvaram .. 31 ..
5.59.d:
कैलासशिखराकारं भास्करार्थे महामुनिः ..
जटामध्यगतं दृष्ट्वा वटस्य च महेश्वरम् .. 31 ..
5.59.m: For the Sun, the great sage [built one] shaped like the peak of Kailāsa. / Seeing Maheśvara situated within the aerial roots of the banyan tree,

5.59.s:
prāsādaṃ nākarottatra liṃgaṃ yāvanna cālayet ..
vāsudevasya yogyāṃ ca kṛtvā śālāṃ bṛhattarām .. 32 ..
5.59.d:
प्रासादं नाकरोत्तत्र लिंगं यावन्न चालयेत् ..
वासुदेवस्य योग्यां च कृत्वा शालां बृहत्तराम् .. 32 ..
5.59.m: he did not construct a temple there, so as not to move the liṅga; / and having made a very large hall suitable for Vāsudeva,

5.59.s:
dattvā vṛttiṃ ca saṃhṛṣṭo brāhmaṇebhyo nivedya ca ..
jagāma svāśramaṃ bhūyo viprānāmaṃtrya tāṃstataḥ .. 33 ..
5.59.d:
दत्त्वा वृत्तिं च संहृष्टो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो निवेद्य च ..
जगाम स्वाश्रमं भूयो विप्रानामंत्र्य तांस्ततः .. 33 ..
5.59.m: and having granted a livelihood, overjoyed, he presented it to the brahmins; / then, having bid farewell to those vipras, he went back to his own hermitage.

5.59.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye vidurakṛtadevaprāsādavṛttānta varṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 59 .. .. cha ..
5.59.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये विदुरकृतदेवप्रासादवृत्तान्त वर्णनंनामैकोनषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 59 .. .. छ ..
5.59.m: Thus ends the fifty-ninth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Account of the Temple of the Gods Built by Vidura,' in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.60.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
māhittheyaṃ tvayākhyātā yā purā sūtanandana ..
kena saṃsthāpitā tatra vada sarvamaśeṣataḥ .. 1 ..
5.60.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
माहित्थेयं त्वयाख्याता या पुरा सूतनन्दन ..
केन संस्थापिता तत्र वद सर्वमशेषतः .. 1 ..
5.60.m: The seers said: / 'O Son of Sūta, this goddess Māhitthā who was previously mentioned by you— / by whom was she installed there? Tell everything in full.'

5.60.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śoṣaṇīnāma yā vidyā purāgastyena sādhitā ..
ātharvaṇena mantreṇa svayaṃ ca parameśvarī .. .. 2 ..
5.60.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
शोषणीनाम या विद्या पुरागस्त्येन साधिता ..
आथर्वणेन मन्त्रेण स्वयं च परमेश्वरी .. .. 2 ..
5.60.m: Sūta said: / 'The lore named Śoṣaṇī, who was formerly mastered by Agastya / through an Ātharvaṇa mantra, was the supreme goddess herself.

5.60.s:
tataḥ saṃśoṣitastena sa samudro mahātmanā ..
mitrāvaruṇaputreṇa sā proktā purataḥ sthitā .. 3 ..
5.60.d:
ततः संशोषितस्तेन स समुद्रो महात्मना ..
मित्रावरुणपुत्रेण सा प्रोक्ता पुरतः स्थिता .. 3 ..
5.60.m: Then, that ocean having been dried up by him, the noble / son of Mitra and Varuṇa, she standing before him was addressed [by him]:

5.60.s:
māhitthaṃ sādhitaṃ yasmāttvayā me sakalaṃ śubham ..
māhitthānāma tasmāttvaṃ devatā saṃbhaviṣyasi .. 4 ..
5.60.d:
माहित्थं साधितं यस्मात्त्वया मे सकलं शुभम् ..
माहित्थानाम तस्मात्त्वं देवता संभविष्यसि .. 4 ..
5.60.m: 'Since all auspiciousness for me was accomplished in an earthen-pot manner (māhittha), / therefore you will become the deity named Māhitthā.
In the sacred field of Camatkārapura you will obtain unexcelled worship. / Whoever, endowed with devotion, worships you dwelling there

5.60.s:
pūjayiṣyati vṛddhiṃ ca sarvakālamavāpsyati ..
tasmāttatra drutaṃ gaccha mayā sārddhaṃ purottame .. 6 ..
5.60.d:
पूजयिष्यति वृद्धिं च सर्वकालमवाप्स्यति ..
तस्मात्तत्र द्रुतं गच्छ मया सार्द्धं पुरोत्तमे .. 6 ..
5.60.m: with Ātharvaṇa mantras will obtain prosperity at all times. / Therefore, go swiftly with me to that foremost city;

5.60.s:
dvijānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya nityaṃ saṃnihitā bhava ..
evaṃ sā tatra saṃbhūtā māhitthā varadevatā .. 7 ..
5.60.d:
द्विजानां रक्षणार्थाय नित्यं संनिहिता भव ..
एवं सा तत्र संभूता माहित्था वरदेवता .. 7 ..
5.60.m: be ever present for the protection of the twice-born.' / Thus that excellent goddess Māhitthā came to be there,

5.60.s:
yayā'yaṃ calitaḥ śailaḥ svaśaktyā niścalīkṛtaḥ ..
skandeneha dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śaktyā viddhastadagrataḥ .. ..
narādityastataścānyo yo nareṇa pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ taṃ sūryavāreṇa dṛṣṭvā pāpātpramucyate .. 9 ..
5.60.d:
ययाऽयं चलितः शैलः स्वशक्त्या निश्चलीकृतः ..
स्कन्देनेह द्विजश्रेष्ठाः शक्त्या विद्धस्तदग्रतः .. ..
नरादित्यस्ततश्चान्यो यो नरेण प्रतिष्ठितः ..
षष्ठ्यां तं सूर्यवारेण दृष्ट्वा पापात्प्रमुच्यते .. 9 ..
5.60.m: by whom this mountain, when shaken, was made motionless through her own power. / Pierced in front of her with a spear by Skanda here, O best of the twice-born, / there is then another [shrine], Narāditya, which was installed by Nara. / Having seen it on the sixth day falling on a Sunday, one is freed from sin.

5.60.s:
na śatrūṇāṃ parābhūtiṃ prayāsyati yathārjunaḥ ..
rogī vimucyate rogāddaridro dhanamāpnuyāt .. 6.60.10 ..
5.60.d:
न शत्रूणां पराभूतिं प्रयास्यति यथार्जुनः ..
रोगी विमुच्यते रोगाद्दरिद्रो धनमाप्नुयात् .. 6.60.10 ..
5.60.m: He will not suffer defeat by enemies, just like Arjuna. / A sick person is freed from disease, and a poor person will obtain wealth.

5.60.s:
tathā govardhanadharaṃ tatra devaṃ janārdanam ..
yaḥ paśyetkārtike śukle saṃprāpte prathame dine..
tasya gāvaḥ prabhūtāḥ syurnīrogā dvisattamāḥ .. 11 ..
5.60.d:
तथा गोवर्धनधरं तत्र देवं जनार्दनम् ..
यः पश्येत्कार्तिके शुक्ले संप्राप्ते प्रथमे दिने..
तस्य गावः प्रभूताः स्युर्नीरोगा द्विसत्तमाः .. 11 ..
5.60.m: Likewise, whoever beholds the god Janārdana holding Mount Govardhana there, / when the first day in the bright half of Kārtika arrives, / his cows will become numerous and free of disease, O best of the twice-born.

5.60.s:
narasiṃhavapuḥ sākṣāttathā devo hariḥ svayam ..
tathā vināyakastatra sarvakāmapradāyakaḥ ..
sarvavighnaharaścaiva sthāpitaścārjunena hi .. 12 ..
5.60.d:
नरसिंहवपुः साक्षात्तथा देवो हरिः स्वयम् ..
तथा विनायकस्तत्र सर्वकामप्रदायकः ..
सर्वविघ्नहरश्चैव स्थापितश्चार्जुनेन हि .. 12 ..
5.60.m: Likewise, the god Hari himself is directly present in the form of Narasiṃha. / Also Vināyaka, bestower of all desires / and remover of all obstacles, was established there by Arjuna.

5.60.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā caturthyāṃ modakāśanaiḥ ..
sa sarvavighnanirmukto labhate vāṃchitaṃ phalam ..
tatra sthito dvijeṃdrāṇāṃ hitāya dvijasattamāḥ 413 ..
yastamātharvaṇairmaṃtraiḥ pūjayeddvādaśīdine ..
kārtikasya site pakṣe sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 14 ..
tathā tatra dvijaśreṣṭhā naranārāyaṇāvubhau ..
devau paramatejasvī yastau paśyati bhaktitaḥ .. 15 ..
pūjayecca dvijaśreṣṭhā dvādaśyā divase svayam ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam .. 16 ..
tīrthayātrākṛtāraṃbhaḥ kuntīputro dhanaṃjayaḥ ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre samāyāto dvijottamāḥ .. 17 ..
dṛṣṭvā tatpāvanaṃ kṣetraṃ tīrthapūgaprapūritam..
ādityaṃ sthāpayāmāsa prāsāde sumanohare .. 18 ..
naranārāyaṇau devau tasyāgre sthāpitau tataḥ ..
tathā govardhanadharastatra devaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 19 ..
5.60.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या चतुर्थ्यां मोदकाशनैः ..
स सर्वविघ्ननिर्मुक्तो लभते वांछितं फलम् ..
तत्र स्थितो द्विजेंद्राणां हिताय द्विजसत्तमाः 413 ..
यस्तमाथर्वणैर्मंत्रैः पूजयेद्द्वादशीदिने ..
